analysis.video_title: Bankipur By-Election: बांकीपुर में BJP की हार तय? प्रशांत किशोर ने कर दी बड़ी भविष्यवाणी! |ABPLIVE

respondents.key_reason: He is contesting the Bankipur by-election to defeat BJP, force them to change their leadership in Bihar (specifically remove CM Samrat Chaudhary due to alleged criminal background and false claims), and make MLAs accountable. He believes BJP is arrogant and relies on Modi's name, Hindu-Muslim issues, and fear of Lalu Prasad Yadav.
respondents.quote_original: भाजपा हार रही है चुनाव। भाजपा हार रही है और प्रशांत किशोर जीत रहे हैं। बुरी तरीके से भाजपा हारेगी। आप देखिएगा।
respondents.quote_english: BJP is losing the election. BJP is losing and Prashant Kishor is winning. BJP will lose badly. You will see.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Political strategist, leader of Jan Suraaj, contesting the Bankipur by-election in Patna, Bihar.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video features an in-depth interview with political strategist Prashant Kishor, who is contesting the Bankipur by-election. Kishor expresses strong confidence in defeating BJP in their traditional stronghold, aiming to challenge their perceived arrogance and force a change in leadership in Bihar. He criticizes the current BJP Chief Minister, Samrat Chaudhary, on grounds of alleged criminal history and false claims, while also outlining his party's agenda focused on accountability and development.

analysis.video_title: Bankipur By-Election: बदलाव या BJP? बांकीपुर में जनता का मूड क्या कहता है? |ABPLIVE

respondents.key_reason: Believes BJP is ahead despite a triangular contest and dismisses the impact of student protests and Prashant Kishor's influence.
respondents.quote_original: इस बार का चुनाव तो त्रिकोणी है भले ही मगर फिर भी भाजपा का लक्ष्य आगे है।
respondents.quote_english: This election is triangular, but still, BJP's target is ahead.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, named Lal Ji Gupta, likely older ('chacha').

respondents.key_reason: The atmosphere is completely pro-BJP, citing strong local support for Nitin Naveen. Dismisses any impact from student protests.
respondents.quote_original: माहौल पूरा भाजपामय है।
respondents.quote_english: The atmosphere is completely pro-BJP.

respondents.key_reason: Waiting to see which of the three candidates the public chooses, stating that the government will be formed by whoever provides good work and a good system. Acknowledges significant change due to student protests.
respondents.quote_original: जो अच्छा काम देगी, जो अच्छा व्यवस्था देगी, सरकार उसी का बनेगा।
respondents.quote_english: Whichever provides good work, good system, their government will be formed.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, named Chandan Kumar Gupta, E-rickshaw driver, voter of Bankipur.

respondents.key_reason: Believes the student protest has been beneficial and will lead to a change in government this time.
respondents.quote_original: फायदा तो हुआ है। क्योंकि इस बार चेंज होंगे सरकार।
respondents.quote_english: There has been a benefit. Because this time the government will change.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, named Diljeet Kumar, student, also works, from Digha (not a Bankipur voter).

respondents.key_reason: The atmosphere has become 'dangerous' due to the student protests, with widespread anger and destruction, indicating a shift in public mood.
respondents.quote_original: इस बार का माहौल तो और खतरनाक है। ए भैया ऐसा क्योंकि कुछ दिन पहले देखे कि इतना हल्ला हंगामा गुदाल हुआ है पूरा स्टूडेंट लोग इतना मारपीट किया है कहीं कुछ जला दे रहा है तो कहीं कुछ कर दे रहा है कहीं आग लगा दे रहा है कोई जिप्सी में आग लगा दे रहा है।
respondents.quote_english: This time the atmosphere is even more dangerous. Because a few days ago we saw so much commotion and chaos, students fought so much, burning things, setting fire to jeeps.

respondents.key_reason: The atmosphere has changed since the agency protest. While BJP works, it sometimes falters, which has created an opportunity for change.
respondents.quote_original: माहौल चेंज है। जब से एजेंसी का प्रोटेस्ट हुआ है तब से माहौल चेंज है। नो डाउट बीजेपी काम करती है लेकिन कहीं-कहीं भटक जाती है कहीं-कहीं जिसका फायदा इनको मिला है और इस बार चेंज होने वाला है कुछ माहौल।
respondents.quote_english: The atmosphere has changed. Ever since the agency protest, the atmosphere has changed. No doubt BJP works but sometimes it falters, which has benefited others, and this time the atmosphere is going to change.

respondents.key_reason: The triangular contest has made voters more aware, expecting higher turnout. Praises Modi's handling of the student protest, viewing his 'bowing down' to students as a positive, guardian-like gesture.
respondents.quote_original: मोदी जी ने जो एक के कहा जाता है ना कि एक गार्डियन होता है और आप हम लोग हर दिन प्रत्येक दिन अपने बच्चों के पीछे नीचे घुझुकते हैं और एक वो गार्डियन थे उन्होंने झुका और बच्चों के प्रति झुकना कोई बहुत बड़ा इशू नहीं है।
respondents.quote_english: What is said about Modi ji is that he is like a guardian, and we all bow down to our children every day, and he was a guardian, he bowed down, and bowing down to children is not a big issue.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, named Kundan Kumar Gupta, runs a medicine shop (Shankar Medical).

respondents.key_reason: Believes a young party will emerge, possibly Jan Suraaj or BJP. Separates the student protest (NEET paper) from the local election issues.
respondents.quote_original: हमें तो लगता है कि एक यंग पार्टी ही उठेगा या तो जन स्वराज पार्टी में भी हो सकते हैं और बीजेपी में इन दोनों में हमको लगता है कि कोई ना कोई अच्छे कोई बनेंगे।
respondents.quote_english: I feel that a young party will emerge, it could be Jan Suraaj Party or BJP, I think one of them will be good.

respondents.key_reason: Identifies as a BJP supporter and expects BJP to win. Considers the student protest a separate issue with no significant impact on party preferences.
respondents.quote_original: नहीं वैसा तो कोई खास पार्टी में नहीं हुआ है। वो सब माहौल अलग है। इधर का माहौल अलग है। ... लेकिन हम लोग तो भाजपा से हैं। भाजपा ही रहेंगे। भाजपा ही जीतेगा।
respondents.quote_english: No, there hasn't been any special impact on any party. That atmosphere is different. This atmosphere is different. ... But we are with BJP. We will remain with BJP. BJP will win.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, named Anil Kumar, resident of Bankipur.

respondents.key_reason: Unsure about the political mood and election outcome, stating he doesn't frequent the area much. Does not comment on the student protest's impact.
respondents.quote_original: बता नहीं सकते हैं। हम तो हम तो यहां कम आते हैं। ... हमको नहीं मालूम सब।
respondents.quote_english: Cannot say. I don't come here often. ... I don't know anything.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, named Vivek, voter in Bankipur but doesn't frequent the area.

respondents.key_reason: Believes there is a strong wave for Jan Suraaj. Acknowledges that the student protest has caused some change in the atmosphere.
respondents.quote_original: लहर जन स्वराज का है।
respondents.quote_english: There is a wave for Jan Suraaj.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, named Sanjay Kumar Gupta, born and raised in Bankipur, works in a private business.

respondents.key_reason: Cannot specify the current political mood. Acknowledges that the student protest has caused some change in the atmosphere but doesn't link it to a specific party's gain or loss.
respondents.quote_original: अब इसको तो नहीं बता सकते हैं। ... माहौल क्या माहौल थोड़ा बहुत बदला है क्या इस बार वोट करेंगे वोटिंग सरकार चला रही है अच्छा तो है
respondents.quote_english: Now I cannot say. ... Has the atmosphere changed a bit? Will vote this time, the government is running well, it's good.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures diverse public opinions in Bankipur regarding the by-election, with the recent student protests being a central point of discussion. While some residents express firm support for BJP, dismissing the protests' impact, a significant number believe the protests have shifted the political landscape, creating a mood for change or benefiting emerging parties like Jan Suraaj. The election is perceived as a triangular contest, with voters weighing factors like good governance, local candidate appeal, and the aftermath of the student unrest.

metadata.title: Bankipur का व्यापारी वर्ग किसके साथ? किसे दे रहा वोट, सुरक्षा की गारंट चाहिए.. BJP या PK?
metadata.constituency_audit_reason: Video title and summary explicitly mention 'Bankipur' in the context of elections.

analysis.video_title: Bankipur का व्यापारी वर्ग किसके साथ? किसे दे रहा वोट, सुरक्षा की गारंट चाहिए.. BJP या PK?

respondents.key_reason: Believes BJP provides security to traders and has done significant development work, contrasting it with previous times when traders felt unsafe. Dismisses the opposition.
respondents.quote_original: यहां व्यापारियां सुरक्षित नहीं रहता था। जो लोग व्यापार करता था जो पहले का व्यापारी है समय को उससे अच्छा तो सरकार दे रही है ना देती है वो सुरक्षा बिल्कुल देती है कैसे नहीं देती नहीं देता तो कैसे देता
respondents.quote_english: Traders were not safe here. The government is providing better security than before. It definitely provides security, how can it not? If it didn't, how would it?
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, likely a trader/businessman in Bankipur.

respondents.key_reason: Asserts that Bankipur is a BJP 'cadre vote' area and no other party will win. Highlights local development (Mandiri drain/road) and dismisses Prashant Kishor and Tejashwi Yadav's campaigns as 'all talk' or 'paid'.
respondents.quote_original: ना तेजस्वी जीतेंगे ना प्रशांत किशोर जीतेगा यहां कैडर वोट बीजेपी का है... यहां बीजेपी के छोड़ के दूसरा कोई नहीं निकलेगा। एकदम कंफर्म है। कहिए तो लिख देते हैं आपको।
respondents.quote_english: Neither Tejashwi will win nor Prashant Kishor. Here, the cadre vote belongs to BJP... No one else but BJP will emerge here. It's absolutely confirmed. I can even write it down for you.

respondents.key_reason: Expresses strong loyalty to local BJP leader Nitin Nabin, referring to him as an 'elder brother' and crediting his rise to national president to development work. Dismisses recent student protests as irrelevant.
respondents.quote_original: बाकीपुर में बस बीजेपी आ रहा है। बीजेपी आ रहे हैं। रोड नितिन नवीन जी है। हमारे बड़े भाई साहब उनका क्षेत्र का है।
respondents.quote_english: Only BJP is coming in Bankipur. BJP is coming. Nitin Nabin ji is on the road. He is like our elder brother, it's his area.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, local resident and supporter of Nitin Nabin.

respondents.key_reason: Strongly believes BJP will win, citing 25 years of continuous support. Views the elevation of leaders like Nitin Nabin from grassroots (booth president) as a matter of respect and an inspiration.
respondents.quote_original: बाकी में बीजेपी आने वाला है भैया बीजेपी एकदम आएगा ही आएगा आएगा दम आएगा 25 साल से हम लोग लगातार करते आ रहे थे आज वो राष्ट्रीय अध्यक्ष बन गए उनका मान सम्मान का।
respondents.quote_english: BJP is definitely coming in Bankipur, it will surely come. We have been doing this continuously for 25 years, today he became the national president, it's about his respect.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, long-time BJP supporter in Bankipur.

respondents.key_reason: Praises BJP's development work and the rise of leaders like Neeraj Kumar Sinha from booth level. Dismisses recent student protests as 'paid' and not genuine, stating they will not affect the election.
respondents.quote_original: नहीं नहीं नहीं उन्होंने इतना विकास का काम किया है। नीरज कुमार सिन्हा जो है बहुत पीछे से मतलब उठे हैं। बूथ लेवल से वह कार्यकर्ता रहे हैं। समझे यहां विकास आप लोगों को झलक भी रहा होगा।
respondents.quote_english: No, no, no, he has done so much development work. Neeraj Kumar Sinha has risen from very humble beginnings. He has been a booth-level worker. You must be seeing the development here.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, local resident, possibly involved in law or education.

respondents.key_reason: As a long-time resident and businessman, he credits BJP with providing security to traders and ensuring development. States that traders will not vote for RJD and dismisses Prashant Kishor as an ineffective alternative.
respondents.quote_original: व्यापारी जब सुरक्षित है तो करेगा नहीं। आरजेडी में तो जाएगा नहीं। सबसे पहली बात तो सुरक्षित तो विकल्प के तौर पे भैया इस बार पीके पीके आए हैं। तो पीके को आके क्या कर लेंगे भैया? यहां व्यापारियां सुरक्षित नहीं रहता था। जो लोग व्यापार करता था जो पहले का व्यापारी है जिस समय को उससे अच्छा तो सरकार दे रही है ना।
respondents.quote_english: When traders are safe, they will vote for BJP. They won't go to RJD. First and foremost, for security, PK has come as an alternative this time. But what will PK do? Traders were not safe here before. The government is providing better security than before.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, Lassi shop owner, long-time resident (30-40 years) of Bankipur.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures the strong pro-BJP sentiment among traders and local residents in Bankipur. Interviewees consistently express firm support for the BJP, citing development work and improved security for businesses as key reasons. There is a widespread dismissal of Prashant Kishor and Tejashwi Yadav's campaigns, with many believing they lack genuine support or are based on superficial efforts. Loyalty to local BJP leaders and the party's grassroots strength are also highlighted.

metadata.title: Bankipur By Election 2026: Prashant Kishor करेंगे बड़ा उलटफेर? क्या कह रही है जनता | Public Opinion
metadata.constituency_audit_reason: Video title and summary explicitly mention 'Bankipur By Election' and by-election context.

analysis.video_title: Bankipur By Election 2026: Prashant Kishor करेंगे बड़ा उलटफेर? क्या कह रही है जनता | Public Opinion

respondents.key_reason: Desires change from the long-standing BJP rule and believes Prashant Kishor is a different kind of leader who will bring development.
respondents.quote_original: चेंज होना चाहिए यार जन स्वराज को होना चाहिए। उनका अच्छा यही लगता है कि थोड़ा वो कुछ थोड़ा सा अलग टाइप का आदमी है। कुछ विकास करेंगे।
respondents.quote_english: There should be a change, it should be Jan Suraaj. What I like about him is that he is a bit different kind of person. He will bring some development.

respondents.key_reason: Wants a change after 30 years of BJP's presence in the constituency, but is not specific about which party should replace them, stating 'anyone should come'.
respondents.quote_original: अभी तो देखिए अभी बदलना चाहिए। इस बार बदलना चाहिए। इतने 30 साल से यहां बीजेपी है। कोई भी आना चाहिए बदलना चाहिए।
respondents.quote_english: Right now, it should change. This time it should change. BJP has been here for 30 years. Anyone should come, it should change.

respondents.key_reason: Expresses strong dissatisfaction with BJP's performance on employment, law and order, and inflation, but remains undecided between Prashant Kishor and RJD.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी हम पार्टी को कि देश के देश के लिए अब साफ है जिस तरह से आए दिन बलात्कार हत्या लूटपाट बेरोजगारी जो बढ़ावा जो मिल रहा है वो हमको तो नहीं लगता है कि बीजेपी आज जब से सत्ता में आई है जब से रोजगार के लिए मुद्दे पे काम किया हो।
respondents.quote_english: BJP, for the country, it's clear that the way rape, murder, robbery, unemployment are increasing day by day, I don't think BJP has worked on the issue of employment since it came to power.

respondents.key_reason: Believes BJP has become dictatorial and is responsible for rising inflation. Wants to give Prashant Kishor a chance, trusting his promise to provide English medium education for poor children.
respondents.quote_original: जन स्वराज काहे का बढ़िया लग रहा है हां अच्छा है एक बार मौका देना चाहिए... पूरा महंगाई बढ़ गया पूरा तेल करवा तेल के दाम बढ़ गया है। आटा चावल के दाम बढ़ गया है। तानाशाही बीजेपी को हो गया है।
respondents.quote_english: Jan Suraaj seems good, yes, it's good, should give a chance once... Inflation has increased a lot, prices of oil, mustard oil have gone up. Prices of flour and rice have increased. BJP has become dictatorial.

respondents.key_reason: Strongly supports Prashant Kishor, citing public frustration over issues like paper leaks, government's failure to take responsibility for student deaths, and general public suffering. Also hints at EVM tampering.
respondents.quote_original: किशोर आएंगे। हर हाल में आएंगे प्रशांत किशोर।... बच्चा लोग जान ही रहा है ना। अभी पीएमसीएच की तरफ जाम किया हुआ है। बच्चा लोग लाठी चार्ज हो रहा है। जी परेशानी है। बदलने में क्या जैसे मान चलिए चार साल का पेपर लीक हो रहा है। अगर मान चलो आप जो शिक्षा मंत्री बदल दिए तो क्या हो जाएगा? बच्चा लोग 20 लोग मर गए उसका जिम्मेवारी सरकार क्यों नहीं ले रहा है?
respondents.quote_english: Kishor will come. Prashant Kishor will definitely come. ...The children know, right? There's a jam towards PMCH, children are being lathi-charged. Yes, there's trouble. What's the point in changing, for example, if paper leaks happen for four years? If you change the education minister, what will happen? 20 children died, why isn't the government taking responsibility for that?

respondents.key_reason: Expresses strong loyalty to the BJP (Lotus symbol) and believes Prime Minister Modi is doing good work.
respondents.quote_original: हमारा तो कमले छाप अच्छा लगता है। कमले एकदम खिलते रहेगा। लोग बोल रहे हैं बोलने दीजिए जो भी बोल सकते हैं कुछ अपना-अपना बोलने का तरीका है सब बढ़िया लगता है बढ़िया लगता है मोदी जी काम ही अच्छा कर रहे हैं।
respondents.quote_english: I like the lotus symbol. The lotus will keep blooming. Let people say what they want, everyone has their own way of speaking, everything feels good, Modi ji is doing good work.

respondents.key_reason: Supports the BJP candidate to ensure continuity of development and benefit from central and state government schemes, acknowledging the long-standing work of BJP MLAs in the area.
respondents.quote_original: बहुत दिनों से यहां पर जो हमारे जीतते आ रहे हैं विधायक जी लोग। यह भाजपा के ही हैं। तो इनके काम करने का जो शैली है इसको हम लोग को देखते हुए हम लोग इस इनहीं को चाह रहे हैं रिपीट करें। ताकि जो भी केंद्र का योजना हुआ या राज्य का हम लोग खासकर बांकेपुर में विकास जो हुआ है और उसमें गति मिले।
respondents.quote_english: For a long time, the MLAs who have been winning here are from BJP. So, looking at their working style, we want them to repeat. So that whatever central or state schemes are there, especially the development in Bankipur, gets momentum.

respondents.key_reason: Believes the public mood is shifting towards Prashant Kishor and that he should be given a chance. Also suggests that the BJP's current candidate is not as strong as a potential alternative.
respondents.quote_original: मे बी शायद मूड प्रशांत किशोर जी के तरफ से... मेरे को लोगों के जो रिव्यू आ रहे हैं कि इस बार प्रशांत किशोर जी को जीतना चाहिए। एक मौका देना चाहिए।
respondents.quote_english: Maybe the mood is towards Prashant Kishor ji... I am getting reviews from people that Prashant Kishor ji should win this time. He should be given a chance.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Female, From the city (not Bankipur specifically)

respondents.key_reason: Supports NDA for development and believes the BJP candidate will win, continuing the legacy of the previous MLA. Dismisses Prashant Kishor's promises as 'empty talk'.
respondents.quote_original: हम लोग तो एनडीए के सब सपोर्टर हैं। एनडीए को वोट देना है। निश्चित रूप से विकास के नाम पर वोट देना है।... प्रशांत जी का सिर्फ हवा हवाई है। हां जमीन पर कुछ नहीं है।
respondents.quote_english: We are all NDA supporters. We have to vote for NDA. Definitely, we have to vote for development. ...Prashant ji is just empty talk. There's nothing on the ground.

respondents.key_reason: Wants change due to dissatisfaction with the previous BJP MLA (Nitin Naveen) who, despite becoming a national president, did not work for the constituency. Believes Prashant Kishor's candidates are educated and deserve an opportunity.
respondents.quote_original: एक्चुअली पीछे से तो सर देखा गया तो बहुत बढ़िया चला लेकिन इधर जो 10 साल से रिपोर्टेशन थोड़ा खराब हो गया है... इस बार भी सब लोग भी विचार किए हैं कि प्रशांत किशोर को ही दिया जाए... जैसे सर नितिन नवीन को तो हम लोग तीन बार देकर देख लिया वो किसी काम के नहीं है ना कुछ काम करते हैं ना एक बार जीतने के बाद फिर वापस आते ही नहीं है हम लोग के पास... उनके जो भी एमएलए वगैरह जितना है सब पढ़े लिखे कैंडिडेट्स हैं लेकिन पढ़े लिखे लेकिन इनको मौका नहीं दिया गया।
respondents.quote_english: Actually, looking back, it went very well, but for the last 10 years, the reputation has deteriorated... This time, everyone has decided to give it to Prashant Kishor... For example, we have given Nitin Naveen three chances, he is useless, he doesn't do any work, and after winning once, he never comes back to us... All his MLAs are educated candidates, but they haven't been given a chance.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures public sentiment in Bankipur, Bihar, ahead of a by-election, focusing on the contest between BJP and Prashant Kishor's Jan Suraaj. Many residents express a strong desire for change after 30 years of BJP rule, citing issues like inflation, unemployment, and a perceived lack of development, and are keen to give Prashant Kishor a chance. Conversely, a significant portion of the public remains loyal to the BJP/NDA, emphasizing past development and the party's strong local presence, dismissing calls for change.

respondents.key_reason: Supports BJP due to significant development work carried out under Nitin Navin and Narendra Modi's leadership; criticizes Prashant Kishor for only focusing on opposing BJP.
respondents.quote_original: जहां तक मेरे रुझान को आप जानना चाह रही हैं, हम मैंने देखा है नितिन नवीन जी के कार्यकाल में नरेंद्र मोदी जी के नेतृत्व में काफी विकास कार्य हुए और जहां तक मेरा रुझान उनकी तरफ ही है।
respondents.quote_english: As far as my inclination is concerned, I have seen a lot of development work done during Nitin Navin ji's tenure under the leadership of Narendra Modi ji, and my inclination is towards them.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Female, morning walker in a park.

respondents.key_reason: Desires a 'new Bihar' and supports an educated, responsible leader like Prashant Kishor to raise important issues. Expresses cynicism about election rigging and vote buying by the ruling party.
respondents.quote_original: मैं अपना राय देता हूं कि मैं आपकी प्रशांत किशोर को चाहता हूं कि आए इसलिए कि कोई भी गलत मुद्दा पर वह संसद में आवाज उठाएं... हम लोग को एकदम नया बिहार बनाना है।
respondents.quote_english: I give my opinion that I want Prashant Kishor to come so that he can raise his voice in Parliament on any wrong issue... We need to build a new Bihar.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Elderly male, retired sectional officer from Patna Commissionerate, 90 years old, morning walker.

respondents.key_reason: Expresses cynicism that all politicians are the same and will ultimately do similar work, but then states 'Mood PK', indicating a leaning towards Prashant Kishor as a new option.
respondents.quote_original: मैडम बदलना कोई सशन नहीं है। लेकिन कोई भी आएंगे काम वही करेंगे। आप किसी से बहुत ज्यादा उम्मीद नहीं कर सकती हैं। आम नेता जो है सबको ठगते हैं। ... बाकीपुर का मूड क्या है मूड पीके पीके यस।
respondents.quote_english: Madam, change is not a solution. But whoever comes, they will do the same work. You cannot expect too much from anyone. Common leaders deceive everyone. ... What is Bankipur's mood? Mood PK, PK Yes.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, morning walker in a park.

respondents.key_reason: Frustrated with inflation, unemployment, paper leaks in exams, and government actions like encounters and bulldozing homes. Believes the people of Bankipur are ready for change.
respondents.quote_original: बांकीपुर के जनता इस बार बदलाव के मूड में है। हम और जो महंगाई से त्रस्त है हम हम और जो एनकाउंटर जो कर रहे हैं हम और बुलडोजर से गरीबों के झोपड़ी को उजाड़ रहे हैं। हम इससे जनता बांकीपुर की जनता हम त्रस्त है और इसको बदल बदलेंगे।
respondents.quote_english: The people of Bankipur are in a mood for change this time. We are fed up with inflation, and the encounters they are doing, and bulldozing the huts of the poor. The people of Bankipur are fed up with this and will change it.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Female, morning walker in a park.

respondents.key_reason: Strongly supports Jan Suraaj due to high inflation and the necessity for change from the current BJP government.
respondents.quote_original: जन स्वराज को देंगे और किसको देंगे? एकदम खुलम खुल हां खुल्लम खुल्लम हां जो करे या ना करें ये तो मोदी जी इतना दिन से रहे क्या किए तो वो भी है वोट देंगे करना होगा करेंगे नहीं करेंगे मगर अब बीजेपी वाला को नहीं देंगे बदल देना हां बदल देना महंगाई हो गया है अब थोड़ा बदलना भी जरूरी है इसीलिए हम लोग सोच रहे हैं कि अब जन सुराग को हम भेज देंगे
respondents.quote_english: We will give it to Jan Suraaj, who else? Openly, yes, openly. Whether they do something or not, Modi ji has been there for so long, what did he do? So we will vote, they may or may not do it, but we will not give it to BJP now. Change it, yes, change it. Inflation has happened, now it is necessary to change a bit, that's why we are thinking of sending Jan Suraaj.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Female, morning walker in a park.

respondents.key_reason: Tired of the same party for 15 years, likening it to eating the same food daily. Criticizes the arrogance of the incumbent (Nitin Navin) and the increase in crime under the new candidate (Samrat Chaudhary). Expresses a strong desire for change.
respondents.quote_original: बदलना चाहिए बदलना चाहिए बदलना चाहिए। एकदम आराम से। क्यों? 15 साल जो रहे और मतलब 1995 से रहे। अब काहे हां सुनिए इसलिए हमेशा डेली डेली आप दाल, चावल, रोटी, सब्जी तो नहीं खाएंगे ना चेंज तो करता है मन। कभी ये खाएं, कभी वो खाएं। वही समझिए। मतलब कभी दाल, भात, चोखा तो कभी बिरयानी भी। ... तो बदलाव इसलिए चाह रहे हैं कि इसकी घमंड टूटेगी।
respondents.quote_english: It should change, it should change, it should change. Absolutely. Why? They have been there for 15 years, since 1995. Why now? Listen, you don't eat dal, chawal, roti, sabzi every day, do you? The mind changes. Sometimes you eat this, sometimes that. Understand it that way. Sometimes dal, bhat, chokha, sometimes biryani too. ... So we want change so that their arrogance breaks.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Female, morning walker in a park.

respondents.key_reason: Focuses on the issue of student protests (NEET) and the government's response, including the narrative of 'foreign funds' against protestors. Does not explicitly state a party preference.
respondents.quote_original: यहां दिल्ली में हम लोग किए बहुत अन्याय कर दिए हम इ ये लोग देखिए आप गए थे राज गए नहीं थे दिल से थे ना दिल्ली में जाना मतलब जो जजी का जो प्रोटेस्ट हो रहा वह सोशल media पे जो मुहिम चल रही है उसमें आप एकदम पुरजोर तरीके से हां हां पटना में गए थे पटना में गए थे पटना में भी हम लोग को दिल्ली की तरह करना चाह रहे थे सब लेकिन हम लोग आगे बढ़ते हुए राजभवन तक पहुंचे थे हम तो हम लोग दिल्ली का आवाज बुलंद किए थे पटना में लेकिन कुछ लोग है कुछ लोग जैसे विदेशी विदेशी फंड है हम तो देशद्रोही है तो कुछ है ये सारी बातें हां अरे हमेशा हुआ है तो चाहे युवा हो महिला हो या फिर जो जो हमारे पुरुष वर्ग के लोग होते हैं।
respondents.quote_english: Here in Delhi, we faced a lot of injustice. Look, you went to Raj Bhavan, not physically, but with your heart, right? Going to Delhi means the protest that is happening, the campaign on social media, you are fully supporting it. Yes, yes, we went to Patna, we wanted to do it like Delhi in Patna too, but we moved forward and reached Raj Bhavan. So we raised the voice of Delhi in Patna, but some people, like those with foreign funds, are traitors, and so on. These things always happen, whether it's youth, women, or men.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, morning walker in a park.

analysis.overall_video_summary: This video captures the public sentiment in Bankipur ahead of a by-election, revealing a strong desire for change among many residents who are 'tired of the same old routine' (dal-chawal). While some acknowledge past development by the BJP, a significant number express frustration over issues like inflation, unemployment, and perceived government arrogance, leading them to lean towards Prashant Kishor's Jan Suraaj party. The discussion also highlights concerns about election integrity and the handling of student protests.

respondents.key_reason: Expressed dissatisfaction with BJP's performance regarding poverty and employment, stating that Prashant Kishor (Jan Suraaj) helps the poor. Believes BJP has done nothing for Bihar's poor.
respondents.quote_original: भाजपा को कैसे वोट दें? बोलते हैं गरीबी दूर कर देंगे। ई करेंगे, वो करेंगे। क्या करें? क्या करें हैं बिहार में? दिखाइए। सब तरह मानते हैं। एक्टरी है, फैक्टरी है, दिल्ली में है, मुंबई में है, सब तरह है। पटना में कौन चीज़ है? एक बार रिक्शा चलाते हैं तो खाते हैं ना तो अपना सुतल रहते हैं। गरीबों की सरकार नहीं है क्या भाजपा? गरीबों का सरकार रहता तो हम लोग ऐसे कोई कोई रोजगार है? कोई रोजगार नहीं है।
respondents.quote_english: How can we vote for BJP? They say they will remove poverty, they will do this and that. What have they done? What have they done in Bihar? Show me. There are factories in Delhi, Mumbai, everywhere. What is there in Patna? If we drive a rickshaw once, we eat, otherwise we sleep. Is BJP not a government for the poor? If it were a government for the poor, would we have no employment? There is no employment.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, elderly rickshaw driver, resident of PAT Colony, Ward No. 25, SK Puri.

respondents.key_reason: Expressed a belief in 'God's grace' and indicated support for the 'Kamal Chhap' (Lotus symbol of BJP).
respondents.quote_original: क्या कमल छाप कमल छाप हम कमल छाप को क्यों दीजिएगा? हां कृपा भगवान का क्या उन्हीं का कृपा है किनका भगवान को
respondents.quote_english: What, Lotus symbol, Lotus symbol. Why will you vote for Lotus symbol? Yes, it's God's grace, whose grace? God's.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, elderly rickshaw driver, named Chandrama Prasad, resident of PAT Colony, Ward No. 25, SK Puri.

respondents.key_reason: Stated that she is a renter and not a local voter, implying she cannot vote in this election.
respondents.quote_original: हम लोग कैसे जाए हम लोग के यहां का कुछ नहीं है यहां का कुछ नहीं है हम लोग रेंटर हैं तो अच्छा रेंटर हैं आप भी रेंटर हैं कि वोटर आईडी कार्ड रेंटर बोलिए ना रेंटर है गांव मेरा
respondents.quote_english: How can we go? We don't have anything here, we are renters. Oh, you are also a renter? Or do you have a voter ID card? Say it, I am a renter, my village is elsewhere.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Female, renter, not a local voter for Bankipur.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures the political atmosphere in Bankipur ahead of the by-election, featuring interviews with local residents. Opinions are divided, with one elderly rickshaw driver expressing strong disillusionment with BJP over poverty and unemployment, favoring Jan Suraaj, while another rickshaw driver firmly supports BJP. A female renter indicates she cannot vote due to not being a local resident, reflecting diverse perspectives and concerns among the electorate.

respondents.key_reason: Strong appreciation for Nitin Naveen's development work in Bankipur, crediting him with giving the area an identity.
respondents.quote_original: बाकीपुर का पहचान दिए हैं तो नीति नवीन दिए हैं। वो तो बात सही है। तगड़ा फैन है नीति नवीन।
respondents.quote_english: Nitin Naveen gave Bankipur its identity. That's true. I am a strong fan of Nitin Naveen.

respondents.key_reason: Views Prashant Kishor as an educated leader who actively raises student issues and represents a necessary change from established parties.
respondents.quote_original: बेहतर तो हमें प्रशांत किशोर जी लग रहे हैं। हर मायने में वो बेहतर हैं। ... पर जो मतलब एक लगा कि हां भाई ये नेता शिक्षित है तो वो प्रशांत किशोर जी लगे।
respondents.quote_english: Prashant Kishor ji seems better to us. He is better in every aspect. ... But the one who felt like an educated leader was Prashant Kishor ji.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, Young Adult, BPSC aspirant student.

respondents.key_reason: Expresses hope in Prashant Kishor for addressing student issues and bringing change, feeling that trust in the current government is broken.
respondents.quote_original: प्रशांत किशोर तो स्टूडेंट की की बात कर रहे हैं लगातार तो प्रशांत किशोर कर रहे हैं तो अब उनका काम ठीक है उनका सपोर्ट में सब रहेगा लेकिन उनका भी तो काम होना चाहिए अभी नरेंद्र मोदी की तरह अच्छे दिन लाते ही रह जाएंगे ऐसा विचार ना प्रशांत पर उम्मीद है हां उम्मीद है इनको कैसे नेता लगते हैं प्रशांत आपको हमको तो अच्छे लगते हैं अच्छे लगते हैं हां
respondents.quote_english: Prashant Kishor is continuously talking about student issues, so Prashant Kishor is doing well, his support will be there, but his work should also be done, otherwise, like Narendra Modi, good days will keep coming. I have hope in Prashant. Yes, I have hope. How do you find Prashant as a leader? I find him good, good.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Female, Adult, living with parents, husband supports BJP.

respondents.key_reason: Strong demand for change due to BJP's 30-year tenure without significant development, sees Prashant Kishor as offering a concrete development plan and a better alternative.
respondents.quote_original: माहौल परिवर्तन का डिमांड कर रहा है। परिवर्तन का इसलिए कि बीजेपी के कैंडिडेट से अगर पूछा जाए तो वो अपना परिचय ठीक से नहीं दे पाता है। ... 30 साल से कहां बीजेपी मैप बना करके दी? हां। ये बात है कि भाई मैप दिखाइए। ब्लूप्रिंट दिखाइए। है कि नहीं? हम करेंगे। हां। ... बदलाव होना जरूरी है।
respondents.quote_english: The atmosphere is demanding change. Change because if you ask the BJP candidate, he cannot introduce himself properly. ... Where has BJP provided a map for 30 years? Yes. The point is, show the map. Show the blueprint. Right? We will do it. ... Change is necessary.

respondents.key_reason: Critical of Prashant Kishor's past political affiliations and current strategy (believes one seat won't make a difference), but strongly advocates for change due to BJP's long tenure and perceived inaction on student issues.
respondents.quote_original: प्रशांत किशोर जी सभी पार्टियों के लिए काम कर चुके हैं। ... बदलाव होनी चाहिए। निश्चित रूप से जब आप रेगुलर आप विक्ट्री हासिल करते हैं तो आप अहंकार आ जाता है। ... कोई भी जीते कि काम करे क्षेत्र का काम करे।
respondents.quote_english: Prashant Kishor ji has worked for all parties. ... Change should happen. Certainly, when you achieve regular victories, arrogance sets in. ... Whoever wins, they should work for the region.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, Adult, concerned about student issues.

respondents.key_reason: Consistent support for BJP, believes they are doing good work and will continue to do so, expressing unwavering loyalty.
respondents.quote_original: हम शुरू से बीजेपी आया है और यही अभी रहेगा जो भी काम कर रहे हैं अच्छा कर रहे हैं बीजेपी इस बार फिर बीजेपी फिर बीजेपी
respondents.quote_english: BJP has been here from the beginning and will remain, whatever work they are doing is good. This time again BJP, again BJP.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, Adult/Older, Samosa shop owner in Lohanipur market.

respondents.key_reason: Focuses on personal livelihood and expresses disillusionment with politicians who only appear during elections and do not care for the public afterwards.
respondents.quote_original: कोई जीते कोई हारे उससे हमको क्या दिक्कत है कोई प्रॉब्लम नहीं है हां हमको तो अपना काम है अपना काम करेंगे तो खाएंगे नहीं करेंगे तो थोड़े फ्री के मिलता है कहीं पे कुछ नहीं ये तो हमको तो किसी से कोई दिक्कत नहीं परेशान जीते अब है तो ठीक हो और क्यों जीते हैं बीजेपी बीजेपी जो भी जीते उससे हमको कोई फर्क नहीं है।
respondents.quote_english: Whoever wins or loses, what problem do I have with that? No problem. Yes, I have my own work, if I work, I will eat, if I don't, I won't get anything for free. I have no problem with anyone, whether Prashant wins or BJP wins, it doesn't make any difference to me.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Female, Adult, Shopkeeper in Lohanipur market.

respondents.key_reason: Strong desire for change and progress in the region, believes that without change, things will not move forward.
respondents.quote_original: बदलाव होना चाहिए या नहीं बदलाव तो कुछ होना चाहिए तरक्की तो कुछ होना चाहिए बोलेगी नहीं पर बदलाव होना चाहिए ये बोलती नहीं होगा तो फिर आगे बढ़ेगा कैसे
respondents.quote_english: Should there be change or not? Some change should happen, some progress should happen. She won't say it, but change should happen. If it doesn't happen, how will things move forward?

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures diverse opinions from Lohanipur market regarding the Bankipur by-election. While some residents express firm support for BJP, citing past development work, a significant number of younger and adult respondents advocate for change, often leaning towards Prashant Kishor due to his focus on student issues, education, and proposed development blueprints. Many also express disillusionment with traditional politics and a strong desire for genuine progress and accountability from elected leaders.

metadata.title: Bankipur में क्या चल रही बदलाव की बयार? Patna की जनता का सबसे बड़ा खुलासा
metadata.constituency_audit_reason: Video title and summary explicitly mention 'Bankipur' and discuss upcoming elections in Bankipur.

analysis.video_title: Bankipur में क्या चल रही बदलाव की बयार? Patna की जनता का सबसे बड़ा खुलासा

respondents.key_reason: Believes a young party or a good candidate from either Jan Suraaj or BJP will emerge. Does not want to link student protests directly to the election.
respondents.quote_original: हमें तो लगता है कि एक यंग पार्टी ही उठेगा या तो जन स्वराज पार्टी में भी हो सकते हैं और बीजेपी में इन दोनों में हमको लगता है कि कोई ना कोई अच्छे कोई कैंडिडेट होंगे तो बनेंगे ही।
respondents.quote_english: I feel that a young party will rise, it could be Jan Suraaj Party or BJP, I think a good candidate from either of these two will win.

respondents.key_reason: Strong loyalty to BJP, believes BJP will win. Does not think the student protest significantly changed the election mood.
respondents.quote_original: हम लोग तो भाजपा से हैं। भाजपा ही रहेंगे। भाजपा ही जीतेगा।
respondents.quote_english: We are with BJP. We will remain with BJP. BJP will win.

respondents.key_reason: Not regularly present in the area, so unsure about the current political mood and who will win. Unsure if student protests were right or wrong.
respondents.quote_original: बता नहीं सकते हैं हम तो खुश हम तो यहां कम आते हैं कम आते हैं
respondents.quote_english: I can't say, I don't come here often.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, Bankipur voter (but not frequently in the area)

respondents.key_reason: Perceives a strong wave for Jan Suraaj and believes the student protest has caused some change in the atmosphere.
respondents.quote_original: लहर जन स्वराज का है
respondents.quote_english: The wave is for Jan Suraaj.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, Born in Bankipur, works in private business

respondents.key_reason: Believes the current government is running well. Acknowledges that the student protest has caused some change in the atmosphere.
respondents.quote_original: वोटिंग सरकार चला रही है। अच्छा सा ही है।
respondents.quote_english: The government is running well. It's good.

respondents.key_reason: Believes BJP is leading despite a triangular contest. Dismisses Prashant Kishor's influence and sees no connection between student protests and the election.
respondents.quote_original: इस बार का चुनाव तो त्रिकोणी है भले ही मगर फिर भी भाजपा का लक्ष्य आगे है।
respondents.quote_english: This election is triangular, but BJP still has the lead.

respondents.key_reason: Strong belief in BJP's dominance, citing local support for Nitin Naveen. Dismisses the impact of national student protests on local elections, viewing it as a national issue.
respondents.quote_original: माहौल पूरा भाजपामय है।
respondents.quote_english: The atmosphere is completely BJP-dominated.

respondents.key_reason: Acknowledges a significant change in atmosphere due to student protests and the education minister's resignation. However, remains neutral on who will win, stating that the public will choose based on good work and system.
respondents.quote_original: जो अच्छा काम देगी, जो अच्छा व्यवस्था देगी सरकार उसी का बनेगा।
respondents.quote_english: The government that provides good work and good system will be formed.

respondents.key_reason: Believes the student protest has benefited the opposition and will lead to a change in government this time.
respondents.quote_original: फायदा तो हुआ है। फायदा हुआ है। क्योंकि इस बार चेंज होंगे सरकार। चेंज होंगे। हमको ऐसा लग रहा है।
respondents.quote_english: It has benefited. It has benefited. Because this time the government will change. It will change. I feel so.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, Student, also works, not a Bankipur voter

respondents.key_reason: Describes the student protest as creating a 'dangerous' and 'riot-like' atmosphere, which has significantly changed the mood in Bankipur.
respondents.quote_original: इस बार का माहौल तो और खतरनाक है।
respondents.quote_english: This time the atmosphere is even more dangerous.

respondents.key_reason: Believes the atmosphere has changed significantly since the student protest. While BJP works, their mistakes have created an opportunity for change this time.
respondents.quote_original: माहौल चेंज है। माहौल चेंज है। जब से एजेंसी का प्रोटेस्ट हुआ है तब से माहौल चेंज है।
respondents.quote_english: The atmosphere has changed. The atmosphere has changed. Ever since the agency's protest, the atmosphere has changed.

respondents.key_reason: Praises Modi's handling of the student protest, viewing it as a guardian's act that boosted morale. Believes the triangular contest has increased public awareness and that Bankipur's atmosphere is good.
respondents.quote_original: मोदी जी ने जो एक के कहा जाता है ना कि एक गार्डियन होता है और आप हम लोग हर दिन प्रत्येक दिन अपने बच्चों के पीछे नीचे घुझुकते हैं और एक वो गार्डियन थे उन्होंने झुका और बच्चों के प्रति झुकना कोई बहुत बड़ा इशू नहीं है।
respondents.quote_english: Modi ji, who is called a guardian, just like we all bend for our children every day, he, as a guardian, bent. Bending for children is not a big issue.

analysis.overall_video_summary: This video captures diverse public opinions in Bankipur regarding the upcoming elections, heavily influenced by recent student protests. While some respondents firmly support BJP and dismiss the protest's impact on local elections, others believe the protests have significantly changed the mood, leading to a potential shift in government or increased public awareness. A triangular contest is noted, with some leaning towards Jan Suraaj or anticipating a 'change' from the incumbent.

analysis.video_title: क्या है Bankipur का मूड? Prashant Kishor निकले भांपने... Ground Report | Bankipur Byelection

respondents.key_reason: Supports the candidate due to his good character, vision for Bihar's development, focus on education, and efforts to prevent migration for jobs. Believes he is a good person and trustworthy.
respondents.quote_original: प्रत्याशी इनका व्यक्तित्व है वो बीजेपी और व्यक्तित्व इनका पहले से भी आदमी जानता है यही अच्छे आदमी है
respondents.quote_english: The candidate's personality is [good], he is from BJP, and people know his personality from before, he is a good person.

respondents.key_reason: Skeptical about the ability of any single individual, like Prashant Kishor, or an MLA to bring about significant, rapid change. Believes fundamental improvements take a long time.
respondents.quote_original: इतना आप लोग कह रहे हैं कि प्रशांत किशोर आएगा सब सुधर जाएगा। ऐसी बात नहीं है। थोड़ा बहुत प्रयास जरूर कर सकते हैं।
respondents.quote_english: You all are saying that if Prashant Kishor comes, everything will be fixed. That's not the case. He can certainly make some effort.

respondents.key_reason: Deeply concerned about the deteriorating law and order situation, rising insecurity, and the prevalence of 'dry drugs' (सूखा नशा) which they link to the alcohol ban. Criticizes police inaction and the involvement of youth and women in drug activities.
respondents.quote_original: अभी फिलहाल तो यही दिक्कत है कि असुरक्षित सर असुरक्षित जी सुरक्षित नहीं है प्रशासन का कोई सहयोग नहीं है ऐसासा कांड हो रहा है मदर हो रहा है
respondents.quote_english: Right now, the main problem is insecurity, sir, insecurity. It's not safe, there's no support from the administration, incidents like murder are happening.

respondents.key_reason: Highlights widespread corruption across all government departments and criticizes poor urban planning, including the allocation of land meant for parks. Expresses frustration with the lack of comparative development in Patna compared to other major Indian cities.
respondents.quote_original: भ्रष्टाचार बहुत है सर हर डिपार्टमेंट में बहुत जबरदस्त भ्रष्टाचार
respondents.quote_english: There is a lot of corruption, sir, tremendous corruption in every department.

respondents.key_reason: Expresses strong dissatisfaction with the high cost and poor quality of education and healthcare. Criticizes exorbitant private school fees, corruption in government schools, and the ineffectiveness or cancellation of government welfare schemes like Ayushman Bharat and ration cards, leading to exploitation.
respondents.quote_original: शिक्षा स्वास्थ्य में सबसे परेशानी स्वास्थ लूट एकदम बहुत ज्यादा कुछ भी हो गया समझिए कि जमीन बेचना है बस
respondents.quote_english: The biggest problem in education and health is that healthcare is a complete rip-off; if anything happens, you might as well sell your land.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures a ground report from Bankipur, where residents express a mix of opinions and significant dissatisfaction with the current state of affairs. While one respondent shows support for a BJP-aligned candidate based on character and vision for Bihar, others are largely critical, highlighting major issues like law and order, rising drug abuse, widespread corruption, and the high cost and poor quality of education and healthcare. There's also skepticism about the ability of any single individual, like Prashant Kishor, to bring about rapid, comprehensive change.

metadata.title: Bankipur Bypoll 2026: Is Prashant Kishor Losing Ground Among Young Voters? | Capital TV
metadata.constituency_audit_reason: Video title and summary explicitly mention 'Bankipur Bypoll' and by-election context.

analysis.video_title: Bankipur Bypoll 2026: Is Prashant Kishor Losing Ground Among Young Voters? | Capital TV

respondents.key_reason: Strong belief in BJP's focus on development, nationalism, and addressing public problems. Criticizes opposition (Prashant Kishor, RJD) for lack of principles and ineffective leadership. Highlights extensive development work in Patna/Bankipur and supports the young BJP candidate.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी ऐसी पार्टी है जहां जनता के समस्या का निराकरण और विकास राष्ट्रवाद तथा विकास दो चीज इसका है और जनता के इस मूलभूत सुविधाएं को सुविधा प्रदान करना और विकास करना यही कारण है कि हम लोग बीजेपी को सपोर्ट कर रहे हैं।
respondents.quote_english: BJP is a party that resolves public problems and focuses on development and nationalism. Providing basic facilities and development to the public is why we support BJP.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Young male, BJP supporter, interviewed at Boring Road Chauraha, Bankipur.

respondents.key_reason: Believes Bankipur is a BJP stronghold and the candidate, Neeraj Kumar Sinha, will win by a huge margin. Emphasizes the strong connection of BJP leaders with the local populace and dismisses RJD's chances.
respondents.quote_original: नहीं नहीं बस बीजेपी और आरजेडी में है जिसमें भाजपा एकदम एक नंबर की पार्टी रहेगी और हमारे प्रत्याशी नीरज कुमार सिन्हा जी लगभग 1 लाख प्लस मार्जिन से जीत करके वोट 1 लाख प्लस इतना भरोसा मार्जिन मार्जिन का उससे ज्यादा ही आएगा।
respondents.quote_english: No, no, it's just between BJP and RJD, in which BJP will be the number one party and our candidate Neeraj Kumar Sinha will win by a margin of almost 1 lakh plus votes, even more than that.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, BJP supporter, interviewed at Boring Road Chauraha, Bankipur.

respondents.key_reason: While a staunch BJP supporter, he is concerned about the party's shift towards a 'dictatorship' mode in Bihar, citing specific encounters. Believes the public will not tolerate this. Acknowledges BJP's development work but feels they need a 'response' in state elections.
respondents.quote_original: एज ए युवा मैं बता रहा हूं। मैं बीजेपी का एक कट्टर समर्थक हूं अभी तक। लेकिन एक होता है लीडरशिप, एक होता है डिटक्टरशिप। अभी बिहार में बीजेपी का मोड डिटक्टरशिप की तरफ चला गया है। लीडरशिप कन्वर्ट हो रहा है।
respondents.quote_english: As a youth, I'm telling you. I am a staunch supporter of BJP until now. But there is leadership, and there is dictatorship. Currently, BJP's mode in Bihar has shifted towards dictatorship. Leadership is converting.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Young male, self-identified as a staunch BJP supporter but currently hesitant for state elections, interviewed at Boring Road Chauraha, Bankipur.

respondents.key_reason: Expresses satisfaction with the peace and business environment under the NDA government (Modi and Nitish Kumar). Believes there is no ground-level dissatisfaction. Sees the main contest between BJP and RJD, dismissing Prashant Kishor as irrelevant and a mere 'agent' seeking media coverage. Highlights the local connection and leadership of Nitin Naveen.
respondents.quote_original: ग्राउंड लेवल पर कहीं नाराजगी नहीं है आम जनता जितना सुकून एनडीए नरेंद्र मोदी जी और यहां पे नीतीश कुमार जी के सरकार में जितनी सुकून से यहां के आम जनता रही है और जितने भी व्यवसाय करने वाले लोग हैं। जितने अमन चैन से यहां पे व्यवसाय कर रहे हैं।
respondents.quote_english: There is no dissatisfaction at the ground level. The common public and business people have lived and conducted business with great peace and comfort under the NDA government of Narendra Modi ji and Nitish Kumar ji.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, supporter of NDA/BJP, interviewed at Boring Road Chauraha, Bankipur.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures public sentiment at Boring Road Chauraha in Bankipur regarding the upcoming by-election. The majority of respondents express strong support for the BJP, citing development, nationalism, and stable governance under the NDA. While one respondent, a self-proclaimed staunch BJP supporter, voiced concerns about the party's 'dictatorship' mode in Bihar, the overall mood indicates a clear preference for BJP, with many dismissing opposition parties, particularly Prashant Kishor, as lacking credibility or being mere 'agents'. The main contest is perceived to be between BJP and RJD, with BJP expected to win comfortably.
