metadata.constituency_audit_reason: Video title and summary explicitly mention 'Bankipur' and 'by-election'.

analysis.video_title: बांकीपुर उपचुनाव: BJP के स्टार प्रचारकों पर फूटा लोगों का गुस्सा, छात्र आंदोलन के बाद क्या है माहौल?

respondents.key_reason: Believes BJP preserves the country's culture and civilization, works for the nation, and other parties are merely performing 'drama'. Supports Neeraj Sinha.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी अच्छी पार्टी है और हम लोग बीजेपी को ही जिताएंगे। नीरज जी को।
respondents.quote_english: BJP is a good party and we will make BJP win. Neeraj ji.

respondents.key_reason: Confident that BJP and Neeraj Kumar Sinha will win the election.
respondents.quote_original: इस समय तो भाजपा ही जीतेगी और नीरज कुमार सिन्हा।
respondents.quote_english: This time only BJP will win and Neeraj Kumar Sinha.

respondents.key_reason: Expresses deep dissatisfaction with the current government due to loss of livelihood (street vending, forced relocation to a multi-level market), and unfulfilled promises of financial aid (₹1100, ₹10000). Feels like begging.
respondents.quote_original: हम लोग का तो दुख है कि भीख मांग रहे है कटोरा लेके का... वो तो छ महीना से नहीं आ रहा है ₹100 नहीं मिल रहा है नहीं... सब कुछ फेल है आप लोग को कुछ नहीं मिल रहा है नहीं कुछ मिल रहा है नहीं कुछ मिल रहा है
respondents.quote_english: Our sorrow is that we are begging with a bowl... It hasn't been coming for six months, not even ₹100 is received... Everything is a failure, we are not getting anything, nothing at all.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Elderly woman, street vendor/shopkeeper, long-time resident ('bachpan se hi dukaan').

respondents.key_reason: Believes voting is a secret, refuses to disclose his preference, and sees the election as a tough fight between candidates, not based on caste.
respondents.quote_original: कोई नहीं बोल सकता किसको क्या देगा अपना गुप्त है। ... इस बार कुछ कहा नहीं जा सकता। अभी कुछ नहीं कहा जा सकता। मुकाबला टक्कर का है।
respondents.quote_english: No one can say who they will vote for, it's secret. ... Nothing can be said this time. Nothing can be said right now. It's a tough fight.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, adult, shopkeeper (57 years at the shop), named Pawan Sahu.

respondents.key_reason: Wants to support a new candidate (Prashant Kishor) who is doing good work, after initial hesitation due to fear of public backlash.
respondents.quote_original: जो सामने है उसको जिताएंगे नया कैंडिडेट को। नया कैंडिडेट को मतलब प्रशांत किशोर को। बस बस।
respondents.quote_english: We will make the one who is in front win, the new candidate. The new candidate means Prashant Kishor. That's it.

respondents.key_reason: Believes BJP is ahead in the election and that Prashant Kishor has no chance of winning.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी आगे है। ना प्रकाश कोई चांस नहीं है उनका। नो चांस कोई चांस नहीं है।
respondents.quote_english: BJP is ahead. No, Prakash (Prashant Kishor) has no chance. No chance at all.

respondents.key_reason: Desires change and believes BJP is 'scared' due to deploying many campaigners. Criticizes BJP for not speaking up for student issues and wants a strong opposition voice for the common public.
respondents.quote_original: लोग चाहता है कि बदली हो चेंज हो। ... डरे गई तो अभी नहीं उतारे। अगर बीजेपी अच्छा काम करती है तो इतना नेताओं को क्यों उतारने की जरूरत है भापुर में? ... इस बार जन स्वराज को मौका मिलना चाहिए। कोई विपक्ष में ऐसा नेता हो जो विधानसभा में जाके विपक्ष के लिए कुछ आवाज उठाए। आम पब्लिक के लिए।
respondents.quote_english: People want change. ... If they were not scared, why would they deploy so many? If BJP was doing good work, why would there be a need to deploy so many leaders in Bankipur? ... This time Jan Suraaj should get a chance. There should be an opposition leader who raises a voice for the common public in the assembly.

respondents.key_reason: Hears a lot of talk about Jan Suraaj and believes people's minds have shifted, despite BJP's traditional stronghold and strong campaigning efforts.
respondents.quote_original: हल्ला तो सुनते हैं। जन स्वराज पार्टी है। देखिए क्या होता है। ... घर तो है बाकी देखिए मन आदमी को घुमा हुआ है इस बार देखिए क्या हो रहा है।
respondents.quote_english: We hear talk. It's Jan Suraaj party. Let's see what happens. ... It is their stronghold, but people's minds have changed this time, let's see what happens.

respondents.key_reason: Believes Prashant Kishor will bring positive change and sees BJP's extensive campaigning as a sign of fear.
respondents.quote_original: आगे तो हम तो प्रशांत किशोर। ... बीजेपी डर गई है क्या? हां। क्यों प्रशांत किशोर? हम लोग तो एक चांद को देने के लिए सोच रहे हैं। लगता है कि प्रशांत किशोर कुछ बेहतर करेंगे।
respondents.quote_english: As for who is ahead, I say Prashant Kishor. ... Is BJP scared? Yes. Why Prashant Kishor? We are thinking of giving him a chance. It seems Prashant Kishor will do something better.

respondents.key_reason: Asserts that Bankipur is a BJP stronghold and the party will win easily, regardless of verbal support for other candidates. Justifies BJP's strong campaign as a national party's duty.
respondents.quote_original: ये भाजपा। भाजपा। क्यों? भाजपा का गढ़ है। गढ़ है तो गढ़ है तो जीत जाएगा। बिल्कुल। ... जब ईवीएम पे बटन जब दबेगा तो भाजपा पे आसानी से जीत जाएगी भाजपा।
respondents.quote_english: It's BJP. BJP. Why? It's BJP's stronghold. If it's a stronghold, it will win. Absolutely. ... When the button is pressed on the EVM, BJP will easily win.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, adult. Attended Maithili Thakur's event.

respondents.key_reason: Was very impressed by Maithili Thakur's program and intends to vote for the BJP (symbol 'Kamal').
respondents.quote_original: कमल झा कमल झाली उसी को देंगे उसी को देंगे ... बहुत बढ़िया लगा बहुत बढ़िया लगा उसी को वोट देंगे
respondents.quote_english: Kamal Jha, Kamal, we will vote for him. ... It felt very good, very good, we will vote for him.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, adult. Attended Maithili Thakur's event.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures diverse public sentiment in Bankipur ahead of the by-election. While some residents express firm support for BJP, citing its traditional stronghold and cultural values, a significant portion, including younger voters and those facing economic hardship, lean towards Jan Suraaj (Prashant Kishor), driven by a desire for change and dissatisfaction with the incumbent government's performance on issues like livelihood and student welfare. The extensive campaigning by BJP's star campaigners is interpreted by some as a sign of the party's apprehension.

metadata.title: Public Opinion Bankipur By-election: CM और BJP से Public की ऐसी एलर्जी कि सुनकर PM Modi भी हो जाएंगे
metadata.constituency_audit_reason: Video title and summary explicitly mention 'Bankipur By-election'.

analysis.video_title: Public Opinion Bankipur By-election: CM और BJP से Public की ऐसी एलर्जी कि सुनकर PM Modi भी हो जाएंगे

respondents.key_reason: Strongly against BJP due to Samrat Chaudhary's unsuitability for CM, his alleged criminal background, and the party's perceived betrayal of a social worker (Abhishek Banti). Believes BJP will lose significantly.
respondents.quote_original: वो मुख्यमंत्री लायक है ही नहीं जो खुद सातवीं फेल और प्लस में वो पांचप उसके ऊपर मर्डर का और क्या-क्या चीज का चार्ज है। खूब खड़े हैं। इस बार बहुत पछताएंगे। एक भी वोट नहीं जा रहा है उनको।
respondents.quote_english: He is not fit to be Chief Minister, he is only 7th pass and has five murder charges and other charges against him. They are standing strong. This time they will regret it a lot. Not a single vote is going to them.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, local resident, highly critical of Samrat Chaudhary and BJP.

respondents.key_reason: Deeply upset and 'acrimonious' over Abhishek Banti's ticket withdrawal, viewing it as a betrayal of a dedicated party worker. Also critical of Samrat Chaudhary's leadership and alleged criminal background.
respondents.quote_original: नहीं हम तो नहीं देंगे पर्सनली। दूसरी बात कि उन्होंने इतना गलत काम किया कि जो लड़का जो कार्यकर्ता बन के उनके लिए 24 घंटा अवेलेबल था पार्टी का काम करता था। पार्टी के काम के साथ-साथ इतना लोकप्रिय यह लड़का है जो कोई ऐसा मोहल्ला नहीं है जो बंटी अभिषेक को नहीं जानता है।
respondents.quote_english: Personally, I will not vote for them. Secondly, they did such a wrong thing that the boy who was available 24 hours as a worker for them, worked for the party. Besides party work, this boy is so popular that there is no locality that doesn't know Banti Abhishek.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Female, Lalita Singh, resident of a nearby locality, expresses strong anger and disappointment.

respondents.key_reason: Believes BJP made a very wrong decision by withdrawing Abhishek Banti's ticket, who they have known for 23 years as a dedicated grassroots worker. Expresses inability to vote for BJP now.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी बहुत ही गलत निर्णय ले चुके हैं। इनका ये निर्णय लगता है बहुत गलत हो चुका है। 23 वर्षों से हम लोगों ने अभिषेक जी बंटी जी को जानते हैं। हम लोगों को लगता नहीं हम लोग दे पाएंगे।
respondents.quote_english: BJP has made a very wrong decision. This decision of theirs seems to be very wrong. We have known Abhishek Banti ji for 23 years. We don't think we will be able to vote for them.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Female, older woman (referred to as 'Chaachi'), local resident.

respondents.key_reason: Strongly condemns BJP for withdrawing Banti's ticket, stating that no one will vote for BJP or Samrat Chaudhary. Believes Banti is a good person and would win if given the ticket.
respondents.quote_original: गलती किया है भाजपा। गलती किया है। हां गलती क्या है इसको इनको पिलाना चाहिए भाजपा को। कोई वोट नहीं डालेगा। सम्राट चौधरी को क्या कहेंगे उसको दे देंगे हम सब बाकी सम्राट के मोदी सरकार को नहीं देंगे नहीं देंगे तो वोट नहीं पड़ेगा बीजेपी को।
respondents.quote_english: BJP made a mistake. Yes, they made a mistake, they should make BJP drink this. No one will vote. What will we say to Samrat Chaudhary, we will give it to him, but we will not give it to Modi's government, so BJP will not get votes.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, older man (referred to as 'Baba'), resident of Sipara.

respondents.key_reason: Criticizes BJP for crushing its own symbol (lotus) by neglecting a grassroots worker like Banti and promoting candidates with 'backing' or 'criminal' connections, thus damaging its image and proving opposition claims true.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी का जो लोगो है कमल ठीक है आज उसने अपने लोगों का निंदा किया है अपने लोगों का जो उसका कमल का फूल जो उसने अपना छाप बनाया है सीधे-सीधे उसको उसने मसल दिया है।
respondents.quote_english: The BJP's logo, the lotus, today it has condemned its own people, it has directly crushed its own symbol, the lotus flower that it made its mark.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, appears to be a younger, educated man with an analytical perspective.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video reveals widespread public anger and disappointment in Bankipur, Patna, primarily directed at the BJP. The central issue is the withdrawal of Abhishek Banti's ticket, which is seen as a betrayal of a dedicated grassroots worker. Respondents also express significant dissatisfaction with Chief Minister Samrat Chaudhary's leadership, citing his alleged criminal background, poor governance, and a deteriorating law and order situation, leading many to firmly state they will not vote for BJP.

metadata.title: Bankipur By Election: बांकीपुर उपचुनाव पर सबसेदिलचस्प Public Opinion, कौन जीत रहा? | Prashant Kishor
metadata.constituency_audit_reason: Video title and summary explicitly mention 'Bankipur By Election' and 'by-election'.

analysis.video_title: Bankipur By Election: बांकीपुर उपचुनाव पर सबसेदिलचस्प Public Opinion, कौन जीत रहा? | Prashant Kishor

respondents.key_reason: Deep disillusionment with the political system due to high inflation, lack of employment opportunities, low wages, and perceived corruption, leading to a feeling of compulsion to vote without trust in any party.
respondents.quote_original: हम लोगों का तो मजबूरी बन गया है वोट देना और कोई उपाय तो है नहीं मजबूरी बना हुआ है।
respondents.quote_english: It has become our compulsion to vote, there is no other option, it's a compulsion.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Santosh Kumar, male, resident of Bankipur, previously worked in an office but lost his job.

respondents.key_reason: Strong desire for political change and belief that Jan Suraaj offers a solution to widespread unemployment and lack of development.
respondents.quote_original: जनरा से पूरा उम्मीद है। सबको उम्मीद है कि और ऐसे भी बदलाव होना बहुत जरूरी है।
respondents.quote_english: Everyone has full hope from Jan Suraaj, and change is very necessary.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, educated but unemployed, at a tea shop in Bankipur.

respondents.key_reason: Admiration for Prashant Kishor's leadership and a desire for him to win, despite acknowledging the traditional Yadav support for RJD. Expresses concern about established powers hindering his victory.
respondents.quote_original: माहौल तो प्रशासान किशोर का बहुत बढ़िया है। भगवान से दुआ करते हैं कि किसी तरह बेचारा जीत जाए।
respondents.quote_english: Prashant Kishor's atmosphere is very good. We pray to God that he somehow wins.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Yogendra Yadav, male, from Mandiri (Yadav-dominated area) in Bankipur.

respondents.key_reason: Strong support for RJD candidate Rekha Gupta, dissatisfaction with the BJP's candidate (Neeraj Sinha) whom he doesn't know, and anticipation of Tejashwi Yadav's campaigning to solidify RJD's position.
respondents.quote_original: अभी तो इधर पूरा बुंजीरी में रेखा गुप्ता का ही चल रहा है रेखा गुप्ता जी
respondents.quote_english: Right now, in this entire Bundiri area, it's all about Rekha Gupta.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Mukesh Kumar, male, from Mandiri in Bankipur.

respondents.key_reason: Strong belief in RJD's victory, rejection of BJP's past dominance, and anticipation of Tejashwi Yadav's visit to boost the party's momentum.
respondents.quote_original: एक नंबर रेखा गुप्ता रेखा गुप्ता एक नंबर पर जीत रही हैं।
respondents.quote_english: Rekha Gupta is winning at number one.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Raju Kumar, male, from Mandiri in Bankipur.

respondents.key_reason: Unwavering loyalty to the RJD ('Lalten chhap'), belief in their candidate, and a strong rejection of any attempts to buy votes or influence their decision, despite acknowledging offers from other parties.
respondents.quote_original: हम लोग ऊपर पर बिकने वाला नहीं है। नहीं है। नहीं हम लोग कट्टर आदमी हैं। एक बार कह दिया भेड़िया शान से गिरेगा। आरजेडी को ही
respondents.quote_english: We are not for sale. No, we are staunch people. Once we've said it, we will vote for RJD.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Rajendra Prasad Yadav, male, from Mandiri in Bankipur.

respondents.key_reason: Strong belief in the development work done by Nitin Naveen (BJP) in Bankipur, rejection of caste-based politics, and dismissal of Prashant Kishor's influence as mere crowd-gathering from outside.
respondents.quote_original: हम जातपात के राजनीति नहीं करते हैं और विश्वास रखते हैं काम पर और पूरा इस सब इलाका बाकी की पूर्ण जो भी विकास हुआ है माननीय राष्ट्रीय अध्यक्ष महोदय के माध्यम से जो भी मंत्रालय था इनका एकदम भलीभांति काम किए हुआ
respondents.quote_english: We don't do caste politics and we believe in work, and all the development in Bankipur has been done well through the honorable National President's ministry.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Anil Yadav, male, from Mandiri (Yadav community) in Bankipur.

respondents.key_reason: Unwavering loyalty to the BJP symbol ('Kamal chhap') and belief that any candidate fielded by the party will win due to the extensive work done by Nitin Naveen.
respondents.quote_original: हम लोग का कैंडिडेट फुल छाप है।
respondents.quote_english: Our candidate is the lotus symbol.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Bawan Kumar Sharma, male, from Bankipur, identified as a BJP 'mandal ka karyakarta' (local party worker).

respondents.key_reason: Strong conviction that BJP's dominance and development work in Bankipur will continue, ensuring their victory in the by-election.
respondents.quote_original: बांकेपुर में जो कमल था कम कमल है और कमल ही रहेगा।
respondents.quote_english: The lotus that was in Bankipur, the lotus is there and the lotus will remain.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, Bankipur voter and BJP supporter.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures diverse public opinions in Bankipur for the by-election, revealing a mix of disillusionment, strong party loyalties, and a desire for change. While some respondents express deep frustration with inflation and unemployment, leading to a neutral stance, others firmly support RJD, emphasizing party loyalty and the influence of Tejashwi Yadav. Conversely, many BJP supporters highlight the development work of Nitin Naveen and their unwavering commitment to the lotus symbol, dismissing Prashant Kishor's Jan Suraaj as having little impact.

metadata.title: Bankipur Public Opinion: Prashant Kishor जिस मोहल्ले में आए गमछा बांटकर वहां के लोगों ने क्या कहा ?
metadata.constituency_audit_reason: Video title and summary explicitly mention 'Bankipur' and 'by-election'.

analysis.video_title: Bankipur Public Opinion: Prashant Kishor जिस मोहल्ले में आए गमछा बांटकर वहां के लोगों ने क्या कहा ?

respondents.key_reason: Supports BJP due to the past work and good behavior of former MLA Nitin Navin. He has done development work in the area and is accessible to the public. Views Prashant Kishor as an outsider with no real connection to the local issues or people.
respondents.quote_original: जो यहां के रह चुके हैं नितिन नवीन जी उनका जो काम है उनका जो व्यवहार है उसके आधार पे हम लोग चलते हैं। उनका व्यवहार उनका काम यहां पे दिखने को आपको मिलेगा। आप जहां इस गली में आ रहे हैं ये जो भी निर्माण और जो भी आप देखेंगे वो सारा उन्हीं का किया हुआ है। लोगकि जो आपका सुनेगा आप उसी को वोट देंगे ना। ये हर हमेशा हम लोगों का सुनते आए हैं और हम लोगों के बीच के हैं। इसलिए हम लोग इनको वोट देते हैं।
respondents.quote_english: We vote based on the work and behavior of Nitin Navin ji, who has been here. You will see his behavior and work here. Whatever construction and development you see in this street, it's all done by him. You will vote for someone who listens to you, right? He has always listened to us and is one of us. That's why we vote for him.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, resident of Meethi Kuan locality, named Ashok Kumar Singh.

respondents.key_reason: Votes for BJP because of the work done by former MLA Nitin Navin in their locality. Believes the vote will be cast in Nitin Navin's name, and there are no other significant issues for them.
respondents.quote_original: नीति नबी ने हमारे मोहल्ले का विधायक पहले थे और उन्होंने काम किया है इसलिए हम लोग म उन्हीं के अथ से म वोट देना चाहते हैं। लेकिन नीति नवीन तो इस बार उम्मीदवार नहीं है। नीति नवीन नहीं है तो फिर अपना दूसरा कैंडिडेट दिए ना बीजेपी का तो हम लोग उन्हीं को दे रहे हैं। ये नितिन नवीन के नाम पर वोट पड़ेगा। कोई मुद्दा नहीं है।
respondents.quote_english: Nitin Navin was our locality's former MLA and he worked, so we want to vote based on his authority. But Nitin Navin is not the candidate this time. If Nitin Navin is not there, then BJP has given another candidate, so we are voting for them. The vote will be cast in Nitin Navin's name. There is no other issue.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, resident of Meethi Kuan locality, named Ajay Kumar.

respondents.key_reason: Supports BJP due to the hard work of party workers and the contributions of Nitin Navin. Believes the BJP candidate (Neeraj Sinha) will win by a large margin. Dismisses Prashant Kishor's campaign, stating he only gave scarves and lacks genuine ground support or a track record of winning.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी कार्यकर्ता लोग के मेहनत है। सफलता है। नितिन नवीन जी कर दिए हैं। राष्ट्रीय अध्यक्ष जी। सभी लोग से मिलते भी हैं। प्रशांत किशोर भी तो प्रचार कर रहे हैं। प्रचार करने दीजिए। उनसे क्या सभी लोग हम भी प्रचार कर सकते हैं तो क्या जीत जाएंगे चुनाव लड़े दावा तो यही कर जाएंगे दावा करने कोई दावा करता है लेकिन बीजेपी का दावा पक्का है बीजेपी का दावा एकदम बहुत पक्का है क्या लग रहा है कितना वोट से जीतेगी बीजेपी इस बार कम से कम 500 प्लस 500 प्लस प्लस प्रशांत किशोर वोट नहीं लाएंगे हम उनको वोट नहीं आएगा आएगा जो किस्मत में होगा लेके आएंगे लेकिन जो जमीनी है वो नितिन नवीन का ये पूछते है बाकीपुर विधानसभा पूछते है हां उनके फादर भी थे नवीन किशोर सिन्हा 15 साल वो रहे 25 साल ये रहे फिर नीरज कुमार सिन्हा ही फुल बहुमत से यहां आएंगे बाकी विधानसभा में जो प्रशांत दावा कर रहे कि हम तो चुनाव हरा देंगे कहीं तो नहीं भैया 500 500 हमको दीजिएगा तो हम ना बोलेंगे प्रशांत किशोर जिंदाबाद अच्छा हम ही लोग बोलेंगे भैया ऐसा थोड़ी है हमको नहीं मिला हम लोग हम लोग पैसा के नहीं है हम लोग बस पैसा नहीं हम लोग पैसा के पीछे नहीं भागते हैं हम लोग अच्छा आपके मोहल्ले में प्रशांत किशोर प्रचार करने आए कि नहीं आए आए थे क्या वादा करके गए क्या बोले आप लोग क्या क्या देंगे गमछ दे गमछी देके गए हैं गमछ देके गए गमछी है पीला गमछ मिलाची देखेगा पसीना पोछने के लिए गर्मी में गर्मी में पसीना पोछने के लिए बोले क्या बोले कि हमको दीजिए हम हां मिलेगा लेकिन किसको वोट देंगे हम बस नीरज कुमार सिन्हा हम चीज पीला ले लिए नेता बीजेपी में आए हैं सर बीजेपी में हां उस कोई दिक्कत नहीं है
respondents.quote_english: It's due to the hard work and success of BJP workers. Nitin Navin ji has done work. The national president also meets everyone. Prashant Kishor is also campaigning, let him. Anyone can campaign, does that mean they will win? BJP's claim is very strong. BJP will win by at least 500+ votes. Prashant Kishor won't get votes. The ground reality is that people ask for Nitin Navin. His father, Navin Kishor Sinha, was here for 15 years, and he (Nitin Navin) for 25 years. Neeraj Kumar Sinha will win with a full majority in Bankipur. Prashant Kishor claims he will defeat us, but no. He came to our locality, gave yellow scarves, saying 'give me your vote'. We took the scarf, but we will vote for Neeraj Kumar Sinha.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, resident of Meethi Kuan locality, named W. Paswan.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures public opinion in the Meethi Kuan locality of Bankipur regarding the upcoming by-election. All interviewed respondents express strong and firm support for the BJP, primarily citing the past development work and accessibility of former MLA Nitin Navin as their main reasons. They largely dismiss Prashant Kishor's campaign, viewing him as an outsider who lacks genuine ground connect and has not delivered on promises, despite his recent visits. The prevailing sentiment is firmly in favor of the BJP candidate, Neeraj Sinha, as a continuation of Nitin Navin's legacy.

metadata.title: Bankipur By Election 2026 Public Opinion : प्रशांत किशोर पर बांकीपुर के वोटर का मूड क्या है?
metadata.constituency_audit_reason: Video title and summary explicitly mention 'Bankipur By Election'.

analysis.video_title: Bankipur By Election 2026 Public Opinion : प्रशांत किशोर पर बांकीपुर के वोटर का मूड क्या है?

respondents.key_reason: BJP will win with a huge majority; Prashant Kishor's claims are baseless and he poses no challenge.
respondents.quote_original: भाजपा एकदम भारी बहुमत से... इस बार कुछ कोई चुनौती नहीं है। कोई चुनौती नहीं।
respondents.quote_english: BJP will win with a huge majority... This time there is no challenge, no challenge at all.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Morning walker at Children's Park, Patna.

respondents.key_reason: BJP will win and break previous records; Prashant Kishor is a businessman whose claims are irrelevant.
respondents.quote_original: बाकी पूर्व चुनाव में भाजपा जीतेगी। पिछला बार का रिकॉर्ड भी टूटेगा। प्रशांत किशोर तो दावा कर रहे हैं। घर में हरा उनको दावा करने से कुछ नहीं होगा। वो तो वो धंधा वाला आदमी है।
respondents.quote_english: BJP will win in the Bankipur by-election. The previous record will also be broken. Prashant Kishor is making claims. He won't achieve anything by making claims from home. He is a businessman.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Morning walker at Children's Park, Patna.

respondents.key_reason: BJP will achieve a historic victory as it resides in the hearts of the people and is trusted; opponents are 'fraudsters' and pose no challenge.
respondents.quote_original: बांकीपुर उपचुनाव में ऐतिहासिक प्रचंड विजय होने वाला है। यहां पर फरौडों का सूफड़ा साफ होने वाला है। भारतीय जनता पार्टी आज जन-जन के दिलों में बसा हुआ है।
respondents.quote_english: In the Bankipur by-election, there will be a historic massive victory. The fraudsters will be wiped out here. The Bharatiya Janata Party is now settled in the hearts of every person.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Morning walker at Children's Park, Patna.

respondents.key_reason: BJP candidate will win due to visible development over the past 40 years in Patna and Bihar, and Nitin Navin's strong performance; Prashant Kishor's theoretical talks are not practical.
respondents.quote_original: बांकीपुर में भारतीय जनता पार्टी का उम्मीदवार जीतेगा। भारी बहुमत से जीतेगा। जो दिखलाई पड़ रहा है विकास वगैरह और हम लोग देखे हैं करीब हमारा 40 साल से हो रहा है पटना पहचान में नहीं आता है।
respondents.quote_english: The Bharatiya Janata Party candidate will win in Bankipur. Will win with a huge majority. The development that is visible, and we have seen for about 40 years, Patna is unrecognizable.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, claims to have seen Patna change over 40 years, morning walker at Children's Park, Patna.

respondents.key_reason: Voters are thoughtful and some have decided, but they will not reveal their choice as it is a secret ballot.
respondents.quote_original: बाकीपुर उपचुनाव में जो जनता हैं वो काफी सजग हैं यहां की जनता और सोच रहे हैं कि इनको वोट दें और कुछ के दिमाग में बैठा हुआ है कि हम इन्हीं को वोट देंगे। तो इसलिए आपको जो पूछना होगा तो कोई बताएंगे नहीं। हां क्योंकि यह गुप्त चुनाव है।
respondents.quote_english: In the Bankipur by-election, the public here is very aware and thinking about whom to vote for, and some have decided that they will vote for a particular person. So, if you ask, no one will tell you. Yes, because it is a secret election.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Morning walker at Children's Park, Patna.

respondents.key_reason: A long-time BJP supporter, believes Prashant Kishor will only cut a small number of BJP votes and won't be a significant challenge; the vote is for Nitin Navin and Narendra Modi.
respondents.quote_original: यहां हम तो सुर से बीजेपी को वोट देते आए हैं। प्रशांत किशोर थोड़ा वोट बीजेपी के काटेंगे लेकिन जमानत बचा जमानत बचा ले। यही बहुत है। ... नितिन मेन है नरेंद्र मोदी जी के नाम पर नरेंद्र मोदी हां
respondents.quote_english: Here, I have always voted for BJP. Prashant Kishor will cut some BJP votes, but saving his deposit will be a big achievement for him. ... The main thing is Nitin Navin, in the name of Narendra Modi, Narendra Modi, yes.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Long-time voter, morning walker at Children's Park, Patna.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures public opinion in Patna's Children's Park regarding the Bankipur by-election. The overwhelming sentiment among the interviewed morning walkers is strong support for the BJP, with many confidently predicting a massive victory for the party and its candidate, Nitin Navin. Respondents largely dismiss Prashant Kishor's candidacy, viewing him as a businessman and not a serious challenger, while highlighting BJP's development work and the popularity of Narendra Modi. One respondent chose to remain neutral, citing the secrecy of the ballot.

metadata.title: Bankipur Bypoll से पहले जनता में नाराजगी, फिर भी इन्हें मिलेगा जमकर Vote ? | Bankipur Public Opinion
metadata.constituency_audit_reason: Video title and summary explicitly mention 'Bankipur Bypoll' and 'Bankipur Public Opinion' in election context.

analysis.video_title: Bankipur Bypoll से पहले जनता में नाराजगी, फिर भी इन्हें मिलेगा जमकर Vote ? | Bankipur Public Opinion

respondents.key_reason: Dissatisfaction with BJP's lack of work and perceived corruption, disappointment with the current Chief Minister, and a belief that Jan Suraaj will not engage in theft. Previously voted RJD but found it useless.
respondents.quote_original: बस चोरी नहीं करेगा। सब क्लियर है जन स्वराज।
respondents.quote_english: They won't steal. Jan Suraaj is clear.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Local resident, previously voted RJD, then JDU-BJP alliance.

respondents.key_reason: Strong belief that BJP candidate Neeraj Kumar will win and is the only serious contender. Expresses long-standing, confirmed support for BJP.
respondents.quote_original: नीरज कुमार ही रेस में है। जी जाएंगे। हां हां कंफर्म। बीजेपी को?
respondents.quote_english: Neeraj Kumar is in the race. He will win. Yes, confirmed. BJP?

respondents.key_reason: Believes BJP has a chance and states his long-standing support for BJP in the area, while acknowledging that some voters are talking about Jan Suraaj.
respondents.quote_original: भाजपा का चांस है हां लेकिन बहुत जगह तो वोटर्स जो कह रहे हैं वो तो जन स्वराज में इस बांकेपुर में इनका अच्छा शुरू से हम इस एरिया में जो है गर्दनी बाग वाले में शुरू से ही रहा है इनका जो है शुरू से बीजेपी के ही हैं
respondents.quote_english: BJP has a chance, yes, but many voters are saying Jan Suraaj in Bankipur. But we have been with BJP from the beginning in this Gardanibagh area.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, 65 years old, named Ramanuj Singh.

respondents.key_reason: Praises the significant development work, specifically the beautification of Kachhi Talab, done by the current BJP MLA Nitin Naveen. Highlights improved law and order and dismisses Prashant Kishor as a non-serious businessman.
respondents.quote_original: काम पर वोट देते हैं। आप ये कच्ची तालाब को देख लीजिए। दृश्य आज से 20 साल पहले आते तो ऐसा दृश्य देखने को नहीं मिलता। ... ये बांकेपुर के विधायक जी का देन है नितिन नवीन जी का ये देख लीजिए सौंदरिककरण और कितना सुंदर बने आप छठ में जब आएंगे ना तो ये पटना का नाक है इतना सुंदर छठ यहां होता है
respondents.quote_english: We vote on work. Look at this Kachhi Talab. If you came 20 years ago, you wouldn't see such a sight. ... This is the gift of Bankipur's MLA Nitin Naveen. Look at the beautification, how beautiful it has become. When you come during Chhath, this is the pride of Patna, such a beautiful Chhath happens here.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, named Anand Kumar Sinha, resident of Dhakanpura.

respondents.key_reason: Complete dissatisfaction with BJP's lack of development work in his specific ward/area despite the party holding the seat for 40 years. Feels neglected by the current MLA.
respondents.quote_original: नहीं नहीं बीजेपी को ही हम लोग वोट देते थे। ठीक है। लेकिन ये लोग कुछ काम नहीं कर रहे हैं। 40 बरस हो गया इस सीट पे। अभी तक कुछ वैसा ये तो कंफर्म सीट मान बन जाती है बांकीपुर। ... नाराजगी पूरा है। हम लोग बीजेपी को वोट देते आए हैं। लेकिन आज तक कुछ हुआ नहीं ऐसा काम
respondents.quote_english: No, no, we used to vote for BJP. Okay. But these people are not doing any work. It's been 40 years on this seat. Nothing significant has happened. Bankipur is considered a confirmed BJP seat... But this time it won't be. There is complete dissatisfaction. We have been voting for BJP, but no such work has happened till date.

respondents.key_reason: Frustration with BJP due to issues like education, exam irregularities, and poor infrastructure management where roads are built and then immediately dug up.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी से अब हताश हो चुका है आदमी क्यों क्योंकि सब चीज का शिक्षा है फिर परीक्षा में धांधली है सब कुछ सब नाराज हो चुका है हां यहां के गली व्यवस्था बनता है रोड फिर से तोड़ देना है
respondents.quote_english: People are now frustrated with BJP because of issues like education, exam irregularities, everything. Everyone is upset. Here, roads are built and then dug up again.

respondents.key_reason: Desire for change after 40 years of BJP rule without significant progress. Expresses strong dissatisfaction with the current Chief Minister and the rise in crime (murders, rapes, encounters) in recent months.
respondents.quote_original: कहने के लिए तो ठीक है। बीजेपी का कंफर्म सीट है। लेकिन ऐसा कहां लिखा हुआ है कि बदलाव नहीं हो सकता है। ये तो कहीं नहीं लिखा हुआ है। तो इस बार बस बदलाव की लहर है और बदलाव होगी। और उम्मीद है कि इस बार बदल करके हमारे जो नए लीडर होंगे बांकेपुर विधानसभा से प्रशांत किशोर जी होंगे
respondents.quote_english: It's fine to say it's a confirmed BJP seat. But where is it written that change cannot happen? It's not written anywhere. So this time, there is a wave of change, and change will happen. And we hope that this time, our new leader from Bankipur assembly will be Prashant Kishor ji.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, youth, named Alok, previously voted BJP.

respondents.key_reason: Dissatisfaction with BJP's performance, citing issues like paper leaks and murders. Feels that the work being done is ineffective or failing, leading him to switch from being a long-time BJP supporter.
respondents.quote_original: पहले हम लोग वोट बीजेपी को करते थे। ... बाकी इस बार हम लोग सोच रहे हैं कि बदलने के लिए। इसलिए कि इस बार कोई काम नहीं हो रहा है। जो भी काम हो रहा है नाकाम हो रहा है। जैसे पेपर लीक होना, मर्डर होना
respondents.quote_english: Earlier we used to vote for BJP. ... But this time we are thinking of changing. Because no work is happening this time. Whatever work is happening is failing. Like paper leaks, murders.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, named Vijay Kumar, identifies as a former BJP worker.

respondents.key_reason: Previously voted for RJD but felt it was a wasted vote. Now supports Jan Suraaj with the belief that they will not engage in corruption.
respondents.quote_original: जन स्वराज के पहले आरजेडी के देते थे तो बेकार भर जाता था। ऐसा बेकार करके इधर ही दे रहे हैं। बस चोरी नहीं करेगा तो क्लियर है जन स्वराज।
respondents.quote_english: Before Jan Suraaj, we used to vote for RJD, but it was useless. So, we are giving it here. They won't steal, so Jan Suraaj is clear.

respondents.key_reason: Desire for change and personal preference. Despite wearing a tilak, he clarifies he has never voted for BJP, always for RJD, but is now switching to Jan Suraaj for change.
respondents.quote_original: हम बीजेपी को आज तक वोट नहीं दिए हुए हैं। अब तक किसको देते थे? हम आरजेडी को देते थे। इस बार इस बार अभी जन सुराग को देंगे। जन सुरा को देंगे। एकदम क्लियर है। ... हम लोग को बदलाव चाहिए। बदलाव करने जा रहे हैं।
respondents.quote_english: I have never voted for BJP till date. Who did I vote for until now? I used to vote for RJD. This time, this time we will give it to Jan Suraaj. Will give it to Jan Suraaj. It's absolutely clear. ... We want change. We are going for change.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, older (referred to as 'Uncle'), wears a tilak, previously voted RJD.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures public opinion in Bankipur ahead of a by-election, revealing a mixed but significant sentiment of dissatisfaction with the incumbent BJP, despite it being considered a 'confirmed seat'. While some residents express firm loyalty to BJP due to perceived development and improved law and order, a substantial number, including former BJP and RJD voters, are leaning towards or firmly supporting Jan Suraaj, citing issues like lack of local development, corruption, exam irregularities, and a desire for change. The prevailing mood indicates a strong undercurrent of anti-incumbency and a demand for new leadership.

analysis.video_title: Bankipur Bypoll Public Opinion : जनता का मूड साफ! क्या ढहेगा BJP का किला या PK पड़ेंगे भारी ?

respondents.key_reason: Praises BJP and JDU for significant development work, especially the JP Ganga Path, and general peace. Believes those who work for Bihar's development should be praised.
respondents.quote_original: अरे जो बिहार के विकास के काम कर रहा है उसको ना तारीफ करना चाहिए बिल्कुल
respondents.quote_english: One should definitely praise those who are working for the development of Bihar.

respondents.key_reason: Hears a lot about Prashant Kishor's (PK) growing influence and popularity. Emphasizes voter independence.
respondents.quote_original: तब यहां स्वराज जनशक्ति पीके के ज्यादा अभी सुन रहे हैं बोलबाला। हां प्रशांत किशोर हां हां उसी के बोलबाला ज्यादा सुन रहे हैं।
respondents.quote_english: We are hearing more about Jan Suraaj, PK's influence is more. Yes, Prashant Kishor, yes, we are hearing more about his influence.

respondents.key_reason: Dissatisfaction with government officials' work, poor drainage, dilapidated government buildings, and a strong desire for change. Believes the BJP candidate has low chances.
respondents.quote_original: बाकीपुर में तो देखिए इस बार तो मेरे ख्याल से नीरज सिन्हा का कम चांसेस है। हम दूसरे को मौका देना चाहिए। बिल्कुल बिल्कुल बदलाव तो जरूरी है।
respondents.quote_english: In Bankipur, I think Neeraj Sinha has less chance this time. We should give a chance to others. Change is absolutely necessary.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Young male, lawyer, previously worked with JDU

respondents.key_reason: Predicts RJD will win because the votes will be split between Prashant Kishor's Jan Suraaj and BJP.
respondents.quote_original: पीके और प्रशांत किशोर और बीजेपी आपस में लड़ेंगे और आरजेडी निकल आरजेडी निकल जाएगा।
respondents.quote_english: PK and Prashant Kishor and BJP will fight among themselves, and RJD will emerge victorious.

respondents.key_reason: Strong desire for government change, blames BJP for high inflation and the suffering of the poor. Believes a change in government will bring relief and a good feeling, even if inflation doesn't immediately decrease.
respondents.quote_original: अभी सरकार बदलना चाहिए। एक तो खाते-खाते मरे, एक भूखे मरे नहीं सरकार बदलना चाहिए। ... महंगाई कम हुए चाहे नहीं हुए मगर एक राहत मिलेगा। एक अच्छा लगेगा कि हां सरकार चेंज हुआ।
respondents.quote_english: The government should change now. Some are dying from overeating, some from hunger, no, the government should change. ... Whether inflation decreases or not, there will be a relief. It will feel good that the government has changed.

respondents.key_reason: Believes in voting for a good leader with strong public momentum ('lehar'). Expresses that the decision will be made on voting day.
respondents.quote_original: हम लोग किसको चाहेंगे हम लोग के चढ़ाएंगे जो अच्छा नेता है जिसका लहर ज्यादा रहेगा उसको वोट दबल जाएगा बीजेपी राजा जनसुरा कौन अब देख लीजिए श में ऐसे तो माने के लहर प्रसाद जन स्वराज और बीजेपी क्या है हम अब यही दुनिया में से कोई आदमी निकसेंगे हम
respondents.quote_english: Who will we choose? We will support the good leader who has more momentum. BJP, RJD, Jan Suraaj, who? Now let's see, among these, Jan Suraaj and BJP have a wave. Someone from these will emerge.

respondents.key_reason: Holds a pragmatic view that inflation won't significantly change regardless of which party is in power, and people have to earn their living. Believes that change is necessary every five years for any government.
respondents.quote_original: कोई के सरकार आएगा तो महंगाई का जगह थोड़ी नहीं खाने के लिए थोड़ी दे देगा। कोई का सरकार आएगा महंगा जो है से महंगा नहीं बिगड़ेगा। हम लोग को कमाना है। खाना नहीं कमाएंगे तो नहीं खाएंगे। ... बदलाव तो होना जरूरी है। बदलाव जरूरी है। 5 साल पर चाहे किसी का सरकार हो।
respondents.quote_english: No government will reduce inflation or give food for free. Inflation won't decrease with any government. We have to earn, if we don't earn, we won't eat. ... Change is necessary. Change is necessary every 5 years, no matter whose government it is.

respondents.key_reason: Acknowledges that the previous BJP MLA (Nitin Navin) had done some work, but is unwilling to explicitly state a preference for BJP or any other party, remaining neutral.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी काम कर रही है। हां एकदम कोई बदलाव की जरूरत नहीं है। बदलाओगे क्या? है ना? नितिन नवीन काम किए थे। ... हम भी नहीं बता सकते हैं। आप लोग चाह किसको? हम नहीं बता सकते हैं।
respondents.quote_english: BJP is working. Yes, there's no need for change. Why change? Nitin Navin had worked. ... I can't say. Who do you want? I can't say.

respondents.key_reason: Expresses strong dissatisfaction, stating that no development work has been done in Bankipur.
respondents.quote_original: बाकीपुर में क्या काम हुआ? कुछ नहीं। कुछ नहीं हुआ। क्या काम हुआ?
respondents.quote_english: What work happened in Bankipur? Nothing. Nothing happened. What work happened?

respondents.key_reason: Firmly believes that BJP will come to power again.
respondents.quote_original: हां हम लोग चाह रहे हैं बीजेपी फिर से ना होगा बीजेपी ही आएगा आई प्रशांत की सोच देखिए
respondents.quote_english: Yes, we want BJP again, BJP will come. Look at Prashant Kishor's thinking.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures diverse public opinions in Bankipur regarding the upcoming by-election. While some respondents firmly support BJP, citing development work and peace, others express strong anti-incumbency sentiments due to inflation, lack of development in certain areas, and a desire for change. Prashant Kishor's Jan Suraaj and RJD are also mentioned as potential contenders, with some predicting an RJD victory due to a vote split.

metadata.title: Bankipur में Pawan Singh के चुनाव प्रचार पर बोले युवा, पूछने लगे सवाल
metadata.constituency_audit_reason: Video title and summary explicitly mention 'Bankipur' and 'election campaign'.

analysis.video_title: Bankipur में Pawan Singh के चुनाव प्रचार पर बोले युवा, पूछने लगे सवाल

respondents.key_reason: Critical of Pawan Singh due to his criminal cases, questioning his suitability as a leader.
respondents.quote_original: Pawan Singh par kitna case hua hai pata hai na? 376 hua hai. Aur 376 ke case hua hai unko bol rahe hain neta.
respondents.quote_english: You know how many cases Pawan Singh has? He has 376. And with a 376 case, you're calling him a leader.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, likely a local resident, critical of Pawan Singh.

respondents.key_reason: Supports the candidate who will win (implicitly Pawan Singh as the alternative) and criticizes the incumbent MLA for lack of development over 20-25 years.
respondents.quote_original: Ikuwahi jitega. Kya Bankipur mein jeet ke kya kiya hai? Sirf 20 saal se 25 saal se kuch nahi kare.
respondents.quote_english: He will win. What has he done after winning in Bankipur? He has done nothing for 20-25 years.

respondents.key_reason: As a BJP Yuva Morcha member, he believes the atmosphere is strongly in favor of BJP due to their star campaigners and organization, dismissing Prashant Kishor as a 'fraud'.
respondents.quote_original: Prashant Kishor fraud Kishor hai. Mahol pura ban gaya hai. Hum log ke paas star pracharak hain, sangathan hai. Mahol hum log na banayenge.
respondents.quote_english: Prashant Kishor is a fraud. The atmosphere is completely set. We have star campaigners, organization. We will create the atmosphere.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, identified as a member of BJP Yuva Morcha.

respondents.key_reason: People came to see Pawan Singh because he is a superstar and a good artist, not for political reasons or support for any party.
respondents.quote_original: Pawan Singh ek superstar hai, achhe kalakar hain, isiliye log dekhne aaye the. Bas aur koi baat nahi. BJP UJP ye koi matlab nahi hai.
respondents.quote_english: Pawan Singh is a superstar, a good artist, that's why people came to see him. That's all, no other reason. BJP, UJP, none of that matters.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, local resident, observing the crowd.

respondents.key_reason: Strong belief that Prashant Kishor will win, indicating support for Jan Suraaj.
respondents.quote_original: Prashant Kishor jeetega aur jeetega hi. Jan Suraaj.
respondents.quote_english: Prashant Kishor will win and will definitely win. Jan Suraaj.

respondents.key_reason: Dismissive of Pawan Singh's political impact, stating that his visit will not bring any benefit or change.
respondents.quote_original: Pawan Singh ke aane se koi fayda hoga? Nahi, kuch nahi. Aaye chale gaye, kya fayda?
respondents.quote_english: Will there be any benefit from Pawan Singh's arrival? No, nothing. He came and left, what's the benefit?

respondents.key_reason: Critical of the current NDA government and Nitish Kumar for the poor condition of roads.
respondents.quote_original: Ye road ka hal kya hai NDA sarkar mein? Nitish Kumar ye road ka hal kya hai?
respondents.quote_english: What is the condition of this road under the NDA government? Nitish Kumar, what is the condition of this road?

respondents.key_reason: Believes the public chose Nitish Kumar and supports the current government led by Modi and Nitish.
respondents.quote_original: Modi aur Nitish ji ke hit mein. Janta kisko chuna tha? Nitish Kumar ko. Sarkar hai kiska?
respondents.quote_english: In favor of Modi and Nitish ji. Who did the public choose? Nitish Kumar. Whose government is it?

respondents.key_reason: Negative view of Samrat Chaudhary, calling him a 'goon'.
respondents.quote_original: Samrat Chaudhary kaun hai? Gunda.
respondents.quote_english: Who is Samrat Chaudhary? A goon.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures a diverse range of public opinions in Bankipur regarding Pawan Singh's political campaign. While some residents view him primarily as an entertainer and doubt his political efficacy, others are critical of his past legal issues or the long-standing lack of development by the incumbent. There is notable support for Prashant Kishor's Jan Suraaj, alongside expressions of loyalty to the BJP/NDA, with discussions frequently revolving around issues of development, infrastructure, and political leadership.

metadata.title: Bankipur By Election : क्या बांकीपुर में पलट जाएगी चुनावी बाजी? | Prashant Kishor | Bihar News
metadata.constituency_audit_reason: Video title and summary explicitly mention 'Bankipur By Election' and 'Bankipur assembly constituency'.

analysis.video_title: Bankipur By Election : क्या बांकीपुर में पलट जाएगी चुनावी बाजी? | Prashant Kishor | Bihar News

respondents.key_reason: Dissatisfaction with the previous BJP MLA's lack of work and strong support for the issues raised by Prashant Kishor, whom they believe is addressing serious concerns.
respondents.quote_original: ये हमारे जो पूर्व विधायक थे जो भाजपा की सरकार थी अभी तक जो इन्होंने यहां कोई काम हमारे लिए नहीं किया। और जो मुद्दे उन्होंने उठाया है वो मुद्दा काफी गंभीर है हम लोग के लिए।
respondents.quote_english: The former MLA, who was from the BJP government, did no work for us here. And the issues he has raised are very serious for us.

respondents.key_reason: Dissatisfaction with the BJP government's lack of progress and a strong desire for change, specifically to replace the current MLA.
respondents.quote_original: भाजपा में इतना सारा सरकार रहा उसमें हम लोग का कोई मैंने अच्छा प्रोसेस नहीं हुआ। इसलिए हम लोग सरकार को चेंज सोचते हैं करने के लिए। विधायक को एकदम बदल देना है।
respondents.quote_english: The BJP government has been in power for so long, but we didn't see any good progress. That's why we are thinking of changing the government. The MLA must definitely be changed.

respondents.key_reason: Belief that Prashant Kishor is the only one who talks about changing the system, raising education standards, and addressing public issues, unlike the incumbent BJP MLA who is perceived as absent and out of touch. He also mentions facing pressure for his support but remains firm.
respondents.quote_original: जो व्यवस्था बदलने की बातें करता है, जो राजनीति में शिक्षा का स्तर को ऊंचा करने की बातें करता है, ऐसा बात करने वाला कोई व्यक्ति आज तक नहीं आया। 40 साल में एक भी दिन ऐसा नहीं हुआ कि नितिन नवीन ने देखने आए हो किसी को मिलने आए हो। उस तरीके की परेशानी झेलते हुए भी हम प्रशांत किशोर को सपोर्ट कर रहे हैं।
respondents.quote_english: The one who talks about changing the system, who talks about raising the standard of education in politics, no such person has come till date. In 40 years, not a single day has Nitin Navin come to see anyone or meet anyone. Even enduring such troubles, we are supporting Prashant Kishor.

respondents.key_reason: Dissatisfaction with the lack of work and development by the current government, and a strong belief that Prashant Kishor will bring about necessary changes and represent their voice.
respondents.quote_original: माहौल तो है प्रशांत जी को जिताना है इस बार पूरा। बहुत काम देख रहे हैं ना कुछ काम हो नहीं रहा है। अब काम को कुछ करना है प्रशांत जी खड़े हुए हैं अपना।
respondents.quote_english: The atmosphere is there, Prashant ji has to win this time completely. We see a lot of work, but nothing is happening. Now something needs to be done about work, Prashant ji has stood up.

respondents.key_reason: Based on the general atmosphere and discussions, he feels that Jan Suraaj (Prashant Kishor) has the upper hand and expresses hope for his victory, though he cannot definitively predict the final outcome.
respondents.quote_original: पलड़ा तो लग रहा है कि जनसुराज का है। उम्मीद तो लग रहा है। अब रिजल्ट कैसे फाइनल हम बता सकते हैं।
respondents.quote_english: It seems the balance is in favor of Jan Suraaj. It seems hopeful. Now how can we tell the final result.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, Village voter (not from Bankipur urban area).

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures the public mood in the Bankipur assembly constituency, a traditional BJP stronghold, during a by-election. Several local residents and businessmen express strong support for Prashant Kishor, citing dissatisfaction with the incumbent BJP MLA's perceived absence, lack of development, and failure to address local issues. Despite acknowledging the BJP's robust campaign machinery, interviewees convey a firm belief in Prashant Kishor's commitment to systemic change, education, and genuine representation, indicating a significant shift in voter sentiment.

respondents.key_reason: Previously a staunch BJP supporter, she is now completely disillusioned with the Modi government due to unaddressed issues like the NEET exam leak, children dying of hunger, and perceived manipulation of women with small benefits. She believes Prashant Kishor is an educated leader who will bring real development and address public concerns.
respondents.quote_original: हम लोग कट्टर भाजपाई थे। लेकिन अब वो क्या कर रहा है? दिल्ली में क्या हो रहा है? वो आप लोग से छिपा हुआ नहीं है, सब कोई जान रहा है। इतना जो लाख दो लाख जो बच्चा वहां मर रहा है भूखे प्यासे, उन लोगों के प्रति तो खड़ा होना चाहिए ना? इस समय मोदी सरकार कहां गए? हम लोग 10 किलो चावल और 5 किलो दाल में नहीं जाएंगे। 10,000 रुपया में हम लोग बिकने वाले नहीं हैं।
respondents.quote_english: We were staunch BJP supporters. But what are they doing now? What's happening in Delhi? It's not hidden from you all, everyone knows. So many lakhs of children are dying there of hunger and thirst, shouldn't they stand up for them? Where is the Modi government at this time? We won't go for 10 kg rice and 5 kg lentils. We are not going to be sold for 10,000 rupees.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Older woman, previously a BJP voter, now a firm supporter of Jan Suraaj. She is the grandmother of Respondent 2.

respondents.key_reason: Influenced by her grandmother's strong support for Jan Suraaj and Prashant Kishor, she enthusiastically chants slogans for the party.
respondents.quote_original: जय बिहार! जय स्वराज!
respondents.quote_english: Hail Bihar! Hail Jan Suraaj!

respondents.key_reason: She expresses strong dissatisfaction with the BJP, calling them 'thieves,' and believes Prashant Kishor (Jan Suraaj) is a 'lion' who will bring significant change. She claims to have been supporting Jan Suraaj since the previous election and is resolute in her decision.
respondents.quote_original: हम और हमार बेटा कट्टर हो गए हैं एकदम जनसुराज जी। हम लोग पिछले बार से ही दे रहे हैं। इस बार उन्हीं को लाएंगे। सोच लिए हैं, मन में ठान लिए हैं। चोर जा रहा चोर जा रहा। शेर आया शेर आया।
respondents.quote_english: My son and I have become staunch Jan Suraaj supporters. We have been supporting him since last time. This time we will bring him. We have decided, we have made up our minds. Thief is going, thief is going. Lion has come, lion has come.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Woman, staunch supporter of Jan Suraaj, claims to have supported them in previous elections.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures a strong anti-incumbency sentiment among women in Bankipur, particularly against the BJP. Many interviewees, including former BJP supporters, express deep disillusionment with the current government over issues like the NEET exam leak, unfulfilled promises, and perceived manipulation. They are now firmly rallying behind Jan Suraaj and Prashant Kishor, viewing him as an educated and capable leader who will prioritize genuine development and address public concerns, contrasting him with the current administration which they criticize for divisive politics and neglecting real issues.

metadata.title: Bankipur By Election 2026: बांकीपुर विधानसभा का माहौल क्या है? Prashant Kishore | BJP | RJD
metadata.constituency_audit_reason: Video title and summary explicitly mention 'Bankipur By Election' and 'Bankipur Vidhan Sabha'.

analysis.video_title: Bankipur By Election 2026: बांकीपुर विधानसभा का माहौल क्या है? Prashant Kishore | BJP | RJD

respondents.key_reason: Believes BJP will win, dismisses Prashant Kishore as a non-local 'trickster' whose previous political affiliations failed.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी जीतेगा। बारूपिया है। आरजेडी में उनका नेता उनको छोड़ दिया। खाली खाली सिंबल दे दिया है। नहीं जीतेगा, वो यहां का रहने वाला नहीं है। ये बारूपिया है।
respondents.quote_english: BJP will win. He is a trickster. His leader in RJD abandoned him. Just gave him a symbol. He won't win, he is not from here. He is a trickster.

respondents.key_reason: Desires change, as long-term incumbency is unhealthy. Sees Prashant Kishore as a viable option for this change, making it a tough fight for BJP.
respondents.quote_original: माहौल ठीक ही चल रहा है। अभी इस बार कांटे का लड़ाई होएगा। जन सुराज एकरा में, बीजेपी में। सीट भी बदलना जरूरी है। एक ही आदमी 35 बरस राज करेगा तो अच्छा चीज नहीं है। ना आसान नहीं रहेगा। बीजेपी के लिए।
respondents.quote_english: The atmosphere is fine. This time it will be a tough fight. Between Jan Suraaj and BJP. Changing the seat is also necessary. It's not good if one person rules for 35 years. No, it won't be easy. For BJP.

respondents.key_reason: Consistent party loyalty to RJD and its candidate.
respondents.quote_original: लालटेन छाप का। रेखा देवी। वोट तो हम लोग उसी को देते हैं। आप किसी को नहीं देते।
respondents.quote_english: Of the lantern symbol. Rekha Devi. We only vote for them. We don't vote for anyone else.

respondents.key_reason: Believes Jan Suraaj is the best party and Prashant Kishore is a dynamic leader, representing a positive opportunity for the region.
respondents.quote_original: चुनाव का माहौल जन सुराज। हम कोर्ट के रिटायर्ड बड़ा बाबू हैं। जन सुराज को ही सपोर्ट कर रहे हैं। और जन सुराज से बढ़िया पार्टी कोई नहीं है। और प्रशांत किशोर एक डायनामिक लीडर हैं। हम लोग का किस्मत है राजधानी का पटना के बांकीपुर का पब्लिक का कि प्रशांत किशोर जैसा कैंडिडेट यहां मिला है।
respondents.quote_english: The election mood is for Jan Suraaj. I am a retired senior clerk from the court. We are supporting Jan Suraaj. And there is no better party than Jan Suraaj. And Prashant Kishore is a dynamic leader. It is our luck, the public of Bankipur, Patna, the capital, that a candidate like Prashant Kishore has been found here.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, retired civil court official, named Jai Prakash.

respondents.key_reason: Shifted from RJD to Jan Suraaj due to Prashant Kishore's focus on education and employment, and a desire to send a strong message against the current government's corruption, inflation, and lack of accountability. Criticizes leaders who don't connect with the public.
respondents.quote_original: माहौल तो इस बार जन सुराज। जो प्रशांत किशोर का वादा है, जो उनका एची है, वही पे हम लोग चल रहे हैं। वो शिक्षा और रोजगार की बात कर रहे हैं। मोदी ऐसा भ्रष्ट नेता कोई नहीं है। आपको हम लोग नेता बनाए, आप नेता बनके मलाई खा रहे हैं, अपना जनता जो आपको वोट दिया, जो आपको सपोर्टर है, उससे आप एक बार मिलने आए? अमित शाह जो आ रहा है 2 तारीख को, वो चोरी ही करने आ रहा है।
respondents.quote_english: This time the mood is for Jan Suraaj. We are following Prashant Kishore's promises and achievements. He is talking about education and employment. There is no leader as corrupt as Modi. We made you a leader, you are enjoying power as a leader, but did you ever come to meet your public who voted for you, who are your supporters? Amit Shah, who is coming on the 2nd, is coming only to steal.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, from Muslim community, Paswan, named Pappu Kumar Paswan, wearing a Jan Suraaj cap, from Buddha Colony.

respondents.key_reason: Desires change and sees Prashant Kishore as the best new candidate. Advocates for merit-based voting (good MLA) over caste/party, believing it's the solution to Bihar's political and economic issues.
respondents.quote_original: प्रशांत किशोर। परिवर्तन चाहिए। बांकीपुर में परिवर्तन चाहिए। प्रशांत किशोर नया चेहरा है उनके लिए कोई कैंडिडेट नहीं है उस लाइक। इससे पहले तो वही बीजेपी ही को किए थे। इस बार बदलाव चाहिए। जात पे देखिए, जात धर्म कभी उस पे वोट नहीं करना चाहिए। आप एमएलए देखिए। बिहार का ये बहुत गंदा है। यही जातिवाद के कारण।
respondents.quote_english: Prashant Kishore. Change is needed. Change is needed in Bankipur. Prashant Kishore is a new face, there is no candidate like him. Before this, I voted for BJP. This time, change is needed. Look at caste, one should never vote based on caste or religion. Look at the MLA. The politics of Bihar here is very bad. This is due to casteism.

respondents.key_reason: Believes Jan Suraaj has strong momentum and will win.
respondents.quote_original: शंकर शर्मा नाम है। चुनाव का वही स्थिति है, इंशाल्लाह जीतेंगे। जन सुराज। इससे पहले तो फिलहाल अभी आरजेडी को करते आए थे। इस बार जो है जन सुराज को ही खड़ा कराना है।
respondents.quote_english: My name is Shankar Sharma. The election situation is the same, Inshallah, they will win. Jan Suraaj. Before this, I used to vote for RJD. This time, Jan Suraaj must be made to stand.

respondents.key_reason: Unwilling to express a political opinion.
respondents.quote_original: अच्छा है। अब ऐसे क्या बताएं।
respondents.quote_english: It's good. What can I say now.

respondents.key_reason: Confident in BJP's victory.
respondents.quote_original: चुनाव ठीक-ठाक हो रहा है और क्या रहेगा। बीजेपी का आएगा और कौन आएगा।
respondents.quote_english: The election is going well, what else will happen. BJP will come, who else will come.

respondents.key_reason: Busy with work.
respondents.quote_original: गाड़ी चला रहे हैं।
respondents.quote_english: I am driving a car.

respondents.key_reason: Acknowledges BJP's development work and underlying public support, but also sees potential in new candidates like Prashant Kishore. Blames societal and political factors for Bihar's underdevelopment.
respondents.quote_original: प्रशांत किशोर आए हैं तो देखिए जनता का समर्थन किस हिसाब से मिल रहा है। लोग को अभी जहां तक लग रहा है कि बीजेपी अच्छा खासा बहुत जगह किए हैं। पर जनता अभी भी अंदर ही अंदर बीजेपी को सपोर्ट कर ही रहे हैं। शिक्षा व्यवस्था थोड़ा हमारे भारत में कुछ हद तक थोड़ी कमी है। यहां पर सबसे पहली बात है कि लोगों में ही गलती है।
respondents.quote_english: Prashant Kishore has come, let's see how much public support he gets. People, as far as I can tell, feel that BJP has done good work in many places. But the public is still supporting BJP internally. The education system in India is somewhat lacking to some extent. First of all, the fault lies with the people here.

respondents.key_reason: Prefers to keep his voting choice private until the election.
respondents.quote_original: वोट देना है वोट के बाद। पहले कुछ नहीं बताया जाएगा। गोपाल कुमार।
respondents.quote_english: Will vote after the election. Nothing will be told before. Gopal Kumar.

respondents.key_reason: Shifted from RJD to Jan Suraaj due to Prashant Kishore's support for the poor and his presence with the youth, in contrast to Tejashwi Yadav's perceived absence during protests.
respondents.quote_original: हम आरजेडी सपोर्टर हैं। बच्चा लोग का क्या हो रहा है। जन सुराज। प्रशांत किशोर को देख के उनका वो भी देखिए गरीब को सपोर्ट कर रहे हैं अभी देखिए फिलहाल में इधर बच्चा लोग में भी थे सपोर्ट किए थे। यादव हो तो इस बार जन सुराज को देंगे।
respondents.quote_english: I am an RJD supporter. What is happening with the children. Jan Suraaj. Looking at Prashant Kishore, he is also supporting the poor, and he was with the children recently, he supported them. If you are a Yadav, this time you will vote for Jan Suraaj.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, named Manish Kumar, identifies as Yadav.

respondents.key_reason: Trusts Prashant Kishore as a new face and hopes he can address the many existing problems, leading to a desire for change.
respondents.quote_original: ज्यादा से ज्यादा जन सुराज के सुन रहे हैं। नया चेहरा है। प्रशांत किशोर। बीजेपी। अभी नहीं बता सकते हैं। जानना चाह रहे हैं कि इस बहुत दिक्कत है।
respondents.quote_english: More and more people are listening to Jan Suraaj. He is a new face. Prashant Kishore. BJP. I cannot say now. I want to know, there are many problems.

respondents.key_reason: Confident that the BJP candidate, Gupta ji, is leading and will win.
respondents.quote_original: माहौल तो अभी चल रहा है वही गुप्ता जी के। हां। नहीं अभी ज्यादा गुप्ता जी के चल रहा है।
respondents.quote_english: The atmosphere is currently for Gupta ji. Yes. No, Gupta ji is currently leading more.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, named Balli Rai, identifies as Yadav.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video explores the political mood in Bankipur for the by-election, focusing on public opinion regarding Prashant Kishore (Jan Suraaj), BJP, and RJD. A significant number of interviewees, including former RJD and BJP supporters, express a strong desire for change and are shifting their allegiance to Jan Suraaj, citing Prashant Kishore's new leadership, focus on education/employment, and commitment to addressing public issues. However, a segment of the public remains firm in their support for BJP, while some are undecided or reluctant to share their views. The discussions highlight issues like inflation, corruption, development, and the importance of choosing a good local candidate over caste or party loyalty.

respondents.key_reason: Believes BJP will win due to Neeraj Sinha's development work and strong public sentiment.
respondents.quote_original: नहीं नहीं भारतीय जनता पार्टी ही जीतेगी। नीरज सिन्हा ही आने वाले हैं। ... हम लोग का मूड बना लिए हम लोग का नीरज सिन्हा ही है जो कि विकास का काम भी किए हैं।
respondents.quote_english: No, no, BJP will win. Neeraj Sinha is coming. ... We have made up our minds, it's Neeraj Sinha, who has also done development work.

respondents.key_reason: Supports BJP due to good governance under their rule, expecting continued well-being.
respondents.quote_original: नितिन नवीन जी का समझिए या फिर पब्लिक का समझिए लेकिन सबको है कि सपोर्ट बीजेपी का करना है। बीजेपी को आगे बढ़ाना है क्योंकि उनके शासन में हम लोग सब अच्छे थे, अच्छे हैं और आगे भी अच्छे रहेंगे।
respondents.quote_english: Understand it as Nitin Navin's or the public's, but everyone has to support BJP. BJP needs to be promoted because under their rule, we were all good, are good, and will continue to be good.

respondents.key_reason: Feels good about the lotus symbol and votes for the party that provides personal benefits.
respondents.quote_original: कमल छाप पर हम लोग के बुझाता है बढ़िया। ... जो हमको सहायता जो करते हैं उन्हीं को हम वोट दिए। मतलब कि जो सब चीज में अपना लाभ हमको बुझाता है उसी को हम वोट देते हैं।
respondents.quote_english: We feel good about the lotus symbol. ... I voted for whoever helps me. Meaning, whoever I feel benefits me in everything, I vote for them.

respondents.key_reason: Feels good about the lotus symbol (BJP's election symbol).
respondents.quote_original: कमल छाप कोई बुझाता है बढ़िया। हम कमल छाप।
respondents.quote_english: Lotus symbol feels good. We are for lotus symbol.

respondents.key_reason: Expresses hope for both Modi and Nitish Kumar, indicating consistent past support for the alliance.
respondents.quote_original: हम लोगों को तो उम्मीद है मोदी जी का ही इन्हीं का नीतीश जी का हां। ... सब दिन उनको दिए हैं तो अभी भी तो उन्हीं का है।
respondents.quote_english: We hope for Modi ji, for him, for Nitish ji, yes. ... We have always given it to them, so it's still theirs.

respondents.key_reason: Initially acknowledges Neeraj Sinha's chances and past BJP vote, but expresses intent to vote for Prashant Kishor (new player) due to fate.
respondents.quote_original: बन तो रहा है नीरज सिन्हा के। ... हां [Kamal Chhap]. ... अब तो अपना-अपना भाग से वो आया है। अब वोट तो हम लोग देंगे ही इन्हें जीतेगा।
respondents.quote_english: It's being made for Neeraj Sinha. ... Yes [Lotus symbol]. ... Now he has come by his own fate. We will vote for him, he will win.

respondents.key_reason: Despite acknowledging a lack of urban development and help, she consistently votes for Nitish Kumar, citing past rural development.
respondents.quote_original: नीतीश कुमार की सरकार ने गांव में घर बना दिया, गांव में जीविका दे दिया लेकिन ये जो शहर है इनका घर इस तरीके का है यहां आपको कोई मदद नहीं मिला। कोई कोई मदद नहीं। हमको कोई नहीं है। और वोट फिर भी नीतीश कुमार को देते हैं। हां देते हैं। वोट दे दे रहे हैं जब से जाने हैं जब से।
respondents.quote_english: Nitish Kumar's government built houses in villages, provided livelihood in villages, but in this city, their houses are like this, they didn't get any help here. No, no help. We have no one. And still, we vote for Nitish Kumar. Yes, we do. We have been voting since we knew him.

respondents.key_reason: Believes BJP will win and continue to rule, citing public enthusiasm.
respondents.quote_original: उनको देख के भी लग रहा है कि भारतीय जनता पार्टी ही आगे आएगी, वही जीतेगी, उन्हीं का शासन चलेगा, उन्हीं का राज रहेगा। जिस तरह लोगों में उत्साह लग रहा है, बीजेपी आगे रहेगा, रहा है और है।
respondents.quote_english: Looking at them, it seems BJP will come forward, they will win, their rule will continue, their reign will remain. The way people are enthusiastic, BJP will be ahead, has been, and is.

respondents.key_reason: Strong belief that Neeraj Sinha (BJP candidate) will win.
respondents.quote_original: नीरज सिन्हा ही जीतेंगे। हां वही जीतेंगे।
respondents.quote_english: Neeraj Sinha will win. Yes, he will win.

respondents.key_reason: Directly states support for BJP.
respondents.quote_original: ऐसे बीजेपी बीजेपी का ही कर रहे हैं।
respondents.quote_english: They are doing it for BJP only.

respondents.key_reason: Directly states support for BJP.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी का ही सपोर्ट है।
respondents.quote_english: It's BJP's support.

respondents.key_reason: Directly states support for BJP.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी का सपोर्ट।
respondents.quote_english: Support for BJP.

respondents.key_reason: Believes BJP has done a lot for them.
respondents.quote_original: वो हम लोग के लिए बहुत कुछ कर सके हैं।
respondents.quote_english: They have done a lot for us.

respondents.key_reason: Nitin Navin (BJP) has developed Bankipur well over 10 years, and women feel safe under his governance.
respondents.quote_original: यहां महिलाओं का जो है बीजेपी का ही समर्थन जा रहा है। बीजेपी के क्या कि यहां नीति नवीन ने जो भी 10 साल से रहा है, डेवलप किया है बाकीपुर को देखा है और अच्छा से डेवलप किया। महिलाएं हम लोग सुरक्षित भी हैं।
respondents.quote_english: Here, the women's support is going to BJP. What about BJP? Nitin Navin, who has been here for 10 years, has developed Bankipur, seen it, and developed it well. We women are also safe.

respondents.key_reason: Has consistently voted for Nitish Kumar (under the lotus symbol, implying alliance with BJP) and will continue to do so.
respondents.quote_original: पिछले में नीतीश कुमार को किए थे। कमल छाप। तो कमल छाप पे नीतीश कुमार को वोट किया था। अभी भी उन्हीं को देंगे।
respondents.quote_english: Last time, I voted for Nitish Kumar. Lotus symbol. So, I voted for Nitish Kumar on the lotus symbol. Still, I will give it to him.

respondents.key_reason: Directly states intent to make BJP win.
respondents.quote_original: हम तो बीजेपी को ही जिताएंगे।
respondents.quote_english: We will make BJP win.

respondents.key_reason: States that she does not vote much or is unwilling to disclose her preference.
respondents.quote_original: बहुत भाई हम नहीं देते हैं।
respondents.quote_english: Brother, we don't vote much.

respondents.key_reason: Directly states support for Nitin Navin.
respondents.quote_original: नितिन नवीन को। उन्हीं को देना है।
respondents.quote_english: Nitin Navin. Have to give it to him.

respondents.key_reason: Praises Nitish Kumar for significant development in Bihar, including hospitals, roads, and reduced traffic, making life convenient.
respondents.quote_original: नया पार्टी को देंगे और ये नीतीश कुमार को देंगे क्योंकि नीतीश कुमार तो बिहार में बहुत विकास किए हैं ऐसा बात नहीं है। इतना हॉस्पिटल, रोड, हम मायके भी जाते हैं तो इतना जाम वूम कुछ नहीं मिलता है। ... अब इतना विकास नीतीश कुमार कर दिए हैं कि क्या हम बताएं। सब चीज बन गया है। हम लोग के लिए सुविधा ही हो गया है।
respondents.quote_english: We will give it to the new party and to Nitish Kumar because Nitish Kumar has done a lot of development in Bihar, that's not wrong. So many hospitals, roads, even when I go to my maternal home, there's no traffic jam. ... Now Nitish Kumar has done so much development, what can I say? Everything is built. It has become convenient for us.

respondents.key_reason: Voted for Nitish Kumar previously and will vote for Nitin Sinha/Navin because he is good for women and has done development.
respondents.quote_original: नीतीश जी के वोट दिए थे। नितिन सिन्हा को ही वोट देंगे। ... क्योंकि महिला के लिए बहुत अच्छा है। मतलब सब विकास किए हैं। तो उन्हीं को वोट देंगे।
respondents.quote_english: Voted for Nitish ji. Will vote for Nitin Sinha only. ... Because he is very good for women. Meaning, he has done all development. So, we will vote for him.

respondents.key_reason: Believes Nitin Navin is the right choice for women.
respondents.quote_original: महिलाओं के लिए जो है नितिन नवीन ही है।
respondents.quote_english: For women, it is Nitin Navin.

respondents.key_reason: Directly states support for Nitin Navin.
respondents.quote_original: हां नितिन नवीन।
respondents.quote_english: Yes, Nitin Navin.

respondents.key_reason: Refuses to state her political preference.
respondents.quote_original: मैं नहीं बोलती।
respondents.quote_english: I don't speak.

respondents.key_reason: Not in support of any specific party, focusing instead on the need for a fair education system without paper leaks.
respondents.quote_original: हम लोग कोई भी पार्टी के सपोर्ट में नहीं है मतलब ना बीजेपी ना सीजेपी। यहां पे मतलब बात है हम लोग के एजुकेशन के लिए फेयर मैनेजमेंट सिस्टम के लिए मतलब एजुकेशन हम लोग का अच्छे से कोई भी बिना पेपर लीक के हो बस यही यूथ चाह रहा है और कुछ नहीं।
respondents.quote_english: Meaning, we are not in support of any party, neither BJP nor CJP. Here, the matter is about our education, for a fair management system, meaning our education should be good without any paper leaks, that's all the youth wants, nothing else.

respondents.key_reason: Highly critical of Nitish Kumar for neglecting urban poor, lack of basic facilities (ration, water), and superficial campaigning, despite his rural development efforts.
respondents.quote_original: बिहार में नीतीश जी घर बनाल थीन। और जो पटना में जरा रहे के साधन ना है, उनका लग नीतीश के ना है ने कि गरीबों को देखीं। राशन ना मिलल करे है। पानी ना पनिया से पीएल करे है। ई लगी सरकार के ना है ने। अब वोट लगी खाली घरे घरे घरे घरे चल रहल ने। ठीक है आज हम तोरा देरा लिए। तोरा संग लड़ रलिए। बाकी हम खाए के कर रहना है।
respondents.quote_english: In Bihar, Nitish ji built houses. And those who don't have means to live in Patna, Nitish doesn't care about the poor. They don't get ration. They don't get water to drink. This government doesn't care. Now for votes, they are just going door to door. Okay, today I fought with you. I fought with you. But we have to eat.

respondents.key_reason: As an uneducated person, she simply follows and supports the lotus symbol.
respondents.quote_original: हम अनपर का जानते हैं। जे का जिन के दे दे। कमल छाप पर दे रहे हैं।
respondents.quote_english: What do I, an uneducated person, know? Whoever they give it to. We are giving it to the lotus symbol.

respondents.key_reason: Critical of the lotus symbol (BJP) for not providing facilities or benefits to her.
respondents.quote_original: कमल छाप हमनी का कोई सुविधा नहीं।
respondents.quote_english: Lotus symbol, we have no facility.

analysis.overall_video_summary: This ground report from Bankipur reveals a strong leaning towards the BJP and JDU (NDA alliance) among women voters, with many expressing firm support for Nitin Navin and Nitish Kumar due to perceived development and women's safety. While Prashant Kishor (PK) is largely unknown or dismissed, a few respondents show a leaning towards his new party. A significant minority expresses dissatisfaction with urban development or prioritizes systemic issues like education over party politics, indicating a mixed but predominantly pro-NDA sentiment.

respondents.key_reason: Strongly advocates for political change and electing visionary leaders who work for the holistic development of society, not just one community. Criticizes existing parties for deceit, lack of vision, and failing to address real issues. He specifically endorses a visionary leader like Prashant Kishor.
respondents.quote_original: प्रशांत किशोर जैसा एक विजन वाला व्यक्ति को ही हम हरदम चुनाव में रखेंगे, उसको मतदान करेंगे, उसको जिताएंगे।
respondents.quote_english: We will always keep a visionary person like Prashant Kishor in elections, we will vote for him, we will make him win.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, older, educated man (referred to as 'Baba Ji' in the title), local resident of Bankipur.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video features a detailed analysis from a local resident of Bankipur who strongly advocates for political change and the election of visionary leaders. He criticizes existing political parties, including the BJP, for their lack of vision, deceitful policies, and failure to address core societal issues. The respondent emphasizes the need to choose candidates based on their vision for holistic societal development, explicitly mentioning Prashant Kishor as an example of such a leader.

metadata.title: Bankipur ByElection: Prashant Kishor, BJP या RJD बांकीपुर की जनता किसके साथ? कौन मारेगा बाज़ी?
metadata.constituency_audit_reason: Video title and summary explicitly mention 'Bankipur ByElection' and 'Bankipur by-election'.

analysis.video_title: Bankipur ByElection: Prashant Kishor, BJP या RJD बांकीपुर की जनता किसके साथ? कौन मारेगा बाज़ी?

respondents.key_reason: BJP workers are actively campaigning, distributing voter slips, and contacting people in every street and corner. He believes no other party is doing this. He also states that a community that previously didn't vote for them has now rejoined their support.
respondents.quote_original: भाजपा कार्यकर्ता हर एक गली में, हर एक मोहल्ले में एकदम गली-गली कोना-कोना पर्ची पहुंचा रहे हैं, लोगों से संपर्क कर रहे हैं। पिछली बार से ज्यादा ही होगा, कम नहीं होगा... प्रशांत किशोर जी का जो वोट है वो आरजेडी से ही डैमेज होंगे, भाजपा के नहीं जाएंगे इधर-उधर।
respondents.quote_english: BJP workers are reaching every street, every locality, every nook and corner, distributing slips and contacting people. It will be more than last time, not less... Prashant Kishor's votes will only damage RJD, they won't go to BJP.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, self-identifies as a 'common person' but strongly affiliated with BJP, speaking in Lohanipur, Ward 36, Patna.

respondents.key_reason: Extensive development work done by BJP MLAs (Naveen Kishor Sinha and Nitin Naveen) in the constituency since 1995, including building schools, laying pipelines, improving drainage, paving roads, and upgrading electricity infrastructure.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी 95 से कंटिन्यू बीजेपी जीत रहे हैं... दोनों विधायक जी इतने बांकीपुर विधानसभा में इतना काम किए हैं... स्कूल बनवाए हैं... पाइपलाइन बिछवाए... नाला वाला ड्रेनेज सिस्टम दूर किए... मेन रोड के सभी रोड पिच करवाए... चापाकल लगवाए... हर एक गली के बिजली के तार लगातार चेंज कर रहे हैं सब कॉपर वायर करवाए।
respondents.quote_english: BJP has been continuously winning since '95... Both MLAs have done so much work in Bankipur constituency... built schools... laid pipelines... fixed drainage systems... paved all main roads... installed hand pumps... continuously changed electricity wires in every street to copper wires.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, named Kanhaiya Kishor, speaking in Lohanipur, Ward 36, Patna.

respondents.key_reason: BJP has done good work and cares for the public. People vote based on the visible work of Nitin Naveen.
respondents.quote_original: काम किया है सब चीज काम किया है बढ़िया से काम करता है केयर करता है आम पब्लिक का मान के चलिए इसलिए जीत रहा है घर-घर के नितिन नवीन के देख के लोग वोट देते हैं।
respondents.quote_english: They have done work, everything, they work well, they care for the common public, that's why they are winning. People vote after seeing Nitin Naveen's work in every household.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, named Pankaj Sharma, speaking in Lohanipur, Ward 36, Patna.

respondents.key_reason: BJP will win. He dismisses Prashant Kishor's influence, stating that many like him have come and gone, implying they have no lasting impact and are only after money.
respondents.quote_original: जीतेगा बीजेपी जीतेगा और कौन जीतेगा... प्रशांत किशोर कितना आए और गए... झंडे जैसे उड़ जाएंगे।
respondents.quote_english: BJP will win, who else will win... How many Prashant Kishors have come and gone... Their flags will fly away.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, named Sanjeet Kumar Singh, speaking in Lohanipur, Ward 36, Patna.

respondents.key_reason: There is a strong 'wave' for BJP, indicating widespread public support, and they are definitely winning.
respondents.quote_original: उपचुनाव में बस वही मतलब बीजेपी का लहर है। एकदम जीत रही है।
respondents.quote_english: In the by-election, it's just the BJP wave. They are definitely winning.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, named Nishant Shekhar, speaking in Lohanipur, Ward 36, Patna.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures the public mood in Patna's Lohanipur area regarding the Bankipur by-election. All interviewed residents express strong and firm support for the BJP, citing extensive development work by their local MLAs and active campaigning. They collectively dismiss the influence of other parties and candidates like Prashant Kishor, asserting that BJP will win with a significant margin.

metadata.title: छात्र आंदोलन पर जनता की राय: बांकीपुर चुनाव पर कितना पड़ेगा असर, बता रहे लोग
