analysis.video_title: छात्र आंदोलन पर जनता की राय: बांकीपुर चुनाव पर कितना पड़ेगा असर, बता रहे लोग

respondents.key_reason: Supports BJP candidate Nitin Navin. Believes protests should be peaceful and condemns violence and paper leaks, advocating for a calm approach to demands.
respondents.quote_original: यहां नितिन नवीन जी के उम्मीदवार जीतेंगे भाजपा का।
respondents.quote_english: Here, Nitin Navin ji's candidate will win, from BJP.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, resident of Bankipur, likely older.

respondents.key_reason: Unsure about the political mood in Bankipur, perceiving a close fight between BJP and Jan Suraaj. Did not witness the protest directly.
respondents.quote_original: हमको तो समझ में नहीं आ रहा किसका लग रहा है। अब दोनों में से दोनों के लड़ाई है। किसका? एक वो बीजेपी का है एक वो जनसुराज का। बीजेपी जनसुराज की लड़ाई है ना।
respondents.quote_english: I don't understand whose side is stronger. Now it's a fight between both of them. Whose? One is BJP's, one is Jan Suraaj's. It's a fight between BJP and Jan Suraaj, right?
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, named Ramnath, resident of Bankipur (implied).

respondents.key_reason: Supports student protests due to rising unemployment and unfulfilled job promises by the government. Believes leaders deserve to be beaten for not delivering on their promises. Historically supports BJP but is critical of the current 'dummy candidate'.
respondents.quote_original: नेता तो पिटाएंगे। बड़े-बड़े वादे करते हैं मंच से और जमीनी स्तर पर कुछ कर नहीं पाते हैं तो नेता तो पिटाएंगे ना। नितिन नवीन थे तो हम लोग समर्थन करते थे। लेकिन ये डमी कैंडिडेट हैं इनको क्यों समर्थन करें हम?
respondents.quote_english: Leaders will get beaten. They make big promises from the stage but can't do anything at the ground level, so leaders will get beaten, right? When Nitin Navin was there, we used to support him. But why should we support this dummy candidate?
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, named Raviraj, resident of Bankipur locality.

respondents.key_reason: Strongly supports Prashant Kishor. Criticizes police brutality against students during the protest, especially against a girl, and dismisses claims of injured police. Believes BJP leaders deserve to be beaten.
respondents.quote_original: हम लोग प्रशांत किशोर को वोट देंगे। नेता को जो पिटाना का है वो तो और लात खाएगा नेता सब। हां बीजेपी के।
respondents.quote_english: We will vote for Prashant Kishor. The leaders who got beaten, those leaders will get more kicks. Yes, BJP's.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, named Om Prakash, likely older ('uncle ji').

respondents.key_reason: Believes the protest was sponsored by all political parties and criticizes the opposition for gheraoing the PM's residence and raising slogans against 'Brahminism' while the PM and Education Minister are from backward castes. Strongly condemns asking 'the country's father's name'. Defends BJP's candidate selection and criticizes Prashant Kishor's past electoral performance and commitment to public service.
respondents.quote_original: ये कैसा विद्यार्थी है जो देश का बाप का नाम पूछ रहा है। ये भारतीय जनता पार्टी ही है कि रोड से उठाकर उसको नेता बना देता है। उसके बाद ये चुनाव छोड़कर चले गए जनता की सेवा छोड़कर चले गए विजय थालापति के यहां पैसा कमाने के लिए।
respondents.quote_english: What kind of student is this who is asking the name of the country's father? It is the Bharatiya Janata Party that picks someone from the street and makes him a leader. After that, he left the election, left public service, and went to Vijay Thalapathy's place to earn money.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, named Krishn Mohan Kumar, resident of Bankipur locality, likely older ('uncle ji').

analysis.overall_video_summary: This video captures diverse public opinions in Bankipur regarding a recent student protest and the upcoming by-election. While some respondents strongly support the protests, citing unemployment and unfulfilled government promises, others criticize the aggressive nature of the demonstrations and the opposition's tactics. The political landscape appears divided, with firm support for both the BJP and Prashant Kishor's Jan Suraaj, alongside some undecided voters and those critical of specific candidates.

metadata.title: Bankipur By Election: Jansuraaj और BJP समर्थकों में होने लगी बहस, कर दिया चैलेंज | Public Opinion
metadata.constituency_audit_reason: Video title and summary explicitly mention 'Bankipur By Election' and 'by-election'.

analysis.video_title: Bankipur By Election: Jansuraaj और BJP समर्थकों में होने लगी बहस, कर दिया चैलेंज | Public Opinion

respondents.key_reason: Believes in Prashant Kishor's education and quality. Despite acknowledging the incumbent BJP MLA's good work, he feels free to choose a new leader as the current political situation allows for personal choice and a desire for change.
respondents.quote_original: हमारे विधायक हमको छोड़ के चलते हैं, उनको भी हम छोड़ दिए। हमारा अपना मत है हम जिसको दें। मेरा प्रत्याशी हार जाए हार जाए, मगर हम वोट तो देंगे उन्हीं को।
respondents.quote_english: Our MLA left us, so we also left him. It's my own choice whom I vote for. Even if my candidate loses, I will still vote for him.

respondents.key_reason: Strongly dismisses Prashant Kishor's claims and efforts, believing he is merely a 'vote-splitter' who will not win. Challenges PK's supporters to prove his victory.
respondents.quote_original: नहीं बॉस उनके बोलने से क्या होंगे अगर उनके बोलने से हो जाएंगे तो हम आधा मूछ मुड़वा लेंगे। वो आके केवल वोट कटवा का काम कर रहे हैं।
respondents.quote_english: No boss, what will happen by his words? If he wins by his words, I'll shave half my mustache. He is only working as a vote-splitter.

respondents.key_reason: Believes BJP will win due to its traditional stronghold in the constituency and past large margins. Praises the incumbent MLA, Nitin Navin, for good work and strong connection with the people.
respondents.quote_original: जिसका सीट है, परंपरागत वो जीत जाएगा। इतना लंबा मार्जिन से पहले से भी भाजपा यहां से जीतती आई है। पहले जो यहां के जो प्रतिनिधि थे नितिन नवीन जी मतलब घर-घर से जुड़े हुए थे, अच्छा काम कर रहे थे।
respondents.quote_english: The one whose seat it is, traditionally, they will win. BJP has been winning here with such a large margin from before. The representative here earlier, Nitin Navin ji, was connected with every household and was doing good work.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, named Ravindra Kishor, local resident.

respondents.key_reason: Supports BJP because Nitin Navin has done significant development work in the area, including converting a drain into a road and improving alleys. Believes voters will support the one who brings development.
respondents.quote_original: माहौल बहुत यहां पे भाजपा के ही पक्ष में है माहौल। यहां पे नितिन नवीन ने बहुत विकास का काम किया है। ये मंदिरी नाला था, इसको पाट के इन्होंने रोड बनवा दिया।
respondents.quote_english: The atmosphere here is very much in favor of BJP. Nitin Navin has done a lot of development work here. This Mandiri drain was filled and he built a road over it.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, named Sanjeev Kumar, local resident.

respondents.key_reason: Believes BJP has historically won in this constituency and currently has strong momentum. Dismisses other candidates' chances, stating that the party that has been winning will continue to win.
respondents.quote_original: जो जूते आ रहे हैं वही जीतेंगे और क्या जीतेंगे। शुरू से भाजपा ही यहां जीतते आया है इसलिए जीतेगा।
respondents.quote_english: The one who has been winning will win, what else? BJP has been winning here from the beginning, so it will win.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, named Prem Prakash Singh, local resident.

respondents.key_reason: Believes there is a strong wave of change in Bihar. Views the election as an opportunity to break BJP's arrogance and choose a better chief minister, highlighting the increased attention from central ministers as a sign of voter power and BJP's concern.
respondents.quote_original: बदलाव की लहर है ना। ये भाजपा के उस अहंकार को तोड़ने का चुनाव है जहां उन्होंने कहा है कि अगर वो कुत्ता बिल्ली को भी खड़ा करेंगे तो बाकीपुर की जनता उन्हीं को वोट देगी। जिनके यहां पहले वार्ड काउंसलर नहीं आते थे, आज उनके यहां केंद्रीय मंत्री आ रहे हैं। ये बिहार के लोगों की बाकीपुर के लोगों की ताकत है।
respondents.quote_english: There is a wave of change, isn't there? This election is about breaking BJP's arrogance, where they said that even if they field a dog or a cat, the people of Bankipur will vote for them. Where earlier even ward councilors wouldn't visit, today central ministers are coming. This is the power of the people of Bihar, the people of Bankipur.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, named Prem Prakash, local resident.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures a lively debate among residents of Bankipur regarding the upcoming by-election. While a significant number of respondents express firm support for BJP, citing the incumbent MLA's development work and the party's traditional stronghold, a vocal minority strongly advocates for Prashant Kishor's Jan Suraaj, emphasizing the need for change, educated leadership, and breaking the BJP's perceived arrogance. The discussion highlights a clear divide between those favoring continuity and those seeking a political shift.

analysis.video_title: बांकीपुर उपचुनाव कौन जीतेगा? इस दादा जी ने कर दिया सटीक भविष्वाणी! Bankipur By Election Exit Poll

respondents.key_reason: He is deeply disillusioned with the current government's (implied BJP/NDA) corporate-focused policies, perceived arrogance of leaders, and exploitation of common people. He believes Prashant Kishor's movement (Jan Suraaj) will bring genuine change and remove the 'stigma' associated with Biharis, urging voters to prioritize integrity over caste and religion.
respondents.quote_original: इस बार अपने ईमान का परिचय दीजिए इस बार जाति और धर्म से उठ के अगर जब तक ले आप वोट नहीं करते हैं आने वाले आपके नस्ल खराब हो जाएंगे... प्रशांत किशोर जीतेंगे और इस बार कोई ईवीएम टीडीएम का तमाशा नहीं चलेगा जब जनता एक मत होगी तो सब ईवीएम टीबीएम का तमाशा खत्म हो जाएगा।
respondents.quote_english: This time, show your integrity. If you don't vote rising above caste and religion, your future generations will be ruined... Prashant Kishor will win, and this time no EVM drama will work. When the public is united, all EVM drama will end.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, identifies as 'Swami Jitendra', former BJP cadre, from Bankipur constituency.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video features a single, highly vocal interviewee, Swami Jitendra, a former BJP cadre, who expresses strong dissatisfaction with the current political establishment, particularly criticizing the BJP for its corporate-centric approach and perceived arrogance. He firmly supports Prashant Kishor's Jan Suraaj movement, believing it will bring about a much-needed revolution in Bihar by addressing issues like high taxation, inflation, and the exploitation of common citizens. He emphasizes the importance of voting based on conscience rather than caste or religion, predicting a decisive victory for Prashant Kishor.

metadata.title: बांकीपुर सीट पर कौन जीतेगा? जनता ने बता दिया Winner | Bankipur By Election Ground Report 2026 #bihar
metadata.constituency_audit_reason: Video title and summary explicitly mention 'Bankipur constituency' and 'by-election'.

analysis.video_title: बांकीपुर सीट पर कौन जीतेगा? जनता ने बता दिया Winner | Bankipur By Election Ground Report 2026 #bihar

respondents.key_reason: Strongly supports Prashant Kishor, viewing him as a highly qualified and good leader for Bihar who will focus on development, youth, and students. Criticizes BJP for divisive politics (Hindu-Muslim), corruption, and lack of genuine development, and dismisses Nitish Kumar as irrelevant.
respondents.quote_original: प्रशांत किशोर जैसा अभी क्वालिफाइड अभी हमारे बिहार में कोई नहीं है नेता लोग कोई है।
respondents.quote_english: There is no qualified leader like Prashant Kishor in Bihar right now.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Older male, likely from Bankipur, expresses strong opinions against BJP and Nitish Kumar.

respondents.key_reason: Desires 'badlav' (change) and believes Prashant Kishor will bring about positive development in Bankipur.
respondents.quote_original: बदलाव होना चाहिए। प्रशांत किशोर के तरफ से जो है आपका ये जा रहा है रुझान। हाँ हाँ। ठीक है काम करेंगे।
respondents.quote_english: There should be change. Your inclination is towards Prashant Kishor. Yes, yes. He will do good work.

respondents.key_reason: Highly dissatisfied with the current government, stating that Nitish Kumar becoming Chief Minister was a mistake and things have 'become very bad' under Samrat Choudhary, citing the government's actions against street vendors as a major issue affecting the poor.
respondents.quote_original: गलती हुआ यही मुख्यमंत्री बनीं जो गलती हुआ है। बाकी तो ठीक ही था। बहुत गड़बड़ हुआ है।
respondents.quote_english: The mistake was that he became the Chief Minister, that was the mistake. Otherwise, everything was fine. It has become very bad.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, likely from Patna/Bankipur area, critical of current government policies.

respondents.key_reason: A staunch BJP supporter, confident that only BJP will win due to Narendra Modi's leadership. However, he is very critical of Samrat Choudhary's performance, accusing him of personal attacks and lack of work, and believes he should be replaced by another qualified BJP leader. He also thinks Nitish Kumar should retire.
respondents.quote_original: साफ, ओनली फॉर बीजेपी। ... हम लोग बीजेपी सपोर्टर हैं, बीजेपी को सपोर्ट करेंगे। ... सम्राट चौधरी हटेंगे, हटेंगे, हटेंगे। ... वो पर्सनली अटैक ज्यादा करते हैं। तो पर्सनली अटैक मुख्यमंत्री को नहीं करना चाहिए।
respondents.quote_english: Clearly, only for BJP. ... We are BJP supporters, we will support BJP. ... Samrat Choudhary will be removed, will be removed, will be removed. ... He attacks personally too much. A Chief Minister should not do personal attacks.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, staunch BJP supporter, connected to BJP groups, likely from Bankipur.

respondents.key_reason: Believes Bankipur has always been a BJP stronghold and will continue to vote for BJP. Dismisses Prashant Kishor's chances based on his past electoral performance.
respondents.quote_original: भाजपा का ही ये एरिया है शुरू से ही, भाजपा को ही वोट मिलेगा। ... कोई फायदा नहीं है। भाजपा का ही रहेगा जगह, भाजपा ही।
respondents.quote_english: This is BJP's area from the beginning, BJP will get the vote. ... There's no benefit. BJP's place will remain, BJP.

respondents.key_reason: Expresses strong loyalty and faith in BJP, having voted for them for 20 years. Believes BJP works for development and has brought peace and improved law and order, contrasting it with the previous 'Jungle Raj'.
respondents.quote_original: हम लोग बीजेपी के काम करते हैं और बीजेपी को ही वोट देंगे। चाहे हारे या जीते, बीजेपी ही। ... अपना श्रद्धा है।
respondents.quote_english: We work for BJP and will vote for BJP. Whether they win or lose, it will be BJP. ... It's our faith.

respondents.key_reason: Initially hesitant, but ultimately believes BJP is a good candidate that works well and expects them to win again for continued development.
respondents.quote_original: नहीं भाजपा भी सही कैंडिडेट है, बहुत अच्छा काम करते हैं ऐसा बात नहीं कि नहीं करती है। अभी आने वाला समय भी बीजेपी ही आएगा।
respondents.quote_english: No, BJP is also a good candidate, they work very well, it's not that they don't. In the coming time, BJP will come again.

respondents.key_reason: Feels a sense of pride that Prashant Kishor is contesting from his constituency and hopes for a better leader after the previous MLA. Appreciates Prashant Kishor's focus on employment, stopping migration, and overall development rather than just government jobs.
respondents.quote_original: उम्मीद तो इस बार है, सोच में रखे हुए हैं कि प्रशांत किशोर जी आएं, बहुत हम लोग के लिए प्राउड मोमेंट होगा। ... हम लोग अभी तक तो नीति नवीन को ही चुने हैं। ... उनके दिल्ली जाने के बाद तो प्रयास यही रहेगा कि उनके तरफ फिर एक बेहतर नेता आए बांकीपुर विधानसभा में।
respondents.quote_english: There is hope this time, we are thinking that Prashant Kishor ji should come, it will be a very proud moment for us. ... We have only chosen Nitin Nabin until now. ... After he went to Delhi, our effort will be to have a better leader like him come to Bankipur constituency.

respondents.key_reason: Expresses frustration with the poor road infrastructure and incomplete work by contractors, despite the local MLA's instructions. His focus is on local civic issues rather than political preference.
respondents.quote_original: गड्ढा है तो एलटीएस वाली जो काम करते हैं कि चेंबर बनाए, चेंबर बनाने के बाद उसको चालू नहीं किए हैं, बंद नहीं किए हैं। तो ये तो गलती एलटीएस वाला का ना है।
respondents.quote_english: There's a pothole, the L&T people who were supposed to build the chamber, they built it but didn't start it or close it. So this is L&T's mistake, isn't it?
respondents.demographics_or_context: Shopkeeper in Bankipur, whose shop is located near a large pothole.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures diverse political sentiments in Bankipur constituency ahead of a by-election. While some residents express strong loyalty to BJP, citing improved law and order and development, others voice deep dissatisfaction with the current government, particularly regarding corruption, lack of development, and policies affecting the poor. A significant number of interviewees are looking for change and express hope in Prashant Kishor, viewing him as a qualified leader focused on youth and migration issues, despite his past electoral performance.

metadata.title: Bankipur By-Election 2026: बांकीपुर की जनता Prashant Kishor को लेकर क्या सोचती है? | Public Reaction
metadata.constituency_audit_reason: Video title and summary explicitly mention 'Bankipur By-Election'.

analysis.video_title: Bankipur By-Election 2026: बांकीपुर की जनता Prashant Kishor को लेकर क्या सोचती है? | Public Reaction

respondents.key_reason: Leaders are joining BJP because they see it as their family. The public is wise and understands who is genuinely working and who is not. Jan Suraaj is not a serious political entity.
respondents.quote_original: वो बहुत जरूरी था ना। वो अपना परिवार समझते हैं इसीलिए वो भाजपा में जॉइन हो गए हैं। बाकी तो लोग देख ही रहे हैं, जनता समझ ही रही है कि कौन क्या है।
respondents.quote_english: It was very necessary. They consider it their family, that's why they joined BJP. The public is watching, the public understands who is who.

respondents.key_reason: Prashant Kishor is a fraud who cheats people by taking money for tickets and then disappears. He is not genuinely interested in public service, unlike BJP which is focused on development.
respondents.quote_original: प्रशांत किशोर जी ठगने का काम कर रहे हैं। लोगों को पैसा लेते हैं, पैसा टिकट बेचते हैं। पूरा माहौल बना हुआ है इस बात को सभी लोग बोल रहे हैं वहां से जो जो आ रहे हैं कि पैसा लेके पैसा ठगने का काम करते हैं फिर गायब हो जाएंगे।
respondents.quote_english: Prashant Kishor ji is doing the work of cheating. He takes money from people, sells tickets for money. Everyone coming from there is saying that he takes money, cheats people, and then disappears.

respondents.key_reason: Prashant Kishor is weak and a fraud ('bahurupiya') who will come and go. Nitin Navin (BJP) has done significant development work in the area, including double-decker bridges, community halls, and improved drainage and water facilities.
respondents.quote_original: वो तो पहले से ही कमजोर है। प्रशांत किशोर है कौन? वो तो बहुरूपिया है। आएंगे और चले जाएंगे। यहां हम लोग के जनता के लिए जो नितिन नवीन जी काम किए हैं, जैसे कि डबल डेकर पुल दिए हैं।
respondents.quote_english: He was already weak. Who is Prashant Kishor? He is a fraud. He will come and go. Here, for our public, Nitin Navin ji has done work, like providing a double-decker bridge.

respondents.key_reason: Prashant Kishor has a bad image; he is a businessman who only appears during elections to make money by collecting funds and selling tickets, then leaves.
respondents.quote_original: उनका तो पहले से ही छवि खराब है। ऐसे तो उनको हम लोग पहचानते नहीं हैं पर व्यापार के रूप में उनको हम जानते हैं कि जब भी चुनाव आती है वो व्यापार करने आते हैं।
respondents.quote_english: His image is already bad. We don't recognize him otherwise, but we know him as a businessman who comes to do business whenever elections come.

respondents.key_reason: BJP has done significant development work, and the public trusts them based on this progress. They believe NDA candidates will be elected due to their development record.
respondents.quote_original: ऐसा नहीं है बीजेपी अपना विकास जो किए हैं, विकास पर वोट लेते हैं, विकास पर ही भरोसा किए हुए हैं कि हम इतना काम किए हैं, विकास किए हैं, एनडीए के सरकार में विकास हुआ है तो एनडीए की प्रत्याशी को पब्लिक वोट देगी।
respondents.quote_english: No, BJP has done development, they get votes on development, they trust in development that we have done so much work, development has happened under the NDA government, so the public will vote for the NDA candidate.

respondents.key_reason: There has been a lot of development, especially for women, who now enjoy more freedom, mobility, and access to essential resources like gas cylinders and food grains. They want to re-elect BJP for continued progress.
respondents.quote_original: बहुत हुआ हम लोग बहुत पहले तो महिला लोग बहुत आजादी मनाते हैं कि जो पहले घर से नहीं निकलते थे अब घर से निकलते हैं कोई रोक-टोक नहीं है कहीं भी आ जा सकते हैं और इतना लाभ मिला गेहूं मिलता है सिलेंडर मिला है हर चीज को जो महिला को नहीं मिलता था पहले अब महिला को वो चीज मिल रहा है।
respondents.quote_english: A lot has happened. Earlier, women celebrate a lot of freedom now. Those who didn't leave their homes before, now they do, there are no restrictions, they can go anywhere. And they received so many benefits, wheat, cylinders, everything that women didn't get before, they are getting now.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Female, speaking about social and economic changes.

respondents.key_reason: BJP candidates are dedicated grassroots workers who understand public issues and have delivered significant development, including double-decker bridges, community halls, and improved water supply.
respondents.quote_original: जो भी प्रत्याशी आएंगे वो भाजपा के समर्पित प्रत्याशी हैं। ये नहीं कहना है कि ये किसी को भी वोट टिकट मिल जाएगा तो जीत जाएगा। हमारे नीरज कुमार सिन्हा जो हैं भाजपा के समर्पित कार्यकर्ता हैं और बूथ लेवल के कार्यकर्ता हैं बहुत ही साधारण लेवल से आते हैं।
respondents.quote_english: Whoever candidates come, they are dedicated candidates of BJP. It's not about saying that anyone who gets a ticket will win. Our Neeraj Kumar Sinha is a dedicated worker of BJP and a booth-level worker, he comes from a very humble background.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Female, speaking about local candidates and development.

respondents.key_reason: Prashant Kishor is a fraud who has cheated the entire Bihar by taking money for tickets and ATM cards. In contrast, BJP's candidate, Neeraj Kumar, is a genuine grassroots worker from a poor family who educates children for free.
respondents.quote_original: प्रशांत किशोर ऐसा व्यक्ति है ना ये पूरे बिहार को ठगने का काम किए हैं। कभी टिकट के नाम से, कभी एटीएम कार्ड के नाम से, तो कभी ₹10-10 लेके 5 करोड़ आदमी का कम से कम 50-100 करोड़ रुपया लेके चंपत हो गया है।
respondents.quote_english: Prashant Kishor is such a person, he has cheated the entire Bihar. Sometimes in the name of tickets, sometimes in the name of ATM cards, sometimes by taking 10-10 rupees from 5 crore people, he has absconded with at least 50-100 crore rupees.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, speaking about political figures and corruption.

respondents.key_reason: Nitin Navin (BJP leader) has done extensive development work in Bankipur, including solving water problems and building community facilities for the poor. He is a grassroots leader who connects with people by visiting their homes.
respondents.quote_original: नितिन नवीन घर से जुड़ा हुआ व्यक्ति है। एक-एक घर में जाकर आशीर्वाद लेने का काम करते थे, खाना खाते थे।
respondents.quote_english: Nitin Navin is a person connected to every home. He used to go to each house to seek blessings and eat food.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, speaking about local leader's work.

respondents.key_reason: Prashant Kishor is not a significant factor for BJP; he is merely a businessman who collects money through his campaigns by distributing tokens and then leaves.
respondents.quote_original: प्रशांत किशोर कोई फैक्टर नहीं है बीजेपी के लिए। क्या मैं आपको एक उदाहरण दे दूं? उनका जहां भी कैंपेन लग रहा है, वहां वो उनका अपने स्टॉल लगा रहे हैं और वहां पर टोकन बांट रहे हैं। ₹10 का, ₹20 का, वही पैसा लेके वो कैंपेन कर रहे हैं।
respondents.quote_english: Prashant Kishor is not a factor for BJP. Shall I give you an example? Wherever his campaign is happening, he is setting up his stalls and distributing tokens for 10 or 20 rupees, and he is campaigning with that money.

respondents.key_reason: The public is now fully aware of the power of their vote and will choose wisely, selecting a leader who genuinely works for them. Prashant Kishor is not a true politician but an event manager.
respondents.quote_original: फायदा नुकसान के लिए नहीं है। अभी सबसे बढ़िया हम देख रहे हैं, मेरा 66 साल उम्र है, 50 साल का हम जान रहे हैं राजनीति। जो चीज होना चाहिए था अब हो रहा है। इसलिए हो रहा है कि हर हर जनता जान गया कि मेरा एक वोट का अधिकार कितना इसमें पावर है।
respondents.quote_english: It's not about profit or loss. Now we are seeing the best, I am 66 years old, I have known politics for 50 years. What should have happened is happening now. It's happening because every public knows how much power their one vote has.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Elderly Male (66 years old), experienced in politics.

respondents.key_reason: Prashant Kishor's methods are akin to I-PAC, focusing on event management rather than genuine politics. The public is now knowledgeable enough to distinguish between genuine workers and those who deceive them.
respondents.quote_original: ये लोग आते हैं जैसे आप ले लीजिए बंगाल। बंगाल में आईपैक आईपैक का भी यही काम था, सेम काम था। आज आईपैक ममता बनर्जी को क्या कहां लाके खड़ा कर दिया। तो सेम चीज यही ये भी है। ये तो शुरुआती दौर से चालू किए हुए हैं।
respondents.quote_english: These people come, like in Bengal. I-PAC also did the same work there. Today, where has I-PAC brought Mamata Banerjee? So this is the same thing here. He has started this from the initial phase.

respondents.key_reason: Leaders like K.C. Sinha joined BJP from Prashant Kishor's party because they felt a lack of respect, ideological alignment, and a genuine focus on development in PK's leadership. BJP is seen as the true party for development.
respondents.quote_original: उनको कहीं ना कहीं कुछ कमी महसूस हुआ होगा प्रशांत किशोर के नेतृत्व में उस पार्टी में। उनको कहीं ना कहीं मान सम्मान में कमी, विचारधारा में कमी और जो विचारधारा जो विकास का लेकर वो लोग बात करते थे उसमें भी कमी दिखा होगा तो उनको लगा डॉक्टर केसी सिन्हा जी को कि भारतीय जनता पार्टी ही सच्ची विकास की बात करने वाली पार्टी है तो उन्होंने हमारे पार्टी में ज्वाइन किया।
respondents.quote_english: They must have felt some shortcomings somewhere in Prashant Kishor's leadership in that party. They must have seen a lack of respect, a lack of ideology, and a lack of focus on development in the ideology they talked about, so Dr. K.C. Sinha ji must have felt that Bharatiya Janata Party is the only party that talks about true development, so he joined our party.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, speaking about reasons for leaders switching parties.

respondents.key_reason: BJP will win with a huge majority. Prashant Kishor is a businessman, not a politician, and his past political predictions were incorrect. He is here to do business and will eventually leave politics.
respondents.quote_original: किसी को फायदा नहीं होगा, भारतीय जनता पार्टी भारी बहुमत से विजय हम लोग हो गए। और प्रशांत किशोर जी को देख लीजिए 2025 में क्या रिजल्ट था। वो बोले थे कि नीतीश कुमार को 25 सीट नहीं आएगा, हम पार्टी छोड़ देंगे। राजनीतिक छोड़ देंगे। लेकिन उन्होंने राजनीतिक छोड़ दिया? नहीं छोड़ा। आज भी देखिए राजनीतिक कर रहा है। प्रशांत किशोर एक बिजनेसमैन है, वो आया है बिजनेस करने के लिए और बिजनेस करेगा, चले जाएगा।
respondents.quote_english: Nobody will benefit, Bharatiya Janata Party has won with a huge majority. And look at Prashant Kishor ji, what was the result in 2025? He said that Nitish Kumar would not get 25 seats, and he would leave politics. Did he leave politics? No. Even today, he is doing politics. Prashant Kishor is a businessman, he has come to do business and he will do business and leave.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, speaking about political predictions and PK's nature.

respondents.key_reason: Prashant Kishor is an event manager, not a politician, as evidenced by his 'rally of chairs' instead of people. His candidates losing their deposits further proves his lack of political substance.
respondents.quote_original: प्रशांत किशोर जो है वो पॉलिटिशियन नहीं है। पॉलिटिशियन तो पॉलिटिशियन तो आदमी का रैली करता है, कार्यकर्ताओं का रैली करता है, संख्या बुला के रैली करता है। ये व्यक्ति तो 5 लाख कुर्सी का रैली गानिंग गान कर लिया। जो कुर्सी का रैली करता है वो कैसे पॉलिटिशियन हो सकता है? ये तो इवेंट मैनेजर है।
respondents.quote_english: Prashant Kishor is not a politician. A politician holds rallies of people, rallies of workers, rallies by calling numbers. This person held a rally of 5 lakh chairs. How can someone who holds a rally of chairs be a politician? He is an event manager.

respondents.key_reason: Respected academics like K.C. Sinha left Prashant Kishor's party due to a lack of substance. Prashant Kishor is not from the local area and has dual voter IDs. BJP, in contrast, has brought significant development, including double-decker bridges and improvements to PMCH hospital.
respondents.quote_original: हम लोग आठवां-नौवां में केसी सिन्हा का हम लोग मैथमेटिक्स पढ़े हैं। उस समय वो प्रोफेसर जिनका हम लोग किताब में ज्ञान लिए हैं जिससे हम लोग पास किए हैं मैट्रिक इंटर किए हैं वो जब पार्टी छोड़ के आ रहे हैं तो इसका मतलब कहीं ना कहीं उनके अंदर विद्रोह है। और ये प्रशांत किशोर हमारे बीच के नहीं है।
respondents.quote_english: We studied K.C. Sinha's mathematics in 8th-9th grade. At that time, that professor whose knowledge we gained from books, with whom we passed matric and inter, when he is leaving the party, it means there is some rebellion within him. And this Prashant Kishor is not from among us.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, speaking about political figures and local development.

respondents.key_reason: Votes are cast based on work and development, not just names. Nitin Navin (BJP) is known as the 'Road Man of Bihar' due to extensive infrastructure development. Prashant Kishor's agenda is solely focused on money, not genuine development.
respondents.quote_original: ये वोट उनके काम का पड़ेगा, उनके नाम से नहीं वोट पड़ेगा ये उनके काम का वोट पड़ेगा इस बार। विकास तो इतना हुआ है कि उन नितिन जी का नाम ऐसे ही रोड मैन ऑफ बिहार नहीं रखा गया। उनको बिहार का रोड मैन भी नाम दिया गया था नितिन गडकरी के द्वारा।
respondents.quote_english: This vote will be for their work, not for their name; this time, the vote will be for their work. So much development has happened that Nitin ji was not just named 'Road Man of Bihar' for nothing. He was also given the name 'Road Man of Bihar' by Nitin Gadkari.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, speaking about development and political figures.

respondents.key_reason: Prashant Kishor cheated a dedicated worker by wasting his money and selling his ticket. In contrast, BJP's candidate, Neeraj Kumar, is a local, accessible leader who is always available to help people.
respondents.quote_original: जब ये बख्तियारपुर से एक आम कार्यकर्ता पुरुषोत्तम कुमार इनके लिए इतना जी जान से लड़ा, उसके उसका 25 लाख रुपया इन्होंने बर्बाद कर दिया और टिकट 1 करोड़ में वहां का बेच दिया। वो बेचारा आज जन-जन के लिए गली-गली घूम के बता रहा है कि उसको वोट ना करें।
respondents.quote_english: When a common worker Purushottam Kumar from Bakhtiyarpur fought so hard for him, he wasted 25 lakh rupees of his and sold the ticket there for 1 crore. That poor fellow is now going door-to-door telling people not to vote for him.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, speaking about political figures and local issues.

respondents.key_reason: Leaders left Prashant Kishor's party because they realized he is a 'broker' and not a true leader. BJP is the biggest party and is committed to bringing development to the state and the country.
respondents.quote_original: अरे वो तीन नेता जो है प्रशांत किशोर के जो खामियां है उसको देख कर के वो जो है ब्रोकर है। और ये लोग नेता हैं। तो ब्रोकर के साथ तो नेता नहीं रह सकता है। इसलिए जो है उन्होंने जो है देश का देश की पार्टी जो है सबसे बड़ी पार्टी भाजपा उसमें आ गए।
respondents.quote_english: Those three leaders, seeing the flaws of Prashant Kishor, realized he is a broker. And these people are leaders. So a leader cannot stay with a broker. That's why they joined the country's biggest party, BJP.

respondents.key_reason: The leaders joining BJP will only benefit the BJP/NDA. Prashant Kishor's candidates will lose their deposits. Bankipur is a safe seat for NDA, and all voters are prepared to vote for NDA, ensuring their victory.
respondents.quote_original: यहां फायदे फायदे है। भाजपा को, एनडीए को फायदा है। ये अब जो है प्रशांत किशोर उनकी जमानत जब्त होने का ही नतीजा है। एक छोटे से वर्कर से उनको हराया जाएगा और जमानत जब्त किया जाएगा। ये स्थिति बांकीपुर में है।
respondents.quote_english: Here it's all benefits. BJP, NDA will benefit. This is the result of Prashant Kishor's deposit being forfeited. He will be defeated by a small worker and his deposit will be forfeited. This is the situation in Bankipur.

respondents.key_reason: BJP will win with a huge majority, and the talk of 'badlav' (change) is just empty rhetoric. BJP's seat in Bankipur will be retained, as no one can stop their victory.
respondents.quote_original: यहां बीजेपी रहेगा। बीजेपी एनडीए ही। यहां बीजेपी बहुत बहुत वोट से जीतने जा रहा है। और बीजेपी का यहां सीट बरकरार रहेगा। कोई रुकने नहीं जा रहा है।
respondents.quote_english: BJP will be here. BJP NDA. Here BJP is going to win by a huge margin. And BJP's seat will be retained here. No one is going to stop it.

respondents.key_reason: Leaders joining BJP is a natural political process. The real electoral battle is between BJP (expected to be number one) and RJD (expected to be number two), not with Prashant Kishor, who is not a serious contender.
respondents.quote_original: वो तो एक प्रक्रिया है लोग जॉइन कर रहा है। यहां जीत हार का लड़ाई ही नहीं है। यहां लड़ाई है एक नंबर और दो नंबर के। आरजेडी एक नंबर में दो नंबर में रहेगा कि प्रशांत किशोर तीन नंबर में रहेंगे इसका लड़ाई है। जीत उसमें कोई लड़ाई उड़ाई नहीं है।
respondents.quote_english: That's a process, people are joining. There is no fight for win or loss here. The fight is for number one and number two. Whether RJD will be number one or two, or Prashant Kishor will be number three, that's the fight. There is no fight for winning or losing.

respondents.key_reason: BJP already has a strong, dedicated vote bank (thok vote) and will win by a significant margin. Prashant Kishor's image is tarnished when his own people leave him, which is a common consequence.
respondents.quote_original: एक नंबर में तो भाजपा ऑलरेडी है ही है। दो तीन में दो में रहेगा आरजेडी और तीन में रहेगा प्रशांत किशोर। भाजपा का ठोक वोट है, एनडीए का ठोक वोट है। बहुत मार्जिन से जीतेगा लोग।
respondents.quote_english: BJP is already number one. RJD will be number two, and Prashant Kishor will be number three. BJP has a solid vote bank, NDA has a solid vote bank. They will win by a huge margin.

respondents.key_reason: When a leader's own people, especially strong candidates, abandon him at election time, it inevitably damages his image and highlights his weakness. This is what happened with Prashant Kishor.
respondents.quote_original: आपका आदमी कहीं चल जाएगा तो आपका छवि बढ़िया रहेगा? ये तो कॉमन बात है। ये लोग नजदीकी था, ये लोग का उम्मीदवार था, ये लोग वहां का सशक्त कार्यकर्ता थे और ये लोग छोड़ दिया। काहे छोड़ दिया भाई? और वो एन टाइम पर छोड़ दिया जब चुनाव ही लड़ने गए।
respondents.quote_english: If your people leave you, will your image be good? This is a common thing. These people were close, they were his candidates, they were strong workers there, and they left. Why did they leave, brother? And they left at the last minute when he went to contest the election.

respondents.key_reason: Bihar does not need a third political alternative; BJP is already actively working for development across the state and the country. Prashant Kishor is seen as someone who came from abroad to deceive people and create a false impression of a new political force, but his efforts are failing.
respondents.quote_original: तीसरा विकल्प का कोई जरूरत नहीं है। भारतीय जनता पार्टी बिहार में है और पूरे देश में है। विकल्प का कोई जरूरत है नहीं, ये काम हो रहा है बीजेपी सरकार में। बिहार में भी काम हो रहा है और आगे भी होगा। कमी तो कुछ है नहीं बीजेपी में।
respondents.quote_english: There is no need for a third alternative. Bharatiya Janata Party is in Bihar and across the country. There is no need for an alternative, work is being done by the BJP government. Work is happening in Bihar and will continue. There are no shortcomings in BJP.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, speaking about political alternatives and development.

respondents.key_reason: There has been extensive development in Bankipur, including hospitals, roads, electricity, and housing. Accusations of displacing the poor are false; those on government land are being relocated with proper arrangements.
respondents.quote_original: अरे बहुत विकास हुआ। क्या कमी नजर आ रहा है आपको? क्या चाहिए आपको बताइए? पानी भी मिल रहा है, सड़क भी है, बिजली भी है, घर मकान भी है। अब कुछ लोग आरोप लगाते हैं गरीब लोगों का घर घर को उजाड़ रहा है। तो हम कहते हैं जो सरकार की जमीन में कोई घर बना लिया तो सरकार की जमीन है ना? वो खाली करने के लिए बोलेगा ना?
respondents.quote_english: Oh, a lot of development has happened. What shortcomings do you see? What do you want, tell me? Water is available, roads are there, electricity is there, houses are there. Now some people accuse that houses of poor people are being demolished. So we say, if someone built a house on government land, it's government land, right? They will ask them to vacate it, right?
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, speaking about development and social issues.

respondents.key_reason: People do not trust Prashant Kishor's party, which is why leaders are joining BJP. If a leader's own family or party members leave, it reflects on the leader's inability to maintain trust and cohesion.
respondents.quote_original: नहीं नहीं भरोसा नहीं होगा प्रशांत किशोर के पार्टी पे। उनकी पार्टी पर भरोसा नहीं हुआ इसलिए बीजेपी पर भरोसा है इसलिए जुड़ रहे हैं। कोई भी जानते हैं एक में तो उनकी गलती है ना? मेरे परिवार का सदस्य अगर हमसे टूट रहा है तो मेरी गलती है।
respondents.quote_english: No, there is no trust in Prashant Kishor's party. There was no trust in his party, that's why they trust BJP and are joining. Anyone knows it's his fault, right? If a member of my family is breaking away from me, it's my fault.

respondents.key_reason: Prashant Kishor is a businessman, not a politician, and is not capable of managing Bihar. Politics is a tough job not suited for him. BJP has a strong cadre vote, and the public trusts BJP for development, so there will be no impact on the upcoming by-election.
respondents.quote_original: बिल्कुल सही बात है। वो तो एक व्यापारिक व्यापार करने वाले हैं ना? राजनीति करना बहुत टफ काम है। वो उनके हित में नहीं है। वो आगे ठहरेंगे कि नहीं ठहरेंगे इसके बाद नजर आएंगे कि नहीं आएंगे। कोई असर नहीं पड़ेगा। यहां बीजेपी का कैडर वोट है, बीजेपी को पड़ेगा, बीजेपी पर भरोसा करता है जनता।
respondents.quote_english: Absolutely correct. He is a businessman, right? Doing politics is a very tough job. It's not in his interest. Whether he will stay or not, whether he will be seen after this or not. There will be no effect. Here, BJP has a cadre vote, it will go to BJP, the public trusts BJP.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, speaking about political figures and party strength.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures strong public sentiment in Bankipur, predominantly in favor of the BJP and NDA. Interviewees consistently criticize Prashant Kishor, labeling him a 'broker' or 'businessman' primarily interested in financial gain rather than genuine public service or development. They highlight the extensive development work done by BJP leaders like Nitin Navin, including infrastructure, water supply, and women's empowerment, as key reasons for their support. The public expresses firm belief in the BJP's ability to govern and deliver, dismissing Prashant Kishor's party as lacking credibility and a viable alternative.

metadata.title: बांकीपुर चुनाव:  पटना के UCO पार्क से श्रीकांत प्रत्यूष का रैंडम सर्वे, चौकानेवाला है जनता का फैसला.
metadata.constituency_audit_reason: Video title and summary explicitly mention 'Bankipur' and 'election' in the context of local survey.

analysis.video_title: बांकीपुर चुनाव: पटना के UCO पार्क से श्रीकांत प्रत्यूष का रैंडम सर्वे, चौकानेवाला है जनता का फैसला.

respondents.key_reason: Believes BJP's victory is certain and is undecided on Prashant Kishor's impact.
respondents.quote_original: भाजपा जीतेगी। भाजपा की जीत तय है।
respondents.quote_english: BJP will win. BJP's victory is certain.

respondents.key_reason: Believes the RJD candidate will win, as Prashant Kishor is expected to split BJP's votes.
respondents.quote_original: बाकीपुर में राष्ट्रीय जनता दल के प्रत्याशी का जीत होना है। पीके जो है वो भाजपा के वोट को काटेंगे फिर राष्ट्रीय जनता दल जीतेगा।
respondents.quote_english: In Bankipur, the RJD candidate is certain to win. PK will cut into BJP's votes, then RJD will win.

respondents.key_reason: Confident that BJP will win, initially dismisses Prashant Kishor's immediate impact but ultimately believes BJP will prevail.
respondents.quote_original: भाजपा जीतेगी यहां से। अभी तक तो नहीं लग रहा है बाद में देखा जाए क्या। लेकिन अंत में भाजपा ही जीतेगी।
respondents.quote_english: BJP will win from here. For now, it doesn't seem so, we'll see later. But in the end, BJP will win.

respondents.key_reason: Believes Prashant Kishor has no real standing or impact and dismisses RJD's claims, asserting Bankipur is a BJP stronghold with a full majority.
respondents.quote_original: प्रशांत किशोर का कोई अस्तित्व है। प्रशांत किशोर तो बिन पेंदी का लोटा है। वो बाकीपुर सीट बीजेपी का है। कलम में जीतेगा।
respondents.quote_english: Prashant Kishor has no existence. Prashant Kishor is like a rolling stone. That Bankipur seat belongs to BJP. It will win with the lotus symbol.

respondents.key_reason: Acknowledges a tough contest and BJP's strength, but believes Prashant Kishor's efforts could lead to significant change if successful. Based on experience, expects a last-minute shift.
respondents.quote_original: कांटे का मुकाबला तो दिखाई दे रहा है लेकिन ये वोट में परिणत होगा कि नहीं इस पर डिपेंड करता है। बदलना चाहिए। इट विल चेंज एट द लास्ट मोमेंट।
respondents.quote_english: A tough contest is visible, but whether it converts into votes depends on that. It should change. It will change at the last moment.

respondents.key_reason: Believes BJP will lose in Bankipur.
respondents.quote_original: खत्म हो जाएगा बाकीपुर हारेगा अगर भाजपा तो।
respondents.quote_english: It will be over, Bankipur will lose if BJP wins.

respondents.key_reason: Believes in changing with the times and not relying on a single party. Previously voted for BJP.
respondents.quote_original: प्रशांत किशोर को। समय के अनुसार बदलना ना चाहिए। एक ही पर क्यों निर्भर रहेंगे?
respondents.quote_english: Prashant Kishor. One should change with time. Why depend on just one?

respondents.key_reason: Seeks change and a strong opposition for democracy. Previously supported BJP due to Nitin Nabin, but now feels BJP lacks a clear candidate.
respondents.quote_original: इस बार हम लोग कोशिश कर रहे हैं कि थोड़ा चेंज हो। बीजेपी नितिन नवीन के चलते बीजेपी के साथ थे। अभी जब बीजेपी को अपना कैंडिडेट पता नहीं है तो क्या करेगा आदमी? डेमोक्रेसी में अपोजिशन के लिए एक आदमी को डिस्कशन होना चाहिए।
respondents.quote_english: This time we are trying for some change. We were with BJP because of Nitin Nabin. Now that BJP doesn't even know its candidate, what will one do? In a democracy, there should be discussion for the opposition.

respondents.key_reason: Believes in a strong opposition for proper development and a healthy democracy. Sees Prashant Kishor as an unmatched candidate who can speak up. Even as a BJP supporter for the central government, she wants PK as the local MLA to ensure accountability and prevent monopoly.
respondents.quote_original: एकदम डेमोक्रेसी में अपोजिशन अच्छा होना चाहिए ताकि मतलब प्रॉपर डेवलपमेंट हो। वो बोल सके, एक बोलने वाला आदमी चाहिए और प्रशांत किशोर के टक्कर का मेरे को नहीं लगता और कोई कैंडिडेट है। अभी तो एकदम प्रशांत किशोर के साथ हैं। विधायक प्रशांत किशोर।
respondents.quote_english: In a democracy, the opposition should be good for proper development. Someone who can speak is needed, and I don't think there's any candidate to match Prashant Kishor. Right now, I am completely with Prashant Kishor. Prashant Kishor for MLA.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Adult female, likely a BJP supporter at the national level.

respondents.key_reason: Advocates for change in Bihar, believing it reflects the intelligence of the people.
respondents.quote_original: हमारा यही कहना था परिवर्तन होना चाहिए उसी के लिए सब लोग प्रयास कर रहे हैं। एक परिवर्तन हो बिहार में और ये मैसेज जाए कि बिहार की जनता अभी भी बहुत बुद्धिमान है।
respondents.quote_english: Our only point is that there should be change, and everyone is striving for that. Let there be change in Bihar, and let this message go out that the people of Bihar are still very intelligent.

respondents.key_reason: Supports BJP.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी को।
respondents.quote_english: BJP.

respondents.key_reason: Supports BJP.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी को।
respondents.quote_english: BJP.

respondents.key_reason: Changed preference from BJP to Prashant Kishor.
respondents.quote_original: प्रशांत ही किशोर को देंगे। पहले बीजेपी के।
respondents.quote_english: Will vote for Prashant Kishor. Earlier, BJP.

respondents.key_reason: Changed from BJP to Prashant Kishor due to high inflation and rising prices of essential goods, which negatively impact the poor and working class. Believes change is essential.
respondents.quote_original: नहीं प्रशांत किशोर को जिताना चाहिए। पहले तो बीजेपी को देते। काहे से कि महंगाई ज्यादा हो रहा है भैया। बिल्कुल बदलना जरूरी है।
respondents.quote_english: No, Prashant Kishor should win. Earlier, I used to vote for BJP. Because inflation is increasing, brother. It is absolutely necessary to change.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Adult male, concerned about economic issues.

respondents.key_reason: Confident that BJP will win.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी। बीजेपी जीतेगा।
respondents.quote_english: BJP. BJP will win.

respondents.key_reason: Expresses lack of knowledge or strong preference, indicating she will vote for anyone or is not actively campaigning.
respondents.quote_original: सर हम नहीं जानते। हम कोई को दे देना है वोट।
respondents.quote_english: Sir, I don't know. I'll give my vote to anyone.

respondents.key_reason: Prefers the previous government led by Nitish Kumar, crediting him for providing livelihood. Expresses some frustration but still leans towards him.
respondents.quote_original: पहले वाला सरकार बढ़िया था। नीतीश कुमार। हमनी के खाई कमाई जिए देल के।
respondents.quote_english: The previous government was good. Nitish Kumar. He gave us food, work, and life.

respondents.key_reason: Wants to vote for a candidate who genuinely works for the public.
respondents.quote_original: वही जो काम करे पब्लिक के लिए।
respondents.quote_english: The one who works for the public.

respondents.key_reason: Deeply cynical about politicians, believing they all make empty promises and only work for themselves. Feels compelled to vote due to lack of options but is disillusioned with the system, even raising citizenship concerns. Supports change to keep politicians accountable.
respondents.quote_original: बनने से पहले लोग बड़ी-बड़ी बातें बोलते हैं और बनने के बाद फिर वो अपना ही काम करना शुरू कर देते हैं तो इसीलिए किसी पे भी ट्रस्ट किया नहीं जा सकता। हम लोग के पास ऑप्शन नहीं है।
respondents.quote_english: Before getting elected, people make big promises, and after getting elected, they start working for themselves. That's why no one can be trusted. We don't have options.

respondents.key_reason: Believes in giving new people a chance and that change is a natural law. Wants Prashant Kishor to get an opportunity to prove himself.
respondents.quote_original: जन सुराज। प्रशांत किशोर। किसी नए को मौका देना चाहिए। परिवर्तन ही मतलब संसार का नियम है।
respondents.quote_english: Jan Suraaj. Prashant Kishor. A new person should be given a chance. Change is the law of the world.

respondents.key_reason: Finds it difficult to predict the winner but views Prashant Kishor positively as a good person.
respondents.quote_original: ऐसा कहना मुश्किल है बट प्रशांत किशोर इज अ गुड गाय, अच्छे हैं।
respondents.quote_english: It's difficult to say, but Prashant Kishor is a good guy, he's good.

respondents.key_reason: Supports leaders who promote education and ensure that genuinely deserving candidates win. Believes Prashant Kishor is more capable.
respondents.quote_original: प्रशांत किशोर जी। हमेशा से एक ऐसी चीज का साथ देते हैं जहां पे कुछ एजुकेशन को प्रमोट किया जाए। प्रशांत किशोर ज्यादा योग्य हैं? जी हां मुझे लगता है।
respondents.quote_english: Prashant Kishor. Always supports something that promotes education. Is Prashant Kishor more capable? Yes, I think so.

respondents.key_reason: Believes only the BJP (Kamal Chhap) will win in Bankipur. Dismisses Prashant Kishor as not being a local or relevant candidate, citing his past electoral failures and high-profile image as unnecessary for Bankipur.
respondents.quote_original: बाकीपुर से जो भी है उसका नाम होगा सिर्फ कमल छाप। प्रशांत किशोर का जरूरत बाकीपुर को नहीं है।
respondents.quote_english: Whoever is from Bankipur, their name will only be Lotus symbol. Bankipur does not need Prashant Kishor.

respondents.key_reason: Feels BJP might win.
respondents.quote_original: मुझको तो नहीं लग रहा है अब देखिए बीजेपी शायद हो सकता है।
respondents.quote_english: I don't think so, but maybe BJP can win.

respondents.key_reason: Wants the incumbent government to continue.
respondents.quote_original: जो सरकार में है वो ही।
respondents.quote_english: The one who is in government.

respondents.key_reason: Believes Prashant Kishor is good in all aspects – educated, sensible, thinks for Bihar and its people, has a clean image, and deserves a chance.
respondents.quote_original: प्रशांत किशोर को। अच्छे हर मामला में अच्छे हैं। पढ़े लिखे हुए हैं, समझदार हैं, सोचते हैं बिहार के लिए लोगों के जनता के लिए। मौका मिलना चाहिए।
respondents.quote_english: Prashant Kishor. He is good in every aspect. He is educated, sensible, thinks for Bihar and its people. He should get a chance.

respondents.key_reason: Initially neutral, but leans towards Prashant Kishor when pressed.
respondents.quote_original: जेकरा कहिए जिता देंगे। प्रशांत किशोर।
respondents.quote_english: Whoever you say, we will make them win. Prashant Kishor.

respondents.key_reason: Supports Prashant Kishor because he is a new face.
respondents.quote_original: प्रशांत किशोर। नया नया आदमी है।
respondents.quote_english: Prashant Kishor. He is a new person.

respondents.key_reason: No strong preference, will go with whatever is suggested.
respondents.quote_original: जिसको कहिए अभी।
respondents.quote_english: Whoever you say right now.

respondents.key_reason: Not a local resident but favors Prashant Kishor.
respondents.quote_original: हम फेवर करते हैं प्रशांत किशोर को।
respondents.quote_english: I favor Prashant Kishor.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Adult male, not a local resident.

respondents.key_reason: Unaware of candidates and still thinking about who to support.
respondents.quote_original: हम तो जान में नहीं करते हैं कौन कौन। अभी सोच रहे हैं।
respondents.quote_english: I don't even know who the candidates are. Still thinking.

respondents.key_reason: Believes there's a strong wave of change (parivartan) against BJP due to Mahagathbandhan's candidate (Rekha Gupta) and issues like inflation and unemployment. Highlights RJD as a party of social justice and believes in silent voters. Criticizes BJP's long dominance and alleged mistreatment of communities.
respondents.quote_original: महागठबंधन के उम्मीदवार रेखा गुप्ता को बनाया है। लोगों के मन में परिवर्तन इस बार 40 साल बनाम 4 साल का नारा लोगों ने दिया है। महंगाई बेरोजगारी का जो नारा था उसमें जो लोगों को ठगा उसको लोगों ने सोच लिया मन बना लिया।
respondents.quote_english: Mahagathbandhan has fielded Rekha Gupta as its candidate. People have given the slogan of '40 years vs 4 years' for change this time. People have decided against BJP due to inflation and unemployment.

respondents.key_reason: Believes that despite Mahagathbandhan's candidate, the Vaishya community remains a core voter base for BJP, ensuring their victory. Dismisses other factors.
respondents.quote_original: ये तो कोर वोटर भाजपा का है। वैश्य समुदाय तो कोर वोटर है भारतीय जनता पार्टी का। ये सब नहीं चलेगा बीजेपी।
respondents.quote_english: This is BJP's core voter. The Vaishya community is a core voter of the Bharatiya Janata Party. All this won't work, BJP will win.

respondents.key_reason: Advocates for voting for an honest candidate with a clean image. Believes the public should identify such a candidate. Clarifies he is not a local voter.
respondents.quote_original: जनता ये समझ ले कि ईमानदार आदमी कौन है मैं आग्रह करता हूं जनता से कि ईमानदार आदमी के वोट दे। दर्जनों उम्मीदवार खड़ा है उनमें से सबसे स्वच्छ छवि के जो है उन्हीं को वोट दें।
respondents.quote_english: The day the public understands who the honest person is, I urge the public to vote for the honest person. There are dozens of candidates, vote for the one with the cleanest image.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Adult male, associated with Sharad Yadav, not a local voter.

respondents.key_reason: Believes BJP's victory in Bankipur is certain with no real competition. Dismisses Prashant Kishor as not a true leader and predicts he won't even save his deposit. Advocates for voting for a local, grassroots leader.
respondents.quote_original: बाकीपुर में बीजेपी तय है। दूसरा कोई टक्कर में नहीं है। प्रशांत किशोर हवा में चले जाएंगे। आप वो घर के नेता के ना दीजिएगा।
respondents.quote_english: BJP is certain in Bankipur. There is no other competition. Prashant Kishor will vanish into thin air. You should vote for the local leader.

respondents.key_reason: Supports BJP due to its long-standing victory record and it being a traditional seat. Highlights Nitin Nabin's soft-spoken nature, good public relations, and his continued influence even without directly contesting.
respondents.quote_original: इतने दिनों से जीत रही है बीजेपी और उसका ट्रेडिशनल सीट है प्लस नवीन नितिन नवीन जो हैं। वो बहुत मुलायम किस्म के आदमी हैं। नितिन नवीन के जो रिश्ते हैं वो इस चुनाव में काम आते दिखाई दे रहे हैं।
respondents.quote_english: BJP has been winning for so long, and it's its traditional seat, plus Nitin Nabin. He is a very gentle person. Nitin Nabin's connections are seen to be working in this election.

respondents.key_reason: Believes Bihar has a history of change (citing JP Movement). Acknowledges BJP's strength but sees Prashant Kishor's efforts as a potential catalyst for significant change. Emphasizes democracy where the public decides, not a fixed outcome based on past dominance.
respondents.quote_original: बिहार जो है परिवर्तन के लिए मशहूर रहा है। एक प्रयास तो प्रशांत किशोर कर रहे हैं। एक प्रयास में अगर वो सफल हो जाते हैं तो शायद संभवतः बिहार के लिए भी बहुत बड़ी चीज होगी। हम लोग चाहते हैं कि परिवर्तन हो।
respondents.quote_english: Bihar is famous for change. Prashant Kishor is making an effort. If he succeeds, it could be a big thing for Bihar. We want change.

respondents.key_reason: Believes caste politics are deeply entrenched in Bihar and cannot be easily changed. Supports BJP, implying it's the only viable option given the political landscape.
respondents.quote_original: बिहार में जात पात कोई मिटा सकता है? ये सब नहीं चलेगा बीजेपी।
respondents.quote_english: Can anyone erase casteism in Bihar? All this won't work, BJP will win.

respondents.key_reason: Expresses uncertainty about the election outcome and seems resigned to whatever happens.
respondents.quote_original: ओ मैंने ये इलेक्शन में कुछ जो होवे कोई निरप हम हमेशा।
respondents.quote_english: Oh, in this election, whatever happens, I am always neutral.

respondents.key_reason: Believes Amit Shah's election management and technology are superior, making it impossible for anyone, including Prashant Kishor, to win against BJP. Predicts BJP's victory.
respondents.quote_original: अमित शाह का जो इलेक्शन टेक्नोलॉजी है उसके सामने अभी भारतवर्ष में हजारों प्रशांत किशोर भी नहीं जीत सकते हैं। खत्म हो जाएगा बाकीपुर हारेगा अगर भाजपा तो।
respondents.quote_english: Against Amit Shah's election technology, thousands of Prashant Kishors cannot win in India. Bankipur will be finished if BJP loses.

respondents.key_reason: Expresses disillusionment with the political system, implying that outcomes are manipulated. Acknowledges Prashant Kishor's good standing among intellectuals but criticizes the BJP candidate's poor communication skills, yet predicts the BJP candidate will win due to the 'system.'
respondents.quote_original: जो नहीं होना चाहिए वही हो रहा है तो बोलना क्या है। प्रशांत किशोर का पोजीशन अच्छा है। लेकिन फिर भी उसको 1 लाख वोट से जिताए। ये आपका सिस्टम है।
respondents.quote_english: What shouldn't be happening is happening, so what's there to say? Prashant Kishor's position is good. But still, they made him win by 1 lakh votes. This is your system.

respondents.key_reason: Refuses to discuss politics, stating that as a former bureaucrat, he followed rules. Expresses disillusionment with the current system, implying that individual preferences don't matter when the system itself is flawed.
respondents.quote_original: नहीं देखिए हम पॉलिटिक्स में बात नहीं करते हैं। व्यवस्था ही गड़बड़ है तो अब क्या कीजिएगा।
respondents.quote_english: No, I don't talk about politics. If the system itself is flawed, what can you do?

respondents.key_reason: Supports BJP.
respondents.quote_original: यहीं के वोटर हैं। बीजेपी।
respondents.quote_english: I am a voter from here. BJP.

respondents.key_reason: Initially expresses uncertainty but leans towards Prashant Kishor when pressed, confirming he votes.
respondents.quote_original: अंतिम में हम सब लोग नहीं जानते हैं। प्रशांत ही किशोर को देंगे।
respondents.quote_english: In the end, we all don't know. We will vote for Prashant Kishor.

respondents.key_reason: Believes the winner is the true leader, indicating a neutral stance on who should win.
respondents.quote_original: जो जीते वो सिकंदर है।
respondents.quote_english: Whoever wins is the conqueror.

respondents.key_reason: Not eligible to vote.
respondents.quote_original: हमरा हमनी का वोट है ये नहीं है।
respondents.quote_english: We don't have a vote.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video presents a random survey from UCO Park in Bankipur, Patna, revealing mixed public opinions on the upcoming election. While many respondents express firm support for BJP, a significant number are leaning towards or firmly supporting Prashant Kishor, often citing a desire for change, a strong opposition, or dissatisfaction with inflation. Some voters previously supported BJP but have now shifted their allegiance, indicating a dynamic and potentially unpredictable electoral landscape in Bankipur.
