analysis.video_title: Bankipur By Election 2026 : बांकीपुर में कौन किसका खेल बिगाड़ेगा? | Ground Report | Public Reaction

respondents.key_reason: Believes Jan Suraaj candidate is educated and the current BJP candidate is just a 'pocket man' of Nitin Navin. The BJP candidate change won't make a difference.
respondents.quote_original: फर्क पड़ेगा, जन सुराज पूरा एकदम बहुमत से हम लोग उनको ला रहे हैं और सबसे बड़ी बात है कि पढ़ा लिखा आदमी है। ई तो जो कैंडिडेट बदले हैं ई तो नितिन नवीन जी के पैकेट के आदमी और अभी भी जो नया कैंडिडेट दिए हैं वो भी वही है। तो ई चाहते हैं कि हमारा पैकेट के आदमी यहां माने ये बने।
respondents.quote_english: It will make a difference, Jan Suraaj is bringing him with full majority and the biggest thing is that he is an educated person. The candidate they changed, he is Nitin Navin ji's pocket man, and even the new candidate they have given is the same. So they want their pocket man to become this.

respondents.key_reason: Initially supported BJP, but now shifting due to BJP playing caste politics by changing candidates. If BJP supports its caste, then he will support his own community's candidate (Prashant Kishor).
respondents.quote_original: बोले हैं कि जातिवाद पे अभी कैंडिडेट दिए हैं। बोला गया देखिए हम महतो, चौधरी, कुर्मी, कोई भी खड़ा होता है तो हम लोग वोट देते थे मोदी जी को। हम भी 25 साल से मोदी जी को बीजेपी को वोट दे रहे थे। लेकिन इस बार लाला समाज क्या बोल रहा है कि हम लाला कोई खड़ा होगा तब हम लोग उसको समर्थन करेंगे।
respondents.quote_english: They said they gave the candidate based on casteism. See, if Mahto, Chaudhary, Kurmi, anyone stands, we used to vote for Modi ji. We have been voting for Modi ji, BJP for 25 years. But this time, what is the Lala community saying? That if a Lala stands, then we will support him.

respondents.key_reason: BJP changed candidate because they realized they couldn't win against Jan Suraaj's senior leader. The new candidate is not strong enough. People want an educated, capable candidate.
respondents.quote_original: लगा कि इनके सामने हम टिक नहीं पाएंगे। जनसुराज के जो वरिष्ठ नेता खड़े हैं, तो उनके सामने हम टिक नहीं पाएंगे, जिसके कारण जो है वो अपना सिलेंडर बोल दिए। हर मामले में माने वो हर चीज में। लेकिन आरजेडी वाला कह रहा है कि रेखा गुप्ता को देखे तो उनको लगा कि उनका जो उम्मीदवार है थोड़ा कमजोर है इसलिए बदल देते हैं। नहीं नहीं ऐसी कोई बात नहीं है। उम्मीदवार कमजोर नहीं होता है वो जनता के ऊपर निर्भर करता है। जनता जिनको चाहे जिता सकता है। तो जनता के सामने जो है ये होना चाहिए कि मेरा उम्मीदवार कैसा है। शिक्षित है, कर्मयोगी है, कर्मठ है, कैसा है।
respondents.quote_english: They felt they couldn't stand against him. The senior leader of Jan Suraaj who is standing, they couldn't stand against him, which is why they surrendered. In every matter, they are strong. But RJD is saying that after seeing Rekha Gupta, they felt their candidate was weak, so they changed. No, no, that's not the case. A candidate is not weak; it depends on the public. The public can make anyone win. So, before the public, it should be clear what kind of candidate I have. Is he educated, a karma yogi, dedicated, what is he like?

respondents.key_reason: The new BJP candidate (Neeraj Sinha) is young (29-30 years old) and unknown, unlike the previous candidate. BJP is giving tickets to inexperienced people. They have always voted for BJP but will change this time for Prashant Kishor.
respondents.quote_original: 29 से 30 साल उसका उम्र होगा, वैसे वैसे लोग प्रत्याशी आएंगे। उससे बड़े-बड़े भी नेता हैं। उनको टिकट देना चाहिए। आए नील रतन घोष जी का नाम आ रहा था, उनसे ज्यादा कोई है। उनके पिताजी के समय से हैं वो। और टिकट उनका ये क्या नाम है नीरज सिन्हा। इसको कोई जानता है पहले? आए बस मामूली बूथ अध्यक्ष है क्या उम्र क्या है उनका? 29 से 30 साल उम्र है। ऐसे ऐसे लोग को टिकट दे रहा है। पहले तो बंटी जी को दिया। देखा कि अब मेरा लग रहा है सुपरा साफ है इसीलिए इनको उतारा गया। अब लग रहा है इसीलिए हम लोग मन बनाए कि इस बार प्रशांत जी को एकदम भारी बहुमत से। सब दिन हम लोग बीजेपी को ही वोट देते आए हैं लेकिन इस बार एकदम बदल देना है।
respondents.quote_english: He must be 29-30 years old, such people will come as candidates. There are bigger leaders than him. They should be given tickets. Neel Ratan Ghosh ji's name was coming, is there anyone more than him? He is from his father's time. And his ticket, what's his name, Neeraj Sinha. Does anyone know him before? He's just a normal booth president, what's his age? 29-30 years old. They are giving tickets to such people. First, they gave it to Bunty ji. They saw that their chances were looking slim, so they fielded him. Now it seems, that's why we have decided that this time Prashant ji will win with a huge majority. We have always voted for BJP, but this time we have to change it completely.

respondents.key_reason: Prashant Kishor is a senior and intelligent leader, known as 'Chanakya of Bihar.' He has proven his capabilities in other states. They believe he will bring development to Bihar.
respondents.quote_original: सबको अपना-अपना बोलना है, अपना पार्टी का सब बड़ाई करेगा। लेकिन हम लोग का तो मानना है कि प्रशांत किशोर सबसे मतलब वरिष्ठ नेता हैं और सबसे मतलब बुद्धि में भी अच्छे हैं। आप लोग तो पहले से जान रहे हैं कि बिहार का चाणक्य उनको कहा जाता है। जैसे कि कोलकाता का चुनाव देख लीजिए, तमिलनाडु का चुनाव देख लीजिए। जब इतना दूसरे ड्रेस में जाके इतना दूसरे जगह आ जाके इतना कर सकते हैं तो अपने बिहार में कितना करेंगे? तो इसीलिए हम लोग प्रशांत किशोर के साथ हैं इस बार और इस बार पूरे बहुमत से प्रशांत किशोर को हम लोग विजय बनाएंगे।
respondents.quote_english: Everyone will speak for themselves, everyone will praise their own party. But we believe that Prashant Kishor is the most senior leader and also the most intelligent. You all know that he is called the Chanakya of Bihar. For example, look at the elections in Kolkata, look at the elections in Tamil Nadu. When he can do so much in other states, how much will he do in Bihar? That's why we are with Prashant Kishor this time, and this time we will make Prashant Kishor victorious with a full majority.

respondents.key_reason: BJP has done a lot of development work (nalas, roads, boring, house construction). They believe the new candidate is good because BJP promotes grassroots workers, not just based on age. They criticize Prashant Kishor for not giving time to people.
respondents.quote_original: तो चलने वाले ही खुद बताएंगे कि कितना विकास हुआ है। कौन ब्लाइंड कहता है कि विकास नहीं हुआ है। जो आज इतने ही लड़का लोग जो इंटरव्यू दे रहे हैं बेवकूफ लोग, मैं तो मुंह पर बोलती हूं। ये नाला किसके कारण बना है? सुमित्रा देवी रही मंत्री यहां। फिर भी वो उसके मीरा कुमार रही लोकसभा के अध्यक्ष रहे। वो क्या कर ली? यहां की बहू थी, नाला पर की बहू थी, क्या की? मेरे माननीय जी चार बार उसको माने दिक्कत पहुंचाया गया अगेंस्ट पार्टी वाला। फिर भी वो प्रण ठाने थे कि हम इस नाला को हम बना के रहेंगे और जनता के लिए सुविधा देकर रहेंगे। ये गली, ये नल जल को जो ये योजना दिया गया है वहां बोरिंग भी हो गई है। आप भी देखिएगा तीन चार जगह बोरिंग हुई है। कौन कराया है? प्रशांत किशोर करा दिया। आज हम घर को बना दिए और प्रशांत किशोर ऑफर देगा कि हम आपके एको रूम में टाइल्स लगा देंगे तो हम अपने घर को उसको दे देंगे? अरे उम्र से क्या लेना है? भाजपा में तो यही अच्छाई है कि एक-एक जमीनी कार्यकर्ता को ऊंचे पद पर पहुंचाते हैं।
respondents.quote_english: Those who walk will themselves tell how much development has happened. Who says blindly that development has not happened? These foolish young people who are giving interviews today, I tell them directly. Who built this drain? Sumitra Devi was a minister here. Even then, Meira Kumar was the Speaker of the Lok Sabha. What did she do? She was the daughter-in-law of this place, the daughter-in-law of the drain, what did she do? My honorable leader was troubled four times by the opposing party. Still, he vowed that we will build this drain and provide facilities for the public. This street, this tap water scheme that has been given, boring has also been done there. You will also see boring has been done in three-four places. Who did it? Prashant Kishor did it? Today we have built the house, and Prashant Kishor will offer to put tiles in one of your rooms, so will we give our house to him? What does age have to do with it? This is the good thing about BJP, that they promote every grassroots worker to a high position.

respondents.key_reason: Criticizes BJP's development work, stating that drains are just covered, not properly built, and roads are of poor quality due to corruption. Believes Nitin Navin (BJP) thinks it's his ancestral seat, but Prashant Kishor will win.
respondents.quote_original: केवल नाला के रोड को केवल तोप दिया गया है। उसके साथ अभी भी जाइए आप पानी पड़ा है जाके देखिए कितना पानी लगा हुआ है नाला पर। अब कोई क्वालिटी नहीं है। और जहां तक कि ये रोड के बात बोल रहे हैं तो आगे जाके आप खुद कैमरा ऐसे देख लीजिएगा कि क्या स्थिति है अभी महीना नहीं हुआ है रोड ढलाए हुए। क्या स्थिति है? यहां तो बीजेपी के अथि में इतना ना कमीशन लोग ले लेता है कि ठेकेदार बेचारा क्या काम करेगा? इसलिए कोई क्वालिटी नहीं है यहां। और अमरी बार तो नितिन नवीन जी जो चाह रहे हैं कि एकदम मेरा बपौती सीट है ऐसा होने नहीं जा रहा है। अमरी बार प्रशांत किशोर जी यहां से जीतेंगे और हम सारे लोग लग चुके पूरा माने ये पूरे मोहल्ला के एकतरफा वोट जा रहे हैं।
respondents.quote_english: The drain road has only been covered. Even now, if you go, there's water, go and see how much water is accumulated on the drain. There's no quality. And as for this road, if you go ahead, you can see for yourself with the camera what the situation is; it hasn't even been a month since the road was laid. What's the situation? Here, in BJP's work, people take so much commission that what will the contractor do? So there's no quality here. And this time, Nitin Navin ji, who thinks this is his ancestral seat, that's not going to happen. This time Prashant Kishor ji will win from here, and all of us have joined in, meaning the entire locality is voting one-sided.

respondents.key_reason: Believes that if there are defects in development projects, the current 'Honorable Minister' (referring to BJP's work) will fix them. Compares it to a son looting if the father asks him to build a house.
respondents.quote_original: योजना में अगर डिफेक्टिव हुआ है, कुछ भी हुआ है हम दम ताल ठोक के कहते हैं तो मेरे माननीय जी ही सुधारेंगे। मेरे माननीय जी के विधानसभा का ही कार्यक्रम है। लूट खसोट तो एक घर में काम कराइए तो एक बेटा का भी जिम्मेवारी दे दीजिएगा ना तो बेटा भी लूटने लगता है अगर बाप कहता है बाबू तुम बना दो जड़ी घर।
respondents.quote_english: If there is a defect in the scheme, or anything has happened, I say with conviction that my honorable leader will fix it. This is a program of my honorable leader's constituency. As for looting, if you get work done in a house and give responsibility to a son, even the son starts looting if the father says, 'Son, build the house.'

respondents.key_reason: Defends BJP's work, stating that the previous candidate (Naval Bhaiya) worked for BJP and BJP has done a lot of development. Accuses others of trying to take credit.
respondents.quote_original: अरे देखिए, नाला वही ना लूटेगा। नाला वही ना लूटेगा। नवल भैया, यही नवल भैया। नवल भैया यही बीजेपी में काम करते थे। और बीजेपी और बीजेपी और बीजेपी इतना काम करवाया। और बीजेपी इतना आगे बढ़ाया। और बीजेपी को धोखा देके।
respondents.quote_english: Oh, look, only the drain will be looted. Only the drain will be looted. Naval Bhaiya, this Naval Bhaiya. Naval Bhaiya used to work in BJP. And BJP, and BJP, and BJP got so much work done. And BJP advanced so much. And by betraying BJP.

respondents.key_reason: Believes that the current system is about making money, and public money is being misused.
respondents.quote_original: ये तो कमाई का जरिया बन चुका है। अब पैसा किसका जा रहा है? जनता का जा रहा है।
respondents.quote_english: This has become a source of income. Whose money is going now? The public's money is going.

respondents.key_reason: Defends the quality of work done, stating that if a house is built, it's not broken to be rebuilt. Implies that if there are defects, they know where they are.
respondents.quote_original: मेरी बात सुनिए, हम घर बना हुआ है हम उसको तोड़ के बनाते हैं कि नहीं बनाते हैं। तो मेरी बर्बादी हुई। वो हम जान रहे हैं कि कहां डिफेक्टिव है।
respondents.quote_english: Listen to me, if a house is built, do we break it to rebuild it or not? So my ruin happened. We know where the defect is.

respondents.key_reason: Prashant Kishor is well-spoken, educated, experienced ('old is gold'), and has a proven track record. He deserves a chance.
respondents.quote_original: देखिए जनता के चुनाव यहां के जनता के चुनाव तो भी प्रशांत किशोरी हैं। इसलिए है कि वो बोलने में भी ठीक है, पढ़े लिखे भी हैं, समझदार भी है ओल्ड इज गोल्ड है। सारा जगह वो सब चीज करके दिखा चुके हैं। आदमी सब देखा भी है। मगर इस बार प्रशांत किशोर के एक मौका मिलेगा ही मिलेगा।
respondents.quote_english: Look, in the public election, the public's choice here is Prashant Kishor. He is good at speaking, educated, sensible, 'old is gold'. He has shown his work everywhere. People have seen it too. But this time, Prashant Kishor will definitely get a chance.

respondents.key_reason: BJP has ruled for 30 years, but the drain was only built recently, implying they only act when their power is threatened. This time, BJP's 'card is about to be cut.'
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी 30 साल से यहां राज कर रही है तो 30 साल से जब राज कर रही थी तो जो नाला बना ये 30 साल पहले मतलब जो इसमें बहुत समय आया उस समय बनना चाहिए था। इतना समय इतना बार टेंडर पास हुआ इतना बार सब कुछ हुआ। उस समय नहीं बना। इस बार बना। इस बार इसलिए बना कि इनका पत्ता अब कटने वाला है।
respondents.quote_english: BJP has been ruling here for 30 years, so when they were ruling for 30 years, the drain that was built, it should have been built 30 years ago, there was a lot of time in between. So much time, so many tenders passed, so much happened. It wasn't built then. It was built this time. It was built this time because their card is about to be cut.

respondents.key_reason: Prashant Kishor is capable, educated, and will bring change and improve the system. There is no other capable leader like him in Bihar.
respondents.quote_original: प्रशांत किशोर को वोट देंगे। किस मुद्दा पर दीजिएगा? कुछ सोचे हैं मुद्दा कि ये काम करेगा इसलिए इसको मिलेगा? इसलिए कि योग्य है, शिक्षित है। ये कुछ करेगा। अरे सबको मौका दिया, ये परिवर्तन करेगा। समाज में जो व्यवस्था है उनको परिवर्तन करेगा। इसके ऐसे योग्य नेता अभी बिहार में है नहीं।
respondents.quote_english: We will vote for Prashant Kishor. On what issue will you vote? Have you thought about an issue, that he will work, so he will get it? Because he is capable, educated. He will do something. Everyone has been given a chance, he will bring change. He will change the system in society. There is no other capable leader like him in Bihar right now.

respondents.key_reason: Believes the BJP candidate (Abhishek Sinha) withdrew due to fear, not family reasons. It's an excuse because he couldn't win.
respondents.quote_original: क्या करें वो तो अपने डर गया। उनसे डर गया कि इनके। लेकिन बीजेपी के जो प्रत्याशी थे अभिषेक सिन्हा वो बोले कि पारिवारिक कारण की वजह से अपना थोड़ा नामांकन वापस ले रहे हैं। ये तो बहाना है ना। अपना पे इल्जाम देना नहीं है। अपना अयोग्यता को बताएगा कि नहीं मुझे क्या कमी है। बता देगा कि भाई फलाना पारिवारिक है ये चीज है वो चीज है।
respondents.quote_english: What to do, he got scared himself. He got scared of them. But BJP's candidate Abhishek Sinha said he was withdrawing his nomination due to family reasons. This is just an excuse. He doesn't want to blame himself. Will he tell about his incompetence, what shortcomings he has? He will say that so-and-so is family, this and that.

respondents.key_reason: Critical of Prashant Kishor, stating he doesn't answer questions from the public and just pushes them away. Believes talking about him is useless.
respondents.quote_original: आएंगे तो आप सब कोई देखेगा। बोलने से कोई फायदा नहीं है। जो आएगा देखेगा ही। बहुत लोग ये भी बोल रहा है कि प्रशांत किशोर आए हैं तो कुछ नया करेंगे, कुछ। अरे बोलते हैं, परसों ही आए थे रैली में। आए हैं कुछ बात एक पब्लिक पूछे उनसे कि सर आप आइएगा तो आप आगे क्या कीजिएगा। धकेल दिए उसको। क्या बोलेंगे उनके बारे में? कोई बोलना ही बेकार है।
respondents.quote_english: If he comes, everyone will see. There's no point in talking. Whoever comes, people will see. Many people are also saying that Prashant Kishor has come, so he will do something new. Oh, they say, he came to the rally the day before yesterday. He came, and a member of the public asked him, 'Sir, if you come, what will you do next?' He pushed them away. What will you say about him? It's useless to say anything.

respondents.key_reason: Believes the BJP candidate change is an internal party matter and won't make a difference until the new candidate speaks and holds rallies.
respondents.quote_original: अच्छा एक बात बताइए बीजेपी वाला प्रत्याशी अपना बदला है कल तो क्या लग रहा है क्या कारण था इसका? प्रॉब्लम होगा, कुछ प्रॉब्लम होगा अंदर की बात। चुनाव पारिवारिक कारण बताए हैं। जो भी बात हो अपना वो अंदर का बात होगा अपना हट गए होंगे। तो कोई अंतर पड़ेगा अब? मतलब पहले अभिषेक सिन्हा थे वो और अभी जो नए आए हैं नीरज। जो नए आए हैं वो आएंगे वो तो वो बताएंगे ना अब वो रैली में आएंगे उसके बाद ही ना कुछ होगा।
respondents.quote_english: Okay, tell me one thing, BJP changed its candidate yesterday, so what do you think was the reason? There must be some problem, some internal problem. They cited family reasons for the election. Whatever the matter, it must be an internal party matter, they must have withdrawn. So will it make any difference now? I mean, earlier it was Abhishek Sinha, and now the new one is Neeraj. The new ones will come, they will tell, something will happen only after they come to the rally.

respondents.key_reason: BJP has done significant development work, including roads and drains, which has improved connectivity and sanitation. They believe BJP will win.
respondents.quote_original: गांव का माहौल जैसा पहले रहता था वैसा बीजेपी की सरकार आएगी। क्योंकि जो यहां पे प्रगति का कार्य किया गया, जो सबसे अहम मुद्दा नाला था। पहले लोग उसमें डूब के गिर के मर जाते थे, गंदगी फैली रहती थी। अभी उससे बेहतर विकल्प मिला है, एक मेन रोड बना है, हाईवे बना है जो कि मरीन ड्राइव से कनेक्ट होगा। प्रारंभिक रूप पे पहली बार हिसाब है जिसमें कंस्ट्रक्शन हुआ है, कहीं पे जल जमाव हो रहा है। ये सब जगह होता है। अब उसको सुधारा जा रहा है। तो यहां सब जनता को भी पता है कि कितना बड़ा ये सौगात है। पहले मंदिरी को अपना रोड नहीं था। आज नाला बनने से हम लोग मेन रोड से कनेक्टिविटी हो गए हैं, जो विकास का सबसे बड़ा मुद्दा है। और यहां से हम लोग क्लियर हैं कि बीजेपी यहां से निकल रही है।
respondents.quote_english: The village atmosphere will be as it was before, BJP's government will come. Because the development work done here, the most important issue was the drain. Earlier people used to drown and die in it, filth was spread. Now a better alternative has been found, a main road has been built, a highway has been built which will connect to Marine Drive. For the first time, there is an account where construction has happened, waterlogging is happening somewhere. This happens everywhere. Now it is being improved. So everyone here knows how big a gift this is. Earlier Mandiri didn't have its own road. Today, with the construction of the drain, we have connectivity to the main road, which is the biggest issue of development. And from here, we are clear that BJP is winning from here.

respondents.key_reason: BJP is struggling to find a strong candidate to compete with Prashant Kishor, indicating his strength.
respondents.quote_original: कि वैसा कैंडिडेट मिल जाए कि टक्कर हो। बीजेपी वाले लोग के पास तो अभी कोई टक्कर के लिए है नहीं। प्रशांत किशोर जी का जुलूस देख के, भीड़ देख के बीजेपी वाला लोग हरक गया है कि वैसा कैंडिडेट खोज लें। तो वैसा कैंडिडेट मिला नहीं उनको।
respondents.quote_english: That they find such a candidate who can compete. BJP people don't have anyone to compete with right now. Seeing Prashant Kishor ji's procession, seeing the crowd, BJP people are scared and are looking for such a candidate. But they haven't found such a candidate.

respondents.key_reason: Dismisses BJP's claims, stating that BJP itself brings paid crowds to rallies, while Prashant Kishor's crowd is genuine.
respondents.quote_original: आप देखिए बीजेपी वाला कुछ भी बात बना देगा तो वैसा थोड़ी होगा। आरजेडी देखिए अब अपना अपना ये है कि भाई कोई भी कुछ बोल दे बोल देगा तो वैसा थोड़ी है अब कल परसों में ये आपका प्रशांत किशोर जी का चीना कोठी में था प्रोग्राम था उसमें मतलब हम भी थे तो उसमें क्या हुआ था कि भीड़ देख के बीजेपी वाले लोग ने बोल रहे थे कि ये जो भीड़ है ये खरीदा हुआ भीड़ है। तो मतलब बीजेपी वाले लोग जो भीड़ लेके चलते हैं वो खरीदा हुआ मतलब नहीं रहता है भीड़। मतलब जनसुराज जी के साथ जो है वही खरीदा हुआ रहता है भीड़।
respondents.quote_english: Look, BJP will make up any story, but that's not how it is. RJD, see, everyone has their own thing, if anyone says anything, it's not like that. Just yesterday or the day before, Prashant Kishor ji had a program at China Kothi, and I was also there. So what happened was that seeing the crowd, BJP people were saying that this crowd is a bought crowd. So, the crowd that BJP people bring, that's not a bought crowd. But the crowd that is with Jan Suraaj ji, that's the bought crowd.

respondents.key_reason: Wants peace, education, and for politicians to address local issues. Criticizes politicians for forgetting promises after winning elections.
respondents.quote_original: आपस में शांति रहे, शिक्षा का माहौल अच्छा रहे। और जो मोहल्ला में लोग हैं, दबे कुचले जो भी लोग हैं, उनको लोग देखे, पहुंचाए उनका शिकायत पहुंचाए कि हां हमारे मोहल्ला में इस तरह का है। लेकिन जनरली क्या होता है कि जीत लेने के बाद फिर उधर ध्यान आता नहीं है।
respondents.quote_english: There should be peace among us, the environment for education should be good. And the people in the locality, the downtrodden, whoever they are, people should see them, convey their complaints that yes, this is the situation in our locality. But generally, what happens is that after winning, they don't pay attention anymore.

respondents.key_reason: Will vote based on development, not caste.
respondents.quote_original: तो आप वोट देने जाइएगा तो कुछ मुद्दा सोचे हैं कि फिर जाति के नाम पर देंगे विकास के क्या? विकास पर ही देंगे। विकास पर देंगे।
respondents.quote_english: So when you go to vote, have you thought about an issue, or will you vote on the basis of caste, or development? I will vote on development. I will vote on development.

respondents.key_reason: BJP has brought development, including new roads, which has improved the area and removed bad odors. Believes BJP should continue to rule.
respondents.quote_original: माहौल तो बीजेपी का ही है, रहेगा भी आगे। ठीक है क्योंकि जिस तरह से विकास हुआ, देखिए नई सड़क बनी है। काफी परेशान थे हम लोग काफी टाइम से, लेकिन ये बन गई। ठीक है? हमारे तरफ मेन रोड बन गया है, जिसकी वजह से आवागमन बहुत अच्छा हो गया है, सारी बदबू खत्म हो गई है। और अब हमारा भी माहौल एक भीषण रोड बोर्डिंग के नाले रोड जो टॉप रैंक में आता है, तो इस एरिया के बंदे अच्छे होते हैं, लोग अच्छे होते हैं, अब उस एरिया में हम लोग आ गए हैं। तो ये हमारे लिए उन्नति की चीज है और आगे भी बीजेपी ही रहे, हम लोग यही चाहते हैं।
respondents.quote_english: The atmosphere is for BJP, and it will remain so in the future. Okay, because of the way development has happened, see, a new road has been built. We were quite troubled for a long time, but it's done now. Okay? A main road has been built on our side, because of which commuting has become very good, all the bad smell is gone. And now our area, which comes in the top rank for road boarding and drains, the people in this area are good, people are good, now we have come into that area. So this is a matter of progress for us, and we want BJP to remain in power in the future.

respondents.key_reason: Changing candidates is a good move if BJP feels there's a problem or public objection. It shows they want to bring a clean image candidate.
respondents.quote_original: देखिए प्रत्याशी बदलना अच्छी बात है। अगर बीजेपी को लगी है कि हां इस प्रत्याशी में कुछ दिक्कत है और अपोजिशन कुछ कर सकती है और या जनता को लगे कि भविष्य में इस पर कोई उंगली उठ सकती है, तो उन्हें राइट्स है चेंज करने का कि मैं अच्छा प्रत्याशी, साफ-सुथरा प्रत्याशी लाऊं ताकि लोग कोई ऑब्जेक्शन ना कर सके इस चीजों पे कि हां इसमें ये गलत था, उनका ये गलत था या बैकग्राउंड खराब था। साफ-सुथरा छवि जैसे नितिन नवीन थे, साफ-सुथरा छवि के लोग आएंगे।
respondents.quote_english: Look, changing candidates is a good thing. If BJP feels that there is some problem with this candidate and the opposition can do something, or if the public feels that an objection can be raised against him in the future, then they have the right to change, to bring a good, clean candidate so that people cannot object to these things, saying that this was wrong, that was wrong, or the background was bad. People with a clean image, like Nitin Navin, will come.

respondents.key_reason: Believes that after 5 years, every politician should be changed to give new people a chance and see what they can do.
respondents.quote_original: तो पहले कोई नहीं जानता है कौन विकास करेगा। प्रशांत किशोर ही आएगा और कल हो के कुछ करे तो लोग क्या है देने वाला तो दिया वोट वो तो राजा बन गया। हां वो किंग बन गया अपना घूम रहा है। तो पहले तो कोई नहीं जानता है देता है देने के बाद लेकिन पांच-पांच साल पे हर चेंज कर देना चाहिए हर कोई को। हर किसी को 5 साल के बाद चेंज। अगला को मौका देना चाहिए ताकि पता चले कि वो क्या कर रहा है ये क्या कर रहा है। सब दिखता है।
respondents.quote_english: So first, no one knows who will bring development. Prashant Kishor will come, and if he does something tomorrow, what will people do? The one who gave the vote, he became king. Yes, he became king and is roaming around. So first, no one knows, they vote, but after five years, everyone should be changed. Everyone should be changed after 5 years. The next person should be given a chance so that it is known what he is doing and what this one is doing. Everything is visible.

respondents.key_reason: Believes BJP's candidate change is necessary to win. Dismisses claims that Prashant Kishor will only cut votes.
respondents.quote_original: देखिए दावा करना तो हर कोई दावा करता है ऐसी बात नहीं है। लेकिन उनका माहौल है जिस पर उनको निकालना जरूरी है। लेकिन बहुत लोग ये भी कह रहा है कि प्रशांत किशोर वोट कटवा काम करेगा, आएंगे थोड़ा मोड़ा अंतर होगा बस यही। नहीं नहीं ऐसा बात नहीं है।
respondents.quote_english: Look, everyone makes claims, that's not the point. But their atmosphere is such that it is necessary to remove them. But many people are also saying that Prashant Kishor will only cut votes, there will be a slight difference, that's it. No, no, that's not the case.

respondents.key_reason: Believes Prashant Kishor will fulfill promises like fixing ration card issues and addressing past problems.
respondents.quote_original: उम्मीद है जो मतलब विकास करेंगे। राशन कार्ड में नाम कट गया गरीबों का मतलब ये सब मतलब उनका दावा है जो मतलब पूरा करेंगे। जो 25 2025 में जो हुआ मतलब इस पर कांड वो सब मतलब सुधार करेंगे। बस यही है और क्या है। लेकिन हम लोग इसी पर मतलब जनसुराज को ही वोट देंगे।
respondents.quote_english: There is hope that he will bring development. The names of the poor were cut from ration cards, he claims he will fix all that. Whatever happened in 2025, he will rectify all those incidents. That's it, what else? But we will vote for Jan Suraaj on this.

respondents.key_reason: BJP has been in power for 40 years, it's time to give a new person (Prashant Kishor) a chance to see what he can do.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी तो 40 साल रहा। उसका तो देखवे किए हैं। एक बार इनको भी देख लेते हैं। अच्छा एक नया आदमी को मौका देते हैं। हां एकदम एकदम हां।
respondents.quote_english: BJP has been there for 40 years. We've seen what they did. Let's give this person a chance too. Okay, give a new person a chance. Yes, absolutely.

respondents.key_reason: Believes Rekha Gupta (RJD) has no standing and won't get votes, while Prashant Kishor will win. Predicts BJP will lose.
respondents.quote_original: रेखा गुप्ता का? रेखा गुप्ता का कोई नाम ही नहीं है। उसको तो कोई वोट नहीं मिलेगा। लेकिन इनको मिलेगा ये जीतेंगे भी। हां बीजेपी इस बार हारेगा यहां से।
respondents.quote_english: Rekha Gupta? Rekha Gupta has no name. She won't get any votes. But he will get votes, and he will win. Yes, BJP will lose from here this time.

respondents.key_reason: Believes BJP changed its candidate because the previous one had a 'stain' or they realized they couldn't win against Prashant Kishor. No matter who BJP fields, they won't win.
respondents.quote_original: अब वो उन लोग समझे हम क्या उसका बात तो हम नहीं बोल सकते हैं। उस मान लीजिए कि उसको कोई दाग होगा। अच्छा ये देख लिया कि प्रशांत किशोर से हम नहीं जीत पाएंगे। ये लड़का नहीं जीत पाएगा। उसका टिकट काट दिया। नया को दूसरा को टिकट दिया कि निकाल लेगा। लेकिन कोई किसी को दे दे नहीं निकालेगा।
respondents.quote_english: Now they understand, what can I say about that? Suppose he had some stain. Or they saw that they couldn't win against Prashant Kishor. This boy won't be able to win. So they cut his ticket. They gave the ticket to someone else, thinking he would win. But no matter who they give it to, they won't win.

respondents.key_reason: Still thinking about who to vote for.
respondents.quote_original: अब अभी नहीं सोचे। सोचेंगे तब बतलाएंगे।
respondents.quote_english: Haven't thought yet. Will tell when I think.

respondents.key_reason: Criticizes the current situation, mentioning eve-teasing and kidnappings, implying a lack of law and order despite development claims.
respondents.quote_original: बहुत हुआ है। बतलाएंगे कुछ बहुत हुआ है। लड़की लोग के छेड़खानी अवती यार का। लड़की को उठा करके ले जाता है दिना दिस्ती ये सब हो रहा है। मंदिरी में चाहे और कहूं भी। एको मंदिरी खास नहीं है बहुत जगह है।
respondents.quote_english: A lot has happened. I will tell you, a lot has happened. Girls are being harassed. Girls are being kidnapped in broad daylight, all this is happening. In Mandiri or anywhere else. Mandiri is not special, it's happening in many places.

respondents.key_reason: Criticizes BJP for not addressing poverty, rising inflation, and unemployment. Points out that Nitin Navin has been in power for a long time but has done nothing.
respondents.quote_original: गरीबी नहीं जाएगा। बीजेपी का कहना है कि गरीबी भगाओ अमीरी लाओ। तो गरीबी कहां जाएगा? तो मरेगा। देखिए बहुत गरीब तो मर गया, घर टूटा, ये सब मर गया। उसमें क्या क्या लाभ मिला बीजेपी की सरकार से? कोई लाभ नहीं मिला। महंगाई पर महंगाई बढ़ रहा है। आदमी का मजदूरी नहीं बढ़ रहा है। 500 में क्या करेगा? खाएगा कि पेट भरेगा कि बाल बच्चे को पढ़ाएगा? ना ढंग का स्कूल है। नितिन नवीन 30 वर्ष रहे, उनका बाबूजी थे, बाबूजी से बेटा हो गया 45 वर्ष अभी रह रहे हैं। वो क्या किए? आज तक तो कुछ करवे नहीं किए हैं। आज देखिए कांग्रेस का अध्यक्ष बन गए, बीजेपी का अध्यक्ष बने हुए हैं। आज तक तो कुछ करवे नहीं किए हैं।
respondents.quote_english: Poverty will not go away. BJP says 'remove poverty, bring prosperity'. So where will the poor go? They will die. Look, many poor people have died, their homes broken, all this. What benefit did they get from BJP's government? No benefit. Inflation is rising. People's wages are not increasing. What will they do with 500 rupees? Eat, fill their stomach, or educate their children? There are no proper schools. Nitin Navin has been there for 30 years, his father was there, from father to son, he has been there for 45 years now. What did they do? They haven't done anything till date. Today, look, he became the Congress president, he is the BJP president. They haven't done anything till date.

respondents.key_reason: Believes that with Prashant Kishor and Rekha Gupta in the fray, there's a chance for change, but it's too early to say who will win.
respondents.quote_original: अच्छा एक बात बताइए प्रशांत किशोरी मैदान में है, रेखा गुप्ता भी है तो क्या अंतर कुछ पड़ने वाला है इस बार? देखिए। मेन बात है कि रेखा गुप्ता तभी खड़ा हुए थे आरजेडी से तो कुछ तो टक्कर दिए थे। अबरी भी खड़ा है। तो चांस तो है देखिए निकलने का। अभी तो कुछ नहीं कह सकता है।
respondents.quote_english: Okay, tell me one thing, Prashant Kishor is in the fray, Rekha Gupta is also there, so will it make any difference this time? Look. The main thing is that Rekha Gupta stood from RJD then, so she gave some competition. She is standing again. So there is a chance, let's see who wins. Can't say anything yet.

respondents.key_reason: Criticizes the lack of development and welfare, mentioning issues like pension being stopped and ration being unavailable.
respondents.quote_original: जरूरत है कल पानी का रोड का था तो वो बना उना है तनी नाला उला बना है। और तो हम लोग को कोई विकास जनता का विकास होना चाहिए। हम लोग को कुछ अब जैसे कि आप देखिए चार पांच महीने से मेरे मां को पेंशन वनशन बंद है। राशन भी एक सुन रहे हैं एक दो महीना बंद है अब क्या है बताइए ये सब तो नेता की हती है। हम तो गरीब आदमी कमाते खाते हैं।
respondents.quote_english: There is a need, yesterday there was a road for water, so that was built, some drains were built. And for us, there should be public development. For us, for example, for four-five months, my mother's pension has been stopped. Ration is also heard to be stopped for one-two months, now what is it, tell me, all this is the leader's doing. We are poor people who earn and eat.

respondents.key_reason: Believes that whoever does good work will remain in power, regardless of what others say.
respondents.quote_original: देखिए जो अच्छा काम करेगा वही रहेगा। कोई का कहे से कुछ होने वाला नहीं है। जो जीतेगा एकरे सरकार रहेगा। जो अच्छा काम करेगा ये हमेशा के लिए रहेगा।
respondents.quote_english: Look, whoever does good work will remain. Nothing will happen by what anyone says. Whoever wins, their government will remain. Whoever does good work will remain forever.

respondents.key_reason: Defends the current government (Nitish Kumar, Modi), stating they have done a lot of work, especially in roads and development across Bihar. Criticizes voting based on caste.
respondents.quote_original: काम वो बहुत किया है। जितना ये काम किया कोई नहीं किया। जितना नीतीश कुमार बाबू काम कर गया मोदी किया। इतना कोई काम करके नहीं रोड बारे में जा के बारे में देखिए। देहात दरभंगा देहात हर राज्य में चमकाए हुए हैं। लाइन दौड़ाए हुए हैं। अब क्या चाहिए बोलिए।
respondents.quote_english: He has done a lot of work. No one has done as much work as he has. As much work as Nitish Kumar Babu and Modi have done. No one has done so much work. Look at the roads, look at the villages. Villages in Darbhanga, villages in every state have been brightened. Power lines have been laid. Now what else do you want, tell me.

respondents.key_reason: Believes there should be a change after seeing the same party (BJP) for a long time. Wants to give Prashant Kishor a chance.
respondents.quote_original: नहीं ठीक है। वहां सब सही है। लेकिन कुछ परिवर्तन होना चाहिए ना। उसको देखते-देखते आदमी हो गया बीजेपी। एक बार सोचेगा इसको मौका दिया जाए। देखते हैं क्या बोलते हैं, कुछ सही है कि गलत है। एक बार मौका देना चाहिए प्रशांत किशोर को।
respondents.quote_english: No, it's fine. Everything is correct there. But there should be some change, right? People have seen BJP for so long. They should think about giving him a chance. Let's see what he says, whether it's right or wrong. Prashant Kishor should be given a chance once.

respondents.key_reason: Believes the BJP candidate was involved in some scam or corruption, which is why he was changed.
respondents.quote_original: उसमें दिखाया नहीं है कुछ उसका जो पिताजी है ना जो कैंडिडेट है कुछ घोटाला-वोटाला में कुछ फंसा हुआ था मतलब कि। उसी का चक्कर कुछ है लगता है। अंदरूनी मैटर है कुछ।
respondents.quote_english: It wasn't shown, but his father, the candidate, was involved in some scam or something. It seems there's something related to that. It's an internal matter.

respondents.key_reason: Does not want BJP government anymore.
respondents.quote_original: सोचना तो सबका अधिकार है। प्लस में इस बार बीजेपी की सरकार नहीं आनी चाहिए। हम लोगों की यही ख्वाहिश है।
respondents.quote_english: Everyone has the right to think. Plus, this time BJP's government should not come. This is our wish.

respondents.key_reason: Does not want BJP government anymore because they haven't received anything from them. Wants Congress government.
respondents.quote_original: 30 साल से रहे उससे मतलब नहीं है क्योंकि बीजेपी की सरकार अब नहीं चाहिए। अब सीधा कांग्रेस की सरकार चाहिए क्योंकि बीजेपी की सरकार से हमें कुछ नहीं मिला है।
respondents.quote_english: It doesn't matter if they've been there for 30 years because we don't want BJP's government anymore. Now we want a direct Congress government because we haven't received anything from BJP's government.

respondents.key_reason: Criticizes BJP's development work, stating that roads and drains are poorly constructed and still have waterlogging. Marine Drive lights don't work.
respondents.quote_original: रोड बनवाया, वैसा रोड बनवाया है कि आज तक पानी जमता है। जो नाला बनाया आपका वो आज तक पानी वहां जमता है। बारिश थोड़ी सी रात में हुई, आज पानी जमा हुआ है। कहीं भी रोड, कहीं भी कोई भी चीज बन रहा है। मरीन ड्राइव आपका जो बना है, बहुत पुराना बना हुआ है। वहां पे लाइटें नहीं जलती हैं सही से। बीजेपी की सरकार में जो जो काम किया है वो सही नहीं हुआ है। काम किया है लेकिन वो काम भी सही सुरक्षा से नहीं हुआ है।
respondents.quote_english: They built roads, they built such roads that water still collects there today. The drain they built, water still collects there today. It rained a little last night, and today water is collected. Anywhere a road or anything is being built. Your Marine Drive, which was built, is very old. The lights don't work properly there. Whatever work BJP's government has done, it hasn't been done correctly. Work has been done, but that work also hasn't been done with proper safety.

respondents.key_reason: Does not want to elect anyone else to create 'speed breakers' in development, as BJP is already in power at both state and central levels. Wants ongoing work to be completed quickly.
respondents.quote_original: और हम नहीं चाहते कि जैसे कि केंद्र में सरकार बीजेपी की है, बिहार में सरकार बीजेपी की है, तो हम और किसी को चुनकर स्पीड ब्रेकर नहीं लगाना चाहते अपने बांकीपुर विधानसभा में। हम चाहते हैं कि बीजेपी का ही विधायक हो ताकि जो काम रुकी हुई है, जो बचा हुआ है, वो तेजी से हो जाए।
respondents.quote_english: And we don't want to elect anyone else to create 'speed breakers' in development, as BJP is in power at the center and in Bihar. We want a BJP MLA so that the pending work can be completed quickly.

respondents.key_reason: Believes the candidate change won't affect BJP's chances because the party's ideology is good, and the new candidate is also from the same constituency. Highlights past development in the area.
respondents.quote_original: देखिए बीजेपी तो कैंडिडेट से हमको नहीं लगता कोई फर्क पड़ने वाला है। क्योंकि जो भी होगा तो इधर का ही होगा। बीजेपी का जो भी जो नाम बदल के नए आए हैं, वो भी तो इसी बांकीपुर विधानसभा के रहने वाले हैं। तो कैंडिडेट से कोई फर्क नहीं पड़ता है क्योंकि पार्टी की विचार अच्छी है बांकीपुर को लेकर। और बांकीपुर को जैसे कि हम भी बचपन से यहां बड़े हुए हैं, आज 37 साल की उम्र हो गई है मेरी। बहुत खस्ता हाल था इस इलाके का।
respondents.quote_english: Look, I don't think the BJP candidate change will make any difference. Because whoever it is, they will be from this area. The new people who have come by changing names for BJP, they are also residents of this Bankipur constituency. So the candidate doesn't make any difference because the party's ideology is good for Bankipur. And for Bankipur, as I have grown up here since childhood, I am 37 years old today. This area was in a very bad state.

respondents.key_reason: Claims Prashant Kishor's team did not come to their area to ask for votes despite a scheduled meeting, which made them feel ignored.
respondents.quote_original: जब मेरे पास में आए यहां संविधान था कि यहां पर था कि नाग मणि के पास में उस शहर कटिन के सलून के पास में रहना है। माने जनसुराज को आना है। समझ गए? मेरे पास में नहीं आए तो कैसे वोट देंगे? आप ही। आपके पास काहे आना था? यहां वोट मांगने। नहीं नहीं समय दिया हुआ था। अच्छा। यहां आएंगे। माला भी लाके हम लोग को मिला। बैनर भी दिया गया। लेकिन ये माला अभी भी रखा हुआ है। मगर यहां आए नहीं वो।
respondents.quote_english: When they came to me, there was a constitution here that they had to stay near Nag Mani, near the salon in that city. Meaning Jan Suraaj had to come. Understood? They didn't come to me, so how will I vote? You tell me. Why did they have to come to you? To ask for votes. No, no, a time was given. Okay. They will come here. We also received garlands. Banners were also given. But this garland is still kept. But they didn't come here.

respondents.key_reason: Claims a 'Madam' (likely Rekha Gupta from RJD) came to them and they support her. Feels insulted by Prashant Kishor's team for not giving them time after distributing garlands and banners.
respondents.quote_original: मैडम आए हैं। मैडम हमको बोले हैं। ये चीज को तम तमन्ना मेरा है। मैडम बोले एक चीज की नाग मणि हम आएंगे। ये भेंट करेंगे। मगर जिस दिल से हम चाहे आरजेडी से छोड़ के इसमें आए मैडम। तो ऐसा होता है तब फिर कैसे हम देंगे आपको? गरीब आदमी है। एक खिला हम बांटे हैं। गरीब आदमी है बेचारा एक खिला हम लेके और प्रशांत किशोर के नाम पर बांट दिया। जो प्रशांत किशोर टाइम नहीं दिए यहां। माला बटवा दिए हम लोग को बैनर दिए हर चीज दिए। बेइज्जती कर दिया। और बेइज्जती कर दिए।
respondents.quote_english: Madam came. Madam told us. This is my wish. Madam said one thing, Nag Mani, we will come. We will meet. But with the heart that we wanted, leaving RJD, we came to this, Madam. So if that happens, then how will we give it to you? He is a poor man. We distributed one packet. He is a poor man, he took one packet and distributed it in Prashant Kishor's name. But Prashant Kishor didn't give time here. They made us distribute garlands, gave us banners, gave everything. And they insulted us.

respondents.key_reason: Acknowledges some road development but criticizes the inconsistent water supply in the tap water scheme. Wants more improvement.
respondents.quote_original: विकास के वैसे तो इधर रोड वगैरह सब बना है। नल नल वाला पानी अभी कुछ कहीं-कहीं आया है किसी-किसी में। और कहीं-कहीं पूरा नहीं आ रहा है। थोड़ा और इंप्रूव हो जाता तो बढ़िया रहता।
respondents.quote_english: As for development, roads and all have been built here. Tap water has come in some places, in some. And in some places, it's not coming completely. It would be better if it improved a little more.

respondents.key_reason: Believes BJP changed its candidate after careful consideration, implying it will be beneficial.
respondents.quote_original: हमको तो लगता है बदला है तो कुछ सोचे समझ के कहे होंगे।
respondents.quote_english: I think if they changed, they must have said it after thinking it through.

respondents.key_reason: Believes BJP has provided benefits like gas cylinders at subsidized rates.
respondents.quote_original: माने 1060 में गैस दे रहा है तो फायदा दिया ना। 1060 में गैस दे रहा है तो फायदा दिया। तो बहुत फायदा दिया। हम लोग गरीब हैं क्या करेंगे देखिए यहां। यहां दुकान देखिए दुकान में आइए अंदर। आप आइए। आप आइए ना मैडम। हां हां। पूरा दुकान के लिए हमको चर्चा। देखिए हम कह रहे हैं कि बताइए कि गरीब आदमी के दुकान में खाने का जगह नहीं है। रोते हैं। किस लिए रोते हैं? अभी देखिए गैस मेरे पास में नहीं है। अब हमारे पास में पैसा नहीं है। तो हम कहां से खाएंगे? और ये प्रधानमंत्री या चाहे मुख्यमंत्री कह रहा है 160 में दिया। कहां से हम लाएंगे सर? आप ही बताइए गरीब आदमी को तो होना चाहिए ना।
respondents.quote_english: Meaning, they are giving gas for 1060, so they gave benefit, right? They are giving gas for 1060, so they gave benefit. So they gave a lot of benefit. We are poor, what will we do, look here. Look at the shop, come inside the shop. You come. You come, Madam. Yes, yes. Discuss the whole shop with us. Look, I am saying, tell me, a poor man's shop has no place to eat. They cry. Why do they cry? Right now, I don't have gas. And I don't have money. So where will I eat from? And this Prime Minister or Chief Minister is saying they gave it for 160. Where will we get it from, sir? You tell me, a poor person should have it, right?

respondents.key_reason: Prioritizes basic needs like food over political parties.
respondents.quote_original: हमको कौन सी चाहिए? हमको भोजन चाहिए।
respondents.quote_english: What do I need? I need food.

respondents.key_reason: Supports BJP and believes they will win.
respondents.quote_original: हम तो बीजेपी का सपोर्टर हैं। तो बीजेपी ही आएगा।
respondents.quote_english: We are BJP supporters. So BJP will come.

respondents.key_reason: Dismisses other parties' claims, stating that those who performed poorly in previous elections won't achieve anything now.
respondents.quote_original: जो पिछले चुनाव में कुछ 0/0 सीट लाया, अब वो चुनाव से वो सीट क्या लाएगा? उसका कुछ नहीं आएगा।
respondents.quote_english: The one who got 0/0 seats in the last election, what will he get from this election? He won't get anything.

respondents.key_reason: Supports BJP because they have brought development to the Bankipur constituency and will continue to do so.
respondents.quote_original: नहीं तो हम बीजेपी को सपोर्ट करते हैं ना क्योंकि वो यहां विकास किया है। हां बाकीपुर विधानसभा में विकास किया है। आप क्या चाहिए? आपको लगता है कि अगर आते हैं तो फिर से वो विकास करेंगे? हां क्यों नहीं करेंगे? कर रहे हैं और करते रहेंगे।
respondents.quote_english: No, we support BJP because they have brought development here. Yes, they have brought development in Bankipur constituency. What else do you want? Do you think if they come, they will develop again? Yes, why not? They are doing it and will continue to do it.

respondents.key_reason: Acknowledges BJP's development but criticizes their lack of support for the poor, especially those whose roadside dwellings were removed.
respondents.quote_original: अच्छा व्यवहार रखेंगे तो अच्छा पद पे आएंगे। लेकिन बीजेपी दावा कर रहा है कि 30 साल से है, बहुत विकास किए हैं, फिर हमी को मौका मिलेगा। बीजेपी बहुत विकास भी किया, बहुत यहां पे जैसे कि बता रहे हैं। विकास तो किया है मगर गरीब के लिए वो बहुत कुछ किया नहीं है। जैसे मान के चलिए अभी अतिक्रमण में जाइए। बहुत गरीब सब को जो रोड के किनारे था, साइड में था, वो सब का दो चार रुपया कमा के अपना घर में रहने का औकात नहीं था तो वो सब रोड के किनारे में झोपड़ी-वोपड़ी ये सब लगा के वो रह रहा था। अभी जादूगर के बगल में जाइए। वहां पे सबका हटा दिया घर-द्वार ये सब। तो वो सब वैसा-वैसा बात बोल रहा है कि अब हम लोग कहां जाएंगे।
respondents.quote_english: If they maintain good behavior, they will come to a good position. But BJP is claiming that they have been here for 30 years, have done a lot of development, and will get another chance. BJP has done a lot of development, as they are saying here. Development has been done, but they haven't done much for the poor. For example, go to the encroachment drive. Many poor people who lived on the roadside, in shanties, earning a few rupees, couldn't afford a proper home, so they lived in roadside huts. Now go next to Jadugar. Everyone's homes and dwellings have been removed there. So they are saying such things, that where will we go now?

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures diverse public opinions on the Bankipur by-election, with a significant focus on the BJP's candidate change and the emergence of Prashant Kishor's Jan Suraaj party. Many respondents express a desire for change, citing issues like development quality, corruption, and caste politics, leading them to support Prashant Kishor. Conversely, a substantial number of people firmly support BJP, highlighting their past development work and party ideology, while some remain undecided, prioritizing development or basic needs over party affiliation.

analysis.video_title: Bankipur की महिलाओं ने बदल दिया पूरा चुनावी खेल! Prashant Kishor Vs BJP | Bankipur Upchunav

respondents.key_reason: Consistently votes for Nitin Navin (BJP) due to perceived development, despite not receiving government benefits like the 10,000 rupees. Acknowledges development but also highlights ongoing issues like sanitation, violence, and child health problems due to the garbage dump. Open to new candidates but ultimately leans towards the established candidate who has done work.
respondents.quote_original: हम लोग के तो 10000 मिलवे नहीं किया है। फिर भी वोट किसको देती है आप? नितिन नवीन के। बस इतना है कि यहां से मारकाट ज्यादा हो रहा है, छीन छोड़ ज्यादा हो रहा है, चोरी चंडाली ज्यादा हो रहा है, ये सब हटाना चाहिए।
respondents.quote_english: We didn't even get 10,000. Still, who do you vote for? Nitin Navin. It's just that there's too much violence, snatching, and theft here, all this should be removed.

respondents.key_reason: Strong desire for change and dissatisfaction with BJP's incomplete development and lack of basic amenities like water. Believes Prashant Kishor will win and perform, and is 100% certain of his victory.
respondents.quote_original: इस बार हम लोग का चेंजिंग करना बहुत जरूरी है। बहुत बदलाव, बहुत बदलाव। नहीं नहीं प्रशांत किशोर आएंगे। इस बार दम 100 में 100% है कि निकलना है।
respondents.quote_english: This time it's very important for us to make a change. A lot of change, a lot of change. No, no, Prashant Kishor will come. This time, it's 100% certain that he will win.

respondents.key_reason: Votes for those who bring visible development. Dismisses new candidates' claims and believes Nitin Navin's increased political stature (as a national president) will benefit him and the party.
respondents.quote_original: अरे माहौल से शुरू से तो देख रहे हैं कि विकास जिनका हो रहा है उसी को वोट मिल रहा है। उतना नहीं पड़ेगा प्रभाव। नितिन बाबू अध्यक्ष ने बन गए पूरे इंडिया का, तो वो प्रभाव कुछ पड़ेगा।
respondents.quote_english: Oh, from the beginning, we've been seeing that whoever is doing development, they are getting the votes. That much impact won't happen. Nitin Babu has become the president of entire India, so that will have some impact.

respondents.key_reason: Cannot comment on local politics as he is not a resident of the area.
respondents.quote_original: बाबू हम यहां रहते नहीं हैं।
respondents.quote_english: Son, I don't live here.

respondents.key_reason: Recently arrived and not informed enough to comment on the local political situation.
respondents.quote_original: नहीं हम तो आके भी आके बैठे हुए हैं। इसे कुछ नहीं कह सकते हम।
respondents.quote_english: No, I just came and sat here. I can't say anything about this.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, recently arrived in the area.

respondents.key_reason: Trusts only those who have a proven track record of development. Believes new candidates are unproven and lack the ability to perform, preferring the incumbent who has already done work.
respondents.quote_original: अब विकास तो हुआ है, देखिए नाला बनता, दता, रोड बन गया है। बहुत विकास हुआ है। ना जिसको जो पहले जो काम जो किया है, उसी पर भरोसा है, दूसरा पर भरोसा भी नहीं है। हम जिसको चलने की आदत है ये नहीं वो क्या चलेगा?
respondents.quote_english: Now, development has happened, look, drains are built, roads are built. A lot of development has happened. No, whoever has done work before, we trust only them, we don't trust others. The one who doesn't even have the habit of walking, how will he walk?

respondents.key_reason: Waiting for clarity on candidates and party tickets. Believes candidates need to work hard to earn votes and that the decision will be made closer to the elections.
respondents.quote_original: अब आने वाला दिन में देखा जाएगा कि कहां पर। अभी सोच कुछ नहीं है। अभी तो सरकार जो है किसको टिकट देगा, किसको नहीं देगा। समय आएगा तब। अभी बाकी बहुत दिन है।
respondents.quote_english: Now, in the coming days, it will be seen where. Right now, there's no thought. Right now, the government will decide who gets the ticket and who doesn't. When the time comes. There's still a lot of time left.

respondents.key_reason: Trusts visible development and the work done by the regional MLA. Dismisses political rhetoric and focuses on tangible improvements like roads and sanitation.
respondents.quote_original: जो आगे विकास देखा है उसी के अनुसार काम करे। आज जो कह रहे हैं जो सामने है अभी रोड नया जो नाला महकते रहता था दिन-रात, और वो दूर हो गया गंदगी तो विकास तो उसी को झलकता है। जो माने क्षेत्रीय विधायक है, जो काम करे उसके अनुसार वोट दे।
respondents.quote_english: Whoever has seen development before, should work according to that. What they are saying today, what is visible now, the new road, the drain that used to stink day and night, and that dirt has been removed, so development is visible in that. Whoever is the regional MLA, whoever works, vote according to that.

respondents.key_reason: Believes in voting for those with a proven track record of development. Skeptical of new candidates like Prashant Kishor, questioning their ability to perform and their political strength/relevance.
respondents.quote_original: जो काम किया है उसी को आदमी मौका देता है, खोजता है। हां, बीजेपी ही आना चाहिए। वही आना चाहिए। क्या काम करेंगे? क्या काम करेंगे उनसे बताइए, वो तो सेंट्रल का है नहीं। पटना से बिहार से कहां से खड़ा हुए हैं? कितना सीट है इनके पास?
respondents.quote_english: People give a chance to whoever has worked, they look for them. Yes, BJP should come. The same one should come. What work will they do? Tell me what work they will do, they are not from the central government. From Patna, Bihar, where did they stand? How many seats do they have?

respondents.key_reason: Open to giving new candidates like Prashant Kishor a chance, but believes they need to work hard and consistently to prove themselves and gain public trust.
respondents.quote_original: हम लोग तो देने की कोशिश कर रहे हैं। आस्ते-आस्ते तो जरूर मिलेगा मौका। हां, करना होगा। हां, सबको करना पड़ेगा।
respondents.quote_english: We are trying to give a chance. Slowly, they will definitely get a chance. Yes, they will have to. Yes, everyone will have to do it.

respondents.key_reason: Believes the new BJP candidate (Neeraj Sinha) will win, implying trust in the party or the chosen candidate. Votes for performance.
respondents.quote_original: इस बार अब जो अच्छा करेगा वो जीतेगा। हां, भैया, यही निकलेंगे।
respondents.quote_english: This time, whoever does good will win. Yes, brother, he will win.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, named Rohit, resident of Bankipur.

respondents.key_reason: Believes in giving new candidates a chance, especially Prashant Kishor, as this might be their only opportunity to bring change and address long-standing issues.
respondents.quote_original: उम्मीद है, उम्मीद है, उम्मीद पूरा उम्मीद है कि अबरी हो सकता है। अबरी नहीं होगा तो फिर कभी नहीं हो पाएगा। हर कोई के जान चांस देना चाहिए ना सर, इसलिए चांस दे रहे हैं।
respondents.quote_english: There is hope, there is hope, full hope that it might happen this time. If it doesn't happen this time, then it will never happen. Everyone should be given a chance, sir, that's why we are giving a chance.

respondents.key_reason: Acknowledges some development but highlights persistent issues like water scarcity. Believes in the necessity of political change and reflects the general public's desire for it, while dismissing political rhetoric.
respondents.quote_original: विकास क्या जैसे 30-35 साल का मोहल्ला था, वैसे थोड़ा सा रोड-वोड बन गया है, पानी का किल्लत तो यहां सब दिन रहा है। सबसे बड़ा समस्या यहां पर पानी का किल्लत है। ना ना कुछ चेंजिंग होते रहना चाहिए। बदलाव होना चाहिए, सबका गांव-समाज का यही कहनाम है।
respondents.quote_english: What development? Like it was a 30-35 year old neighborhood, some roads have been built, but water scarcity has always been here. The biggest problem here is water scarcity. No, no, some changing should keep happening. Change should happen, this is what everyone in the village and society says.

respondents.key_reason: Acknowledges significant development in infrastructure but is deeply concerned about ongoing issues like sanitation, waste management, and law & order. Not influenced by government benefits or national leaders.
respondents.quote_original: बहुत हुआ है विकास। बहुत कुछ हुआ है, नाला-वला सब बन गया, रोड बन गया, मतलब आने-जाने में सुविधा हो गया हम लोग का। बस इतना है कि यहां से जो ये डोमखाना है, ये सब कचरा यहां से हटाना चाहिए। इसीलिए थोड़ा बहुत हम लोग को दिक्कत हो रहा है। मारकाट ज्यादा हो रहा है, छीन छोड़ ज्यादा हो रहा है, चोरी चंडाली ज्यादा हो रहा है, ये सब हटाना चाहिए।
respondents.quote_english: A lot of development has happened. A lot has happened, drains and all have been built, roads have been built, meaning our commute has become convenient. It's just that this garbage dump here, all this trash should be removed from here. That's why we are facing some problems. There's too much violence, snatching, and theft here, all this should be removed.

respondents.key_reason: Concerned about law and order issues like theft and snatching. Will vote for whoever performs well and is liked, but is waiting for the right time to make a decision.
respondents.quote_original: चोरी सब छीन छोड़ कर ले गया है। अब समय बताएगा ना बेटा। जो अच्छा करेगा उसी को दिया जाएगा।
respondents.quote_english: Theft, everything has been snatched away. Now time will tell, son. Whoever does good will be given the vote.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Female, elderly (referred to as 'Chachi'), resident of Bankipur.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures diverse opinions in Bankipur regarding the upcoming by-election. While many residents acknowledge significant development in infrastructure like roads and drains by the incumbent BJP, there are persistent concerns about sanitation, waste management, water scarcity, and law & order. A significant portion of the electorate expresses firm loyalty to the BJP, particularly Nitin Navin, citing his past work and political stature, even if they haven't received government benefits. However, there's also a strong sentiment for change, with some residents leaning towards Prashant Kishor, believing new candidates should be given a chance to address unresolved issues and bring fresh perspectives.

respondents.key_reason: Strongly against Modi/BJP due to perceived corruption, inflation, unemployment, and lack of development. Believes BJP has become arrogant and only cares about money, not the common people. Supports Prashant Kishor's Jan Suraaj for change.
respondents.quote_original: पहले मोदिया को भगा दीजिए तब हमसे वोट मांगिए। चलो चंदा चोर सब वहां से सब ले भागा। हम नहीं छोड़ेंगे गद्दी। बीजेपी का घमंड ज्यादा हो चुका है। जात-पात से हमको लेना देना नहीं है।
respondents.quote_english: First, remove Modi, then ask for our votes. All the donation thieves have run away from there. We will not leave the throne. BJP has become too arrogant. We have nothing to do with caste.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Elderly man, likely from the Teli community (as per video title context), expressing strong anger against BJP and Modi. Mentions Prashant Kishor's Jan Suraaj.

respondents.key_reason: Believes BJP has become arrogant and there is a need for change. Supports Prashant Kishor (Rekha Gupta) for development and change, not based on caste.
respondents.quote_original: इस बार तो लगता है कि त्रिशंकु है। परिवर्तन तो चाहिए। रेखा गुप्ता का क्या हाल है? बहुत अच्छा है। हम लोग प्रशांत किशोर जी को देंगे। जात से क्या मतलब है? जात खाने के लिए नहीं देगा।
respondents.quote_english: This time it seems to be a hung assembly. Change is definitely needed. How is Rekha Gupta? Very good. We will vote for Prashant Kishor ji. What does caste mean? Caste won't feed us.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Middle-aged man, expressing a desire for change and supporting Prashant Kishor/Rekha Gupta, emphasizing work over caste.

respondents.key_reason: Supports BJP based on the development work done by Nitin Nabin (BJP candidate). Believes work is more important than caste or community.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी का ही जीतेगा यहां। सिन्हा जी जीतेंगे। समाज को वोट नहीं देंगे? समाज से क्या मतलब है? काम से मतलब है। बीजेपी का काम किया हुआ है यहां। यहां जितना रोड देख रहे हैं, नाला से लेकर सब चीज यहां बीजेपी का बनाया हुआ है।
respondents.quote_english: Only BJP will win here. Sinha ji will win. Won't you vote for society? What does society mean? Work matters. BJP has done work here. All the roads and drains you see here are built by BJP.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Younger man, firmly supporting BJP and emphasizing development work by Nitin Nabin.

respondents.key_reason: Frustrated with BJP due to high inflation and unemployment, which negatively impacts small businesses. Believes the current government has failed to address these issues and wants a change, supporting Prashant Kishor.
respondents.quote_original: मोदी जी भी आपके समाज के नहीं होते? तो थे तो क्या हो गया? देश को तो बर्बाद कर दिए। इतना महंगाई, बेरोजगारी है। हमको एकदम क्लियर है प्रशांत किशोर जी को वोट देना है।
respondents.quote_english: Modi ji is not from your community? So what if he was? He has ruined the country. There is so much inflation, unemployment. It's absolutely clear to me that I have to vote for Prashant Kishor ji.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Businessman, expressing strong dissatisfaction with BJP over economic issues and supporting Prashant Kishor.

respondents.key_reason: Believes that voters will decide based on who they want to vote for, not on external factors. Expresses a general sentiment of uncertainty about the outcome and who will win.
respondents.quote_original: किसको लोग वोट देगा थोड़ी कह के देता है। क्या होगा नहीं होगा भविष्य के गर्भ में क्या छुपा हुआ कोई नहीं जानता।
respondents.quote_english: Who people will vote for, they don't say it beforehand. What will happen or not, no one knows what is hidden in the womb of the future.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Older man, appears to be neutral or unwilling to disclose his preference, emphasizing the unpredictable nature of elections.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures diverse sentiments in Bankipur's Ward 17 during the by-election. While some residents firmly support BJP, citing development work by Nitin Nabin, a significant number express strong dissatisfaction with the current government, particularly Narendra Modi, due to issues like inflation, unemployment, and perceived arrogance. These disgruntled voters are leaning towards Prashant Kishor's Jan Suraaj, emphasizing the need for change and prioritizing work over caste.

respondents.quote_english: Yes, a lot of development has happened here, the very large drains are now being covered, that work has started. We are very happy with that. He is a very good person.

respondents.quote_original: प्रशांत किशोर के पास हर चीज का उनके पास नॉलेज है और राजनीति से वो बहुत पुराने जुड़े हुए हैं। हां बांकीपुर में एकदम चेंज चाहते हैं हम।
respondents.quote_english: Prashant Kishor has knowledge of everything, and he has been associated with politics for a very long time. Yes, we definitely want change in Bakipur.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures public sentiment in Bakipur regarding an upcoming by-election, focusing on the incumbent BJP and the new challenger, Prashant Kishor.
