respondents.key_reason: Desire for change and betterment of Bihar, seeing Prashant Kishor as a catalyst. Deep dissatisfaction with the current government's performance on various issues over 20 years.
respondents.quote_original: एक युवा को सबसे पहले रोजगार चाहिए। लेकिन रोजगार के लिए बिहार का युवा मारा मारा पूरा देश में क्यों फिर रहा है? हमारी सरकार कब करेगी? यही हमारा मांग है। हम युवा इस बार बदलाव चाहते हैं एक बदलाव हो बाकीपुर के अंदर प्रशांत किशोर जी आएं।
respondents.quote_english: A youth first needs employment. But why is the youth of Bihar wandering around the whole country for employment? When will our government do it? This is our demand. We youth want change this time. There should be a change in Bankipur, Prashant Kishor should come.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Young male, student from Samastipur District.

respondents.key_reason: Strong belief in BJP, dismisses opposition leaders (including Prashant Kishor) as temporary and lacking long-term commitment to the constituency, highlights BJP's continuous presence since 1995.
respondents.quote_original: ओरिजिनल बाकीपुर का मतदाता हूं। ये माहौल यहां भाजपा का है। ये लोग जितने भी आज तक विपक्ष भाजपा के जो भी विपक्ष है वो बरसाती मेंढक है। जिस दिन 5 साल बाकीपुर के जनता के साथ गुजारेंगे तो विचार अलग होगी।
respondents.quote_english: I am an original voter of Bankipur. The atmosphere here is of BJP. All the opposition to BJP till date are like monsoon frogs. The day anyone spends 5 years with the people of Bankipur, then opinions will change.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Himanshu Kumar Singh, Male, Booth Number 188, Serial Number 457, original voter of Bankipur.

respondents.key_reason: Strong support for the BJP candidate (Nitin Navin) and party workers, confidence in their victory, believes the opposition (like Nishant Kumar) will be defeated.
respondents.quote_original: हम लोग निश्चिंत हैं, आश्वस्त हैं। जनता के बीच में नितिन नवीन रहे हैं और उनका जो उत्तराधिकारी है, जो कार्यकर्ता को मिला है जिम्मेदारी, उनके साथ हम लोग हैं।
respondents.quote_english: We are confident and assured. Nitin Navin has been among the people, and we are with his successor, the worker who has received the responsibility.

respondents.key_reason: Confidence in BJP's inevitable victory in the constituency.
respondents.quote_original: टक्कर यही भाजपा जीतेगा।
respondents.quote_english: BJP will win the contest.

respondents.key_reason: Focus on development, belief that BJP ensures development, and that continuity with the central government is crucial for progress. Dismisses new entrants like Prashant Kishor.
respondents.quote_original: हम लोग गार्जियन देख के वोट करते हैं ना गार्जियन वहां नितिन नवीन बैठे हुए हैं मोदी जी बैठे हुए हैं। अगर सेंट्रल में जो गवर्नमेंट है वही गवर्नमेंट यहां कंटिन्यू होगा तभी डेवलपमेंट होगा।
respondents.quote_english: We vote looking at the guardians, Nitin Navin is there, Modi ji is there. If the government in the center continues here, only then will there be development.

respondents.key_reason: Highlights ongoing development work (roads, drains) and BJP's constant presence and availability to the public, stating they vote for those who are always with them.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी। डेवलपमेंट हो रहा है हमारे यहां देख लीजिए विकास हो रहा है चारों तरफ देखिए रोड बन रहा है, नल्ली बन रहा है, गली बन रहा है, सब चीज हो रहा है। जो हमारे साथ हमेशा रहेंगे हम तो उन्हीं को देंगे ना।
respondents.quote_english: BJP. Development is happening here, see, development is everywhere, roads are being built, drains are being built, lanes are being built, everything is happening. We will only vote for those who are always with us.

respondents.key_reason: Emphasizes maintaining the traditional BJP stronghold, confidence in the party's ability to win, and support for party workers and leaders. Dismisses Prashant Kishor's impact.
respondents.quote_original: परंपरागत सीट को बचाना है। सीट खतरा में नहीं है परंपरा यहां है परंपरागत सीट यहां आगे भी जाएगी बीजेपी के खाते में। छोटा दरी बिछाने वाले को भी मौका देती है पार्टी, छोटा छोटा कार्यकर्ता ही मौका देती है।
respondents.quote_english: The traditional seat must be saved. The seat is not in danger, tradition is here, the traditional seat will go to BJP's account even further. The party gives opportunity even to those who lay small mats, it gives opportunity to small workers.

respondents.key_reason: Deep dissatisfaction with the current MLA and later expresses disillusionment with BJP's behavior, stating they are becoming like RJD. Believes elections are swayed by money and power, but still expresses opposition to BJP.
respondents.quote_original: इस बार तो हम लोग चेंज करने के मूड में हैं। विधायक से हम लोग ऊब गए हैं। हम लोग आरजेडी के डर से आए थे माने कि बीजेपी को सपोर्ट करेंगे मगर इनका भी रवैया अब वही आरजेडी वाला होता जा रहा है। भाजपा को तो जीतना ही जीतना है मगर हम विरोध करते हैं।
respondents.quote_english: This time we are in the mood for change. We are fed up with the MLA. We came out of fear of RJD, meaning we would support BJP, but their attitude is also becoming like RJD now. BJP is bound to win, but we oppose them.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures a mixed sentiment in Bankipur, with a strong majority of interviewees expressing firm support for the BJP, citing development, party loyalty, and the continuous presence of their leaders. However, a significant segment of the youth and some disillusioned voters express a strong desire for change, highlighting issues like unemployment, inflation, and dissatisfaction with the current political establishment, with some specifically mentioning Prashant Kishor as a potential catalyst for change.

metadata.title: बांकीपुर की पढ़ी-लिखी महिलाएं किसे किसे देंगी वोट..बहुत बड़ा गेम हो गया! Bankipur Election Exit Poll
metadata.constituency_audit_reason: Video title and summary explicitly mention 'Bankipur Election Exit Poll' and by-election context.

analysis.video_title: बांकीपुर की पढ़ी-लिखी महिलाएं किसे किसे देंगी वोट..बहुत बड़ा गेम हो गया! Bankipur Election Exit Poll

respondents.key_reason: Expressed dissatisfaction with the current BJP candidate's lack of local engagement and personal connection, despite having supported BJP in the past. She desires change and a strong opposition.
respondents.quote_original: हम लोग चेंज चाहते हैं अब हम लोग बहुत आंख बंद करके हम लोगों ने भाजपा को सपोर्ट किया है। हम उनको जानते भी नहीं कि वो है कौन। स्ट्रांग ऑपोजिशन इज अ मस्ट।
respondents.quote_english: We want change now. We blindly supported BJP for a long time. We don't even know who he is. Strong opposition is a must.

respondents.key_reason: Previously supported BJP's Nitin Navin due to a personal connection, but now sees an opportunity in Jan Suraaj and Prashant Kishor for a new, articulate voice that represents common people and emphasizes transparency. She is willing to give a new party a chance.
respondents.quote_original: नितिन नवीन सर वो थे वो हमारे घर के बच्चा के जैसा थे हम लोग तो उनको हम लोग वोट देते थे एंड ही वाज वेरी गुड बहुत अच्छे थे। लेकिन इस बार हम लोग हम विशेष करके चाहते हैं कि प्रशांत किशोर को सुने वो हाउस में जाए और वो बोले हम लोग की बात को रखे। इस बार एक मौका मिला है कि जन स्वराज को भी हम लोग देखें।
respondents.quote_english: Nitin Navin sir, he was like a child of our house, we used to vote for him and he was very good. But this time, we especially want to listen to Prashant Kishor. We want him to go to the assembly and speak, to represent our voice. This time we got a chance to see Jan Suraaj as well.

respondents.key_reason: Desires change after a long period of the same leadership and wants to give a new, hopeful leader like Prashant Kishor a chance to govern, believing it's time for a different approach.
respondents.quote_original: हां थोड़ा चेंज होना चाहिए। बहुत दिन किए हैं जरा दूसरों को भी नया आदमी को भी मौका मिलना चाहिए। नया आदमी तो प्रशांत किशोर ही दिख रहे हैं। हम लोगों को भी चेंज देखना है। बस यही वजह है कि थोड़ा उनका भी शासन काल में देखते हैं क्या होता है।
respondents.quote_english: Yes, there should be some change. They have been there for a long time, others, new people should also get a chance. Prashant Kishor seems to be the new person. We also want to see change. That's the only reason, let's see what happens during his tenure.

respondents.key_reason: Acknowledges the good work done by Nitish Kumar in the past but is not yet ready to comment on the current candidate (Samrat), indicating a wait-and-see approach for new leadership.
respondents.quote_original: नीतीश कुमार तो बहुत अच्छा काम किए थे अभी तो सम्राट काम शुरू किए हैं अभी इनके बारे में कुछ कह नहीं सकते हैं।
respondents.quote_english: Nitish Kumar did very good work, now Samrat has just started working, we can't say anything about him yet.

respondents.key_reason: Unfamiliar with the current BJP candidate (Neeraj Kumar) and believes any vote for him would be for the party, not the individual. She desires change and is impressed by Prashant Kishor's intellectual background, but remains cautious about the overall election outcome and who will ultimately lead.
respondents.quote_original: कैंडिडेट को तो हम लोग उनसे तो ज्यादा परिचय नहीं है अननोन फेस भी नहीं है। अगर उनको वोट पड़ेगा तो बीजेपी के नाम पर पड़ जाएगा। बदलाव होना चाहिए। प्रशांत किशोर कुछ सबसे बड़ी बात है कि वो इंटेलेक्चुअल आदमी है पढ़े लिखे हैं कोई भी निर्णय लेंगे तो सोच समझ के लेंगे।
respondents.quote_english: We are not very familiar with the candidate, he is not a known face. If he gets votes, it will be in BJP's name. Change should happen. Prashant Kishor, the biggest thing is that he is an intellectual, educated person, he will take any decision thoughtfully.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures the sentiment of educated women in Bankipur regarding the upcoming by-election. Many express a strong desire for change and dissatisfaction with the incumbent BJP candidate's lack of local engagement, despite having supported BJP in the past. There is significant interest and hope placed on Prashant Kishor and Jan Suraaj as a new, intellectual alternative, though some remain undecided, waiting to see how new leaders perform.

metadata.title: Bankipur Byelection Public Opinion : किसका साथ दे रहे बांकीपुर के मुसलमान? Prashant Kishor | Neeraj
metadata.constituency_audit_reason: Video title and summary explicitly mention 'Bankipur Byelection' and by-election context.

analysis.video_title: Bankipur Byelection Public Opinion : किसका साथ दे रहे बांकीपुर के मुसलमान? Prashant Kishor | Neeraj

respondents.key_reason: Believes Jan Suraaj is the only viable option available.
respondents.quote_original: जनसुराज और क्या दूसरा कोई ऑप्शन है?
respondents.quote_english: Jan Suraaj, what other option is there?

respondents.key_reason: Supports Tanveer Alam Sheikh because he is from his locality, is visible, and is expected to work for the people. Expresses dissatisfaction with traditional candidates who are not seen in the area.
respondents.quote_original: तनवीर आलम शेख जो हैं वो मेरे ही मोहल्ले के हैं और वो हम लोग के काम करेंगे ये हम लोग को लगता है कि वो हम लोग का पूरा काम करेंगे वो।
respondents.quote_english: Tanveer Alam Sheikh is from my own locality, and he will work for us, we feel he will do all our work.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Mohammad Asad, male, voter from Bankipur.

respondents.key_reason: Supports Prashant Kishor for being educated, articulate, and speaking with evidence. Criticizes the current BJP candidate for lacking capability and accuses BJP of corruption ('chanda chori'). Believes a capable leader is needed in the assembly.
respondents.quote_original: प्रशांत किशोर पढ़ा-लिखा विद्वान व्यक्ति है और बोलने वाला व्यक्ति है वो। सारा बीजेपी तो चोर ही हो गया है।
respondents.quote_english: Prashant Kishor is an educated, scholarly person and someone who speaks up. The entire BJP has become thieves.

respondents.key_reason: Believes Jan Suraaj is the only viable option available for Muslim voters.
respondents.quote_original: जनसुराज और क्या दूसरा कोई ऑप्शन है?
respondents.quote_english: Jan Suraaj, what other option is there?

respondents.key_reason: Expresses strong dissatisfaction with the current BJP candidate's inability to speak for the people. Despite claiming a past affiliation with BJP, he states he is now for Jan Suraaj, seeking a leader who will genuinely advocate for the area's rights and development.
respondents.quote_original: जनसुराज ही कर रहे हैं हम नितिन नवीन को जानते हैं हम नहीं जानते किसी पार्टी को या किसी प्रत्याशी को हम नितिन नवीन को जानते हैं। हमको ऐसा नेता चाहिए जो मेरे लिए विधानसभा में जाकर के मेरा हक हुकूक का बात करे। मेरा क्षेत्र का विकास का बात करे।
respondents.quote_english: We are doing Jan Suraaj. We know Nitin Nabin. We don't know any other party or candidate. We know Nitin Nabin. We need a leader who will go to the assembly for me and speak for my rights. Who will speak for the development of my area.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, former BJP General Secretary for 13 years, eating pani puri, voter from Bankipur.

respondents.key_reason: Reluctant to disclose his preference, stating 'time will tell,' but strongly hints at a desire for 'parivartan' (change) and a 'big decision' on election day.
respondents.quote_original: आपका इशारा तो परिवर्तन की ओर। हां समझ गए आप जान ही रहे हैं आप।
respondents.quote_english: Your hint is towards change. Yes, you understand, you already know.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, shopkeeper in Khau Gali, Bankipur.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures public sentiment in Bankipur's Khau Gali regarding the by-election. Many Muslim voters express a strong inclination towards Jan Suraaj, led by Prashant Kishor, citing dissatisfaction with traditional candidates and the BJP's alleged corruption. While some acknowledge a wave for Jan Suraaj, others, including a former BJP functionary, indicate a shift towards Jan Suraaj due to a desire for change and better local representation. Some voters remain tight-lipped, hinting at a 'big decision' and 'parivartan' (change) on election day.

metadata.title: बांकीपुर: इस कचौड़ी दुकान पर चुनाव से पहले रिज़ल्ट, कौन जीता, प्रशांत किशोर या BJP?
metadata.constituency_audit_reason: Video title and summary explicitly mention 'Bankipur' and discuss election results in a local context.

analysis.video_title: बांकीपुर: इस कचौड़ी दुकान पर चुनाव से पहले रिज़ल्ट, कौन जीता, प्रशांत किशोर या BJP?

respondents.key_reason: Strongly opposes the current system due to daily extortion by Nagar Nigam and police, which makes earning a living impossible. Supports Prashant Kishor for promising to stop this corruption and bring change.
respondents.quote_original: हम लोग तो रोडे पर रह रहे हैं और एक दो दिन बीच 500 दो, फिर दो दिन 500 दो कमाएंगे क्या? हम तो खाते पीते बराबर कर लेते हैं सब।
respondents.quote_english: We are living on the streets, and every other day we have to pay 500, then again 500. What will we earn? We just manage to break even with our food and expenses.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, shopkeeper, operating for 20 years in Bakipur.

respondents.key_reason: Agrees with the widespread anger against extortion and poor governance. Rejects Samrat Chaudhary as Chief Minister and believes Nitish Kumar was better. Supports Prashant Kishor to contest and become CM, hoping for change.
respondents.quote_original: सम्राट चौधरी की वजह से। क्रिमिनल भी है और पूरा लिखा हुआ भी नहीं है, सातवां क्लास भी पास नहीं है।
respondents.quote_english: Because of Samrat Chaudhary. He is also a criminal and not fully educated, hasn't even passed 7th grade.

respondents.key_reason: Expresses deep frustration over constant extortion by Nagar Nigam and police, which makes it difficult to run their business. Supports Prashant Kishor as a candidate who can bring an end to this harassment.
respondents.quote_original: वसूली से तो नाराज तो है ही है भैया।
respondents.quote_english: We are definitely angry about the extortion, brother.

respondents.key_reason: Supports Prashant Kishor due to his educated background, good character, and new ideas, which resonate with the youth. Believes he can address the issues of extortion and bring positive change.
respondents.quote_original: क्योंकि वो पढ़े लिखे इंसान हैं, बढ़िया आदमी हैं और नए सोच के आगे से वो आ रहे हैं।
respondents.quote_english: Because he is an educated person, a good man, and he is coming forward with new ideas.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, private job, likely young/youth perspective.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video reveals a strong anti-incumbency sentiment among small shopkeepers and vendors in Bakipur, primarily driven by rampant extortion and harassment from the Nagar Nigam and police. All interviewees express deep dissatisfaction with the current situation and a desire for change. There is overwhelming support for Prashant Kishor to contest the upcoming by-election, with respondents viewing him as an educated leader who can address their grievances and bring an end to the corruption, while rejecting the current ruling party.

metadata.title: Patna Sahib Lok Sabha Election में किसकी लहर, Public Opinion Ravi Shankar Prasad Vs Shatrughan Sinha
metadata.constituency_audit_reason: Video explicitly focuses on 'Patna Sahib Lok Sabha Election', not Bankipur Assembly Constituency.

analysis.video_title: Patna Sahib Lok Sabha Election में किसकी लहर, Public Opinion Ravi Shankar Prasad Vs Shatrughan Sinha

respondents.key_reason: Believes the current government (BJP) has destroyed the poor and increased unemployment through policies like demonetization and GST. Supports Mahagathbandhan to save democracy and the constitution.
respondents.quote_original: हमारा नारा है बीजेपी भगाओ और बिहार बचाओ। जब से ये नरेंद्र मोदी का सरकार आया है, नोटबंदी, जीएसटी और यहां बालूबंद, जितना भी मजदूर भाई है यहां पर सब भुक्के रोजगार मर गया। 35000 आदमी बेरोजगार हो गया। क्या करें नीतीश कुमार यहां।
respondents.quote_english: Our slogan is 'Remove BJP and Save Bihar'. Ever since Narendra Modi's government came, demonetization, GST, and sand mining ban have led to all the laborers here dying of hunger and unemployment. 35,000 people are unemployed. What is Nitish Kumar doing here?

respondents.key_reason: Wants a representative who works for the people and focuses on all-round development, not just sits on the chair and serves the government. Believes Shatrughan Sinha has done development work and is honest.
respondents.quote_original: इसलिए हम लोग को चाहिए कि ऐसा सांसद जो हम लोगों के क्षेत्र का सर्वांगीण विकास करे, हम लोग को ऐसा सांसद चाहिए। वैसे तो अपना-अपना मत है, लेकिन मैं दोबारा शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा को चाहता हूं इसमें कहीं दो मत नहीं।
respondents.quote_english: Therefore, we need an MP who will ensure all-round development of our area. That's the kind of MP we want. Everyone has their own opinion, but I want Shatrughan Sinha again, there's no doubt about it.

respondents.key_reason: Supports Mahagathbandhan to save the country's democracy and constitution. Believes it's crucial for the nation's future.
respondents.quote_original: हम यहां गठबंधन के पक्ष में हैं। इसलिए बहुत जरूरी है कि देश लोकतंत्र बचाने के लिए, संविधान बचाने के लिए हम महागठबंधन के पक्ष में मत और लोगों से मत देने का अनुरोध करेंगे।
respondents.quote_english: We are in favor of the Mahagathbandhan here. Therefore, it is very important that to save the country's democracy and constitution, we will vote for the Mahagathbandhan and request others to do the same.

respondents.key_reason: Believes Shatrughan Sinha has done significant development work, citing projects like the Inland Waterways (Jahaj Rani) and AIIMS. Wants him to continue as MP.
respondents.quote_original: हम तो शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा ही ऐसा चाहिए सांसद। जहाज रानी उन्हीं का बनाया हुआ है गाय घाट में। एम्स लाने का उन्हीं का योगदान है। बहुत सा काम किए हैं।
respondents.quote_english: We want Shatrughan Sinha as the MP. The Inland Waterways (Jahaj Rani) at Gai Ghat was built by him. He contributed to bringing AIIMS. He has done a lot of work.

respondents.key_reason: Believes the current government has destroyed the poor and increased unemployment. Supports Mahagathbandhan for societal change, peace, and to save secularism and the constitution.
respondents.quote_original: ये गठबंधन का जो जब से सरकार बनेगी तो सोसाइटी चेंज होगा यहां का। हमारा नारा है बीजेपी भगाओ और बिहार बचाओ। जब से ये नरेंद्र मोदी का सरकार आया है, नोटबंदी, जीएसटी और यहां बालूबंद, जितना भी मजदूर भाई है यहां पर सब भुक्के रोजगार मर गया। 35000 आदमी बेरोजगार हो गया।
respondents.quote_english: When the Mahagathbandhan government is formed, society here will change. Our slogan is 'Remove BJP and Save Bihar'. Ever since Narendra Modi's government came, demonetization, GST, and sand mining ban have led to all the laborers here dying of hunger and unemployment. 35,000 people are unemployed.

respondents.key_reason: Believes the current government (BJP) has failed to fulfill its promises and has suppressed the voice of the people. Supports Mahagathbandhan to protect secularism, the constitution, and ensure employment and peace.
respondents.quote_original: उनकी जितनी भी जो लोहानी 2014 की जो नारे थी, वो एक भी नारा जो है कि आज पूरा के पूरा नारा ठंडे बस्ते में बंद है। और जो है कि यहां की विकास जो है कि एकदम अवरुद्ध है। इसलिए विकास के लिए शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा इसके पहले भी विकास किए हैं ऐसा बात नहीं है कि नहीं किए हैं।
respondents.quote_english: All the attractive slogans of 2014 are now in cold storage. And the development here is completely stalled. Shatrughan Sinha has done development work before, it's not that he hasn't.

respondents.key_reason: Believes the current government has harmed businesses and the poor. Supports Shatrughan Sinha and Mahagathbandhan because Sinha was good when he was with BJP, but now that he's with Congress, BJP criticizes him, implying BJP is not 'Ganga Jal' (pure).
respondents.quote_original: इस सरकार जो जब से बना गरीब आदमी को खत्म कर दिया। गरीबी मने जो हटाने के लिए जो बोला गरीबी को हटा दिया। इसलिए शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा और गठबंधन के सरकार आना जरूरी है।
respondents.quote_english: Ever since this government was formed, it has destroyed the poor. It said it would remove poverty, but it removed the poor. That's why Shatrughan Sinha and the Mahagathbandhan government must come.

respondents.key_reason: Believes BJP should be the MP. No specific reason given, but implies satisfaction with current development.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी का होना चाहिए।
respondents.quote_english: It should be BJP.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, named Raju Ben, does not work.

respondents.key_reason: Believes Ravi Shankar Prasad should be the MP. No specific reason given, but implies satisfaction with current development.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी का होना चाहिए। रवि शंकर प्रसाद। हां पक्का लग रहा है।
respondents.quote_english: It should be BJP. Ravi Shankar Prasad. Yes, it feels certain.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, named Pradeep Kumar, works in boring (drilling).

respondents.key_reason: Believes Shatrughan Sinha is a good leader who has done good work and development in Patna Sahib, citing visible improvements in roads.
respondents.quote_original: शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा ही। क्योंकि वो अच्छे नेता है, अच्छा काम करते हैं इसीलिए। काम करते हैं इसीलिए शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा। हां विकास किए हैं।
respondents.quote_english: Shatrughan Sinha. Because he is a good leader, he does good work, that's why. He works, that's why Shatrughan Sinha. Yes, he has done development.

analysis.overall_video_summary: This ground report from Patna Sahib Lok Sabha constituency reveals a mixed public sentiment, with strong support for both Shatrughan Sinha (Congress/Mahagathbandhan) and Ravi Shankar Prasad (BJP). Supporters of Sinha highlight his past development work and honesty, while critics of the BJP government point to issues like unemployment, demonetization, and the need to protect democracy. Conversely, BJP supporters express satisfaction with existing development and prefer Ravi Shankar Prasad, though some remain undecided, emphasizing the need for a candidate who genuinely works for the people.

analysis.video_title: Patna Sahib Lok Sabha | Public Opinion On 2019 Election | PM Modi | Rahul Gandhi | Shatrughan Sinha

respondents.key_reason: Supports both Modi and Nitish Kumar, indicating satisfaction with the current alliance's leadership.
respondents.quote_english: Modi's... Modi's... Nitish Kumar's... Yes.

respondents.key_reason: Believes Lalu Prasad Yadav's political relevance and work are finished, implying support for the alternative.
respondents.quote_original: लालू जी के काम खत्म हो गया
respondents.quote_english: Lalu ji's work is finished.

respondents.key_reason: Prefers Modi, indicating satisfaction with his work.
respondents.quote_original: सर मोदी को पसंद करेंगे
respondents.quote_english: Sir, I will prefer Modi.

respondents.key_reason: Praises Modi for doing a lot of good work.
respondents.quote_original: मोदी बहुत अच्छा काम किया है। बहुत काम किए हैं वो।
respondents.quote_english: Modi has done very good work. He has done a lot of work.

respondents.key_reason: Supports Rahul Gandhi because Modi failed to fulfill promises, especially regarding unemployment.
respondents.quote_original: मैं तो राहुल को पसंद करूंगा। इसलिए कि मोदी जो भी वादा किया था वो कुछ भी नहीं किया है उसमें से सिंगल वर्क मेन है बेरोजगारी।
respondents.quote_english: I will prefer Rahul. Because whatever promises Modi made, he did nothing, the single main issue is unemployment.

respondents.key_reason: Prefers Rahul Gandhi, stating that Modi made promises but did not deliver any work.
respondents.quote_original: हमको राहुल बढ़िया है। मोदी तो वादा किए हैं कुछ काम नहीं किया।
respondents.quote_english: Rahul is better for me. Modi made promises but did no work.

respondents.key_reason: Highlights unemployment as the major issue in the election, without stating a party preference.
respondents.quote_original: बड़ा मुद्दा बेकारी है।
respondents.quote_english: The big issue is unemployment.

respondents.key_reason: Supports Modi due to the extensive development work he has undertaken.
respondents.quote_original: मोदी जी। मोदी जी बहुत विकास के काम किए हैं।
respondents.quote_english: Modi ji. Modi ji has done a lot of development work.

respondents.key_reason: Praises Modi for good work, mentioning the Mudra Yojana and overall development.
respondents.quote_original: मोदी अच्छा काम कर रहे हैं। मुद्रा योजना दिया, विकास किया।
respondents.quote_english: Modi is doing good work. He gave Mudra Yojana, brought development.

respondents.key_reason: Identifies employment as the primary concern for the election, without expressing a party preference.
respondents.quote_original: बड़ा मुद्दा तो रोजगार है।
respondents.quote_english: The big issue is employment.

respondents.key_reason: Admires Modi as a strong leader who taught Pakistan a lesson through strikes.
respondents.quote_original: मोदी एक ऐसा नेता है जो पाकिस्तान को आज तक कुछ नहीं सबक सिखाया जो पाकिस्तान को सबक सिखाया स्ट्राइक करके।
respondents.quote_english: Modi is such a leader who taught Pakistan a lesson, which no one had done before, by striking.

respondents.key_reason: Criticizes Rahul Gandhi for lacking maturity and praises Modi as a 'fakkar neta' (fearless leader) who is moving forward, similar to Lalu's strong leadership in the past.
respondents.quote_original: राहुल पूरा परिपक्व नहीं हुए हैं अभी तक। वो प्रियंका गांधी से भी पीछे चल जाते हैं। मोदी जी जो हैं नरेंद्र मोदी वो एक फक्कर नेता के रूप में हैं। जैसे लालू का दौर था फक्कर नेता जिसके आगे कोई नहीं टिकता था। तो लालू बेचारा अभी बाहर तो मोदी आगे निकल रहे हैं।
respondents.quote_english: Rahul is not fully mature yet. He even falls behind Priyanka Gandhi. Modi ji, Narendra Modi, is like a fearless leader. Like Lalu's era, a fearless leader whom no one could stand against. So Lalu is now out, and Modi is moving ahead.

respondents.key_reason: Expresses satisfaction with the improved cleanliness under the current government and expects further progress.
respondents.quote_original: बहुत ज्यादा पहले से तो बहुत साफ सफाई है। फिर आगे की ओर होते चलेगा और क्या है।
respondents.quote_english: There is much more cleanliness than before. It will continue to improve further.

respondents.key_reason: Supports Modi for extensive development work (flyovers, smart city, metro) and reduction in corruption, believing he needs more time to achieve full potential.
respondents.quote_original: मुझे तो मोदी को ही वोट करना है। क्योंकि मोदी ने बहुत सारे डेवलपमेंट का वर्क किया है यहां पर और उन्होंने फ्लाईओवर फिर स्मार्ट सिटी के लिए पटना फिर हुआ है और बहुत सारा जैसे हां मेट्रो का काम हुआ है और करप्शन बहुत एलिमिनेट हुआ है उनकी वजह से। ऐसा नहीं है पूरी तरह से नहीं हुआ बट बहुत हद तक हुआ है जो आगे जाकर ऐसा और फाइव इयर्स के टर्म्स में बहुत कुछ नहीं चेंज हो सकता बट उनको एक बार और चांस दिया जाएगा तो वो बहुत कुछ डेवलपमेंट कर सकते हैं हमारे कंट्री में।
respondents.quote_english: I have to vote for Modi. Because Modi has done a lot of development work here, and he has done flyovers, then Patna for Smart City, and a lot of other things like metro work has happened, and corruption has been greatly eliminated because of him. It's not that it's completely gone, but it has been reduced to a great extent, which will continue further. And in a five-year term, not everything can change, but if he is given one more chance, he can do a lot of development in our country.

respondents.key_reason: Believes Modi has worked on improving educational infrastructure in Patna and will continue to do so, addressing youth migration. Also highlights startup initiatives.
respondents.quote_original: ये समस्या ही तो है कि वो यहां से पढ़ाई करने के बाद दिल्ली के पास चले जाते हैं। दैट इज ये ऐसा इसलिए होता है क्योंकि पटना में यहां पे इतना पढ़ाई को लेके इतना इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर अभी है नहीं। लेकिन देखा जाए तो पिछले पांच साल में जब से मोदी जी आए हैं वो पटना में आकर भी पढ़ाई के इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर पे वर्क करके गए हैं। जैसे कि पटना यूनिवर्सिटी आए थे और पटना वुमेन्स कॉलेज की छात्राओं के साथ उन्होंने वीडियो कॉन्फ्रेंसिंग पे पढ़ाई के ऊपर बात भी करी थी। तो अगर वो आते हैं दोबारा से पावर में तो ये चीज का गारंटी है कि पढ़ाई को लेकर के बहुत इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर डेवलप हो सकता है सिर्फ पटना में नहीं कंट्री में क्योंकि कंट्री के सारे लोग जो युवा हैं वो यहां से पढ़ने के बाद बाहर जाकर ही काम करना पसंद करते हैं। लेकिन जब से वो आए हैं तब से स्टार्टअप योजना और ये सब कितना कुछ लेकर।
respondents.quote_english: This is the problem that after studying here, they go to Delhi. This happens because Patna doesn't have enough educational infrastructure right now. But looking at the last five years, since Modi ji came, he has worked on educational infrastructure even after coming to Patna. For example, he visited Patna University and also discussed education with students of Patna Women's College via video conferencing. So, if he comes to power again, it's a guarantee that a lot of infrastructure can be developed for education, not just in Patna but across the country, because all the youth in the country prefer to go outside to work after studying here. But since he came, he has brought so many startup schemes and all.

respondents.key_reason: States that people are uniting from all sides to defeat the current government, implying support for the opposition alliance.
respondents.quote_original: लोग इकट्ठा हो गए हैं। मैंने चारों तरफ से मिल के इनको हराना चाह रहे हैं।
respondents.quote_english: People have united. From all sides, they want to defeat them.

respondents.key_reason: Supports Modi for significant development work and for teaching people how to effectively use technology.
respondents.quote_original: मोदी जी को ही सपोर्ट करेंगे क्योंकि बहुत सारा डेवलपमेंट उन्होंने किया। साथ में मैंने उन्होंने लोगों को सिखा दिया कि जैसे टेक्नोलॉजी थी लेकिन टेक्नोलॉजी को कैसे यूज करना है उन्होंने यह चीज सिखा दिया।
respondents.quote_english: We will support Modi ji because he has done a lot of development. Also, he taught people how to use technology, even though technology existed, he showed how to utilize it.

respondents.key_reason: Focuses on national leadership, arguing that Rahul Gandhi lacks qualities beyond his family name, making Modi the preferred choice for India's leader.
respondents.quote_original: मुद्दे की बात मैं यार की क्या समस्या है? शहर की समस्या को मैं एक साइड रखूंगा मैं अभी यहां देश की बात करूंगा सबसे जरूरी क्योंकि लोकसभा का चुनाव देश का चुनाव है और विश्व का सबसे बड़ा लोकतंत्र है भारत। तो भारत का नेता भारत का लीडर कैसा हो। अगर एज अ लीडर आप राहुल गांधी और नरेंद्र मोदी को कंपेयर करेंगे तो मेरे अंदर गांधी परिवार के अलावा राहुल गांधी में और कोई दूसरी खूबी नहीं है सबसे बड़ी बात।
respondents.quote_english: What is the problem with the issue? I will keep the city's problems aside; I will talk about the country here, which is most important because the Lok Sabha election is the country's election, and India is the world's largest democracy. So, what kind of leader should India have? If you compare Rahul Gandhi and Narendra Modi as leaders, in my opinion, Rahul Gandhi has no other quality besides being from the Gandhi family, that's the biggest thing.

respondents.key_reason: Praises Modi's international relations and national presence. Provides a personal example of development in Bihar, stating he returned from a Delhi job to Patna due to new IT companies, indicating increased local job opportunities.
respondents.quote_original: मोदी जी में खूबी है आप पिछले पांच सालों में देखिए वो देश के अलग-अलग जगहों पे गए उसके अलावा वर्ल्ड में कितनी कंट्रीज में वो गए। अमेरिका गए, रशिया गए, हर जगह उन्होंने अच्छे रिश्ते बनाए। मेरे क्षेत्र में ये विकास हुआ कि सर आज से पांच साल पहले मैं दिल्ली में जॉब करता था। मैं अपने घर को छोड़ के वहां जॉब करता था और आज बिहार के अंदर इतनी आईटी कंपनीज खुल गई हैं कि मैं दिल्ली का जॉब छोड़ के वापस पटना में जॉब कर रहा हूं।
respondents.quote_english: Modi ji has qualities; in the last five years, you can see he visited different places in the country, and how many countries he visited worldwide. He went to America, Russia, everywhere he built good relations. In my region, this development happened: sir, five years ago, I used to work in Delhi. I left my home and worked there, and today so many IT companies have opened up in Bihar that I left my Delhi job and am now working in Patna.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, adult, previously worked in Delhi, now works in Patna (implied IT sector).

respondents.key_reason: Expresses a general desire for an accessible representative who listens to problems and works for the people, without endorsing a specific party.
respondents.quote_original: मैं ऐसा सांसद चुनना चाहूंगा जो हमारे बीच रहे, हमारी समस्या को सुने और हमारे लिए काम करे।
respondents.quote_english: I would like to elect such an MP who stays among us, listens to our problems, and works for us.

respondents.key_reason: Strongly criticizes the Mahagathbandhan, particularly RJD, for its non-existence in Bihar, the corruption of its leader (Lalu), and the unqualified and feuding nature of his sons.
respondents.quote_original: महागठबंधन में है कौन सर? आरजेडी बिहार में है ही नहीं, आरजेडी तो साफ है। उनके लीडर चारा खा कर के जेल में बैठे हुए हैं। उनके दोनों बेटे आपस में लड़ रहे हैं। एक 10वीं है, एक सातवीं फेल है। आप ऐसे बंदे को लीडर कैसे चुन सकते हैं?
respondents.quote_english: Who is in Mahagathbandhan, sir? RJD doesn't even exist in Bihar, RJD is finished. Their leader is sitting in jail after eating fodder (corruption). Both his sons are fighting among themselves. One is 10th pass, one is 7th fail. How can you choose such a person as a leader?

respondents.key_reason: Believes Lalu Prasad Yadav's political era is over and his name no longer holds any benefit, implying support for the opposition.
respondents.quote_original: लालू को खत्म हो गया है। अब लालू के नाम में फायदा है।
respondents.quote_english: Lalu is finished. There is no benefit in Lalu's name now.

respondents.key_reason: Dismisses Tejashwi Yadav as 'zero' and 'finished,' criticizing him for not providing good education or jobs and for becoming rich through family influence, while now opposing Modi.
respondents.quote_original: वो तो सब जीरो है सर। खत्म है वो। ना अच्छा शिक्षा मिला ना पढ़ाई मिला। बाप के बदौलत जो है से पूरा अमीर बन गया। आज इन्हें उन्हें चल रहे हैं मोदी के विरोध में यह कर ले।
respondents.quote_english: He is all zero, sir. He is finished. Neither good education nor studies were provided. He became completely rich due to his father. Today, they are going around opposing Modi.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures diverse public opinions in Patna Sahib regarding the 2019 Lok Sabha elections, primarily focusing on the Modi vs. Rahul debate. A significant number of respondents express strong support for PM Modi, citing development, infrastructure, national security, and efforts against corruption, with some first-time voters also endorsing him for educational infrastructure and startup initiatives. Conversely, a smaller but vocal group supports Rahul Gandhi, criticizing Modi for unfulfilled promises and unemployment, while others express strong disapproval of the RJD and Mahagathbandhan leadership.

analysis.video_title: Patna Sahib Lok Sabha: Ravi Shankar Prasad Vs Shatrughan Sinha, जनता किसके साथ Public Opinion

respondents.key_reason: Shatrughan Sinha was absent from the constituency after winning the last election and did not do any development work. Prefers BJP regardless of the candidate.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी को। चाहे कोई खड़ा हो जाए। शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा पिछले बार जीते ना, उसके बाद तो फिर नजर नहीं आए।
respondents.quote_english: To BJP. No matter who stands. Shatrughan Sinha won last time, but after that, he wasn't seen.

respondents.key_reason: Ravi Shankar Prasad is a good candidate, a central minister, and will bring development to Patna Sahib. Shatrughan Sinha was never seen after winning and did no work.
respondents.quote_original: अच्छे उम्मीदवार हैं। मंत्री बनते ही हैं सेंट्रल में। पटना साहिब के विकास करेंगे। वो तो कभी नजर नहीं आते।
respondents.quote_english: He is a good candidate. He becomes a minister in the central government. He will develop Patna Sahib. He is never seen.

respondents.key_reason: Ravi Shankar Prasad is a good candidate who has made promises for development, such as building a bridge. He is considered much better than Shatrughan Sinha.
respondents.quote_original: अच्छे उम्मीदवार हैं। उम्मीदें हैं जो उम्मीद है जैसे बख्तियापुर क्षेत्र के सामने गंगा किनारे पुल बनवाने का घोषणा किए हैं। शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा से अच्छे हैं। बहुत अच्छे हैं।
respondents.quote_english: He is a good candidate. There are hopes, like the hope that he announced building a bridge across the Ganga in front of Bakhtiyarpur area. He is better than Shatrughan Sinha. Much better.

respondents.key_reason: Ravi Shankar Prasad is a central minister and is capable of bringing development to the area.
respondents.quote_original: केंद्रीय मंत्री हैं, काहे नहीं कर सकते। चाहेंगे तो का ना हो सकता।
respondents.quote_english: He is a central minister, why can't he do it? If he wants, why can't it happen?
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, from Delhi (not a local resident of Patna Sahib)

respondents.key_reason: Both candidates (Shatrughan Sinha and Ravi Shankar Prasad) are central ministers, making it difficult to choose who is better at this time.
respondents.quote_original: इसमें हम लोग क्या कह सकते हैं। दोनों तो केंद्रीय मंत्री हैं। किसी को बेहतर इस समय में नहीं कहा जा सकता।
respondents.quote_english: What can we say about this? Both are central ministers. No one can be called better at this time.

respondents.key_reason: Does not know Ravi Shankar Prasad and does not understand Shatrughan Sinha's candidacy.
respondents.quote_original: नहीं पहचानते। समझ नहीं रहे हैं।
respondents.quote_english: Don't know him. Don't understand.

respondents.key_reason: Hopes Shatrughan Sinha will do development this time.
respondents.quote_original: शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा इस बार उतर रहे हैं, क्या लगता है? विकास करेंगे? अब देखिए हो सकता है। इस बार तो पूरा शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा को दें।
respondents.quote_english: Shatrughan Sinha is contesting this time, what do you think? Will he do development? Now, let's see, maybe. This time, give it all to Shatrughan Sinha.

respondents.key_reason: Strong party loyalty to BJP, stating they would vote for any candidate put forth by the party, regardless of who it is.
respondents.quote_original: हम लोग अंधरा लंगड़ा का भी खड़ा कर देगा तो उसी को देंगे वोट। बीजेपी को। प्रत्याशी से हमको मतलब नहीं है, हमको पार्टी से मतलब है।
respondents.quote_english: If they put up even a blind or lame person, we will vote for them. To BJP. We don't care about the candidate, we care about the party.

respondents.key_reason: Claims to be new to the area and uneducated, therefore uninformed about the candidates.
respondents.quote_original: उनके बारे में मालूम नहीं है। पढ़ा लिखा नहीं ना। हम नवा आदमी है, हम ना जाने भाई।
respondents.quote_english: Don't know about him. Not educated. I am a new person, I don't know, brother.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, claims to be new and uneducated

respondents.key_reason: Does not know Shatrughan Sinha.
respondents.quote_original: ना हम ना जानते हैं।
respondents.quote_english: No, I don't know him.

respondents.key_reason: Evasive, unwilling to state a direct opinion on Ravi Shankar Prasad.
respondents.quote_original: बताना से कहेंगे तो बताएंगे।
respondents.quote_english: If you ask me to tell, I will tell.

respondents.key_reason: Finds Ravi Shankar Prasad to be a 'fine' candidate.
respondents.quote_original: ठीक लग रहे हैं।
respondents.quote_english: He seems fine.

respondents.key_reason: Believes Ravi Shankar Prasad is a good candidate who can bring development and get things done.
respondents.quote_original: अच्छे लग रहे हैं कि अपना कुछ आगे कर सकते हैं, कुछ करा सकते हैं।
respondents.quote_english: He seems good, that he can do something further, can get things done.

respondents.key_reason: Prefers Shatrughan Sinha, though acknowledges both candidates have their merits.
respondents.quote_original: हमको तो शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा ही बेहतर लग रहे हैं। अपना जगह पर दोनों बेहतर हैं।
respondents.quote_english: To me, Shatrughan Sinha seems better. Both are good in their own place.

respondents.key_reason: Hopes for development are attached to Ravi Shankar Prasad, similar to how they are attached to Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
respondents.quote_original: उनसे तो बहुत सा जैसे नरेंद्र मोदी से उम्मीद जुड़ा हुआ है, उसी तरह उनसे भी है।
respondents.quote_english: Many hopes are attached to him, just like with Narendra Modi.

respondents.key_reason: Shatrughan Sinha was not seen after winning the last election and did no development work. Ravi Shankar Prasad is seen as a more present and active candidate.
respondents.quote_original: शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा पिछले बार जीते ना, उसके बाद तो फिर नजर नहीं आए। विकास का काम किया है कि नहीं क्षेत्र में शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा? नहीं।
respondents.quote_english: Shatrughan Sinha won last time, but after that, he wasn't seen. Did Shatrughan Sinha do development work in the area? No.

respondents.key_reason: Ravi Shankar Prasad is considered the best candidate, while Shatrughan Sinha was rarely seen and did not do any development work.
respondents.quote_original: उससे बढ़िया उम्मीदवार तो यहां है नहीं। दर्शन दुर्लभ है उनका। विकास का काम उन्होंने नहीं किया।
respondents.quote_english: There is no better candidate than him here. His darshan (sight) is rare. He did not do development work.

respondents.key_reason: Acknowledges that development is happening but is unsure who is responsible, feeling disconnected from the process.
respondents.quote_original: विकास हो रहा है लेकिन अब कौन कर रहा है ये पता नहीं। क्योंकि हम लोग तो उससे जुड़े हुए हैं नहीं।
respondents.quote_english: Development is happening, but who is doing it is unknown. Because we are not connected to that.

respondents.key_reason: Views Ravi Shankar Prasad as the only viable option or alternative.
respondents.quote_original: रवि शंकर प्रसाद ही विकल्प है।
respondents.quote_english: Ravi Shankar Prasad is the only option.

respondents.key_reason: Ravi Shankar Prasad is a very good candidate from BJP, and there are hopes that he will bring development.
respondents.quote_original: बहुत अच्छे उम्मीदवार हैं। भाजपा से अभी खड़ा हो रहे हैं। उम्मीद तो उनसे है कि अभी रवि शंकर प्रसाद विकास करेंगे।
respondents.quote_english: He is a very good candidate. He is currently standing from BJP. There are hopes from him that Ravi Shankar Prasad will do development now.

respondents.key_reason: Criticizes Shatrughan Sinha for not being seen after an initial development project (Gai Ghat ship), implying a preference for the alternative (Ravi Shankar Prasad).
respondents.quote_original: शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा ने जो भी किया गाय घाट में जो जहाज का जो बनाया, उसके बाद उनका दर्शन तक नहीं हो पाया।
respondents.quote_english: Whatever Shatrughan Sinha did, like building the ship at Gai Ghat, after that, he was not even seen.

respondents.key_reason: Considers Ravi Shankar Prasad to be the better candidate currently.
respondents.quote_original: बेहतर तो अभी हैं रवि शंकर प्रसाद।
respondents.quote_english: Ravi Shankar Prasad is better right now.

respondents.key_reason: Ravi Shankar Prasad is a good candidate, but there's a cynical expectation of 'Guru Dakshina' (something in return) from whoever is standing, implying a demand for accountability or benefits.
respondents.quote_original: अच्छे हैं। हां कहिए कि गुरु दक्षिणा भी तो दीजिए।
respondents.quote_english: He is good. Yes, say that you should also give Guru Dakshina.

respondents.key_reason: Cynical view that all politicians are the same and are primarily focused on personal gain once in power.
respondents.quote_original: कोई रहे। और वहां तो जाकर कमाना है। कोई पार्टी रहे।
respondents.quote_english: Whoever it is. And there, one has to go and earn. Whichever party it is.

respondents.key_reason: Strongly criticizes Shatrughan Sinha for joining Congress, calling it foolish, thereby implicitly supporting the BJP candidate.
respondents.quote_original: शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा तो बेवकूफ है कि जो गया है से मिलकर के खड़ा होवे लगी कांग्रेस में।
respondents.quote_english: Shatrughan Sinha is foolish to have gone and joined Congress.

respondents.key_reason: Implies long-standing support or familiarity with BJP candidates, suggesting they are not new to supporting the party.
respondents.quote_original: देखिए हम लोग बीजेपी का नया कैंडिडेट नहीं है।
respondents.quote_english: Look, we are not new to BJP's candidates (or supporting BJP).

respondents.key_reason: Ravi Shankar Prasad has a good image. Shatrughan Sinha had hopes attached to him but failed to deliver.
respondents.quote_original: बढ़िया है, उनका छवि तो ठीक है। उम्मीदें तो बहुत कुछ है शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा से भी थे उम्मीद थे लेकिन वो तो खड़े नहीं उतरे सर।
respondents.quote_english: He is good, his image is fine. There were many hopes, even from Shatrughan Sinha, but he didn't stand up, sir.

respondents.key_reason: Views Ravi Shankar Prasad as the better candidate, especially after Shatrughan Sinha joined Congress.
respondents.quote_original: कांग्रेस में चले गए हैं शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा। बेहतर कौन लग रहा है? रवि शंकर प्रसाद।
respondents.quote_english: Shatrughan Sinha has gone to Congress. Who seems better? Ravi Shankar Prasad.

respondents.key_reason: Criticizes Shatrughan Sinha for being absent from the constituency and rarely meeting people, implying a lack of development work.
respondents.quote_original: वो फील्ड में रहे ही नहीं तो विकास क्या करेंगे? उनसे तो भेंट मुलाकात भी दुर्लभ है।
respondents.quote_english: He didn't stay in the field, so what development will he do? Even meeting him is rare.

respondents.key_reason: Considers Ravi Shankar Prasad a good candidate and has many hopes for him, provided they are fulfilled.
respondents.quote_original: बढ़िया है। उम्मीद तो बहुत रहती है पर हो पाए तब तो। ऐसे बढ़िया ही हैं।
respondents.quote_english: He is good. There are many hopes, but if they can be fulfilled. Otherwise, he is good.

respondents.key_reason: Expresses cynicism about political promises and disappointment with Shatrughan Sinha's lack of development work and absence from the constituency.
respondents.quote_original: उम्मीद तो बहुत लड़ाई आती है पर आशा नहीं, आशा हो जाता है। उम्मीद तो थी पर नहीं किया है अभी तक कुछ। क्षेत्र में आते थे शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा? नहीं। कभी नहीं आए।
respondents.quote_english: Many hopes arise, but hope doesn't become reality. There was hope, but he hasn't done anything yet. Did Shatrughan Sinha come to the area? No. Never came.

respondents.key_reason: Willing to give Ravi Shankar Prasad a chance.
respondents.quote_original: रवि शंकर प्रसाद को एक चांस लेकर देखते हैं।
respondents.quote_english: Let's give Ravi Shankar Prasad a chance and see.

analysis.overall_video_summary: This ground report from Patna Sahib captures public sentiment regarding the Lok Sabha elections, primarily focusing on the contest between Ravi Shankar Prasad (BJP) and Shatrughan Sinha (Congress). A majority of interviewees express strong support or a leaning towards Ravi Shankar Prasad, often citing his potential for development and Shatrughan Sinha's perceived absence and lack of work in the constituency after his previous win. While some respondents remain undecided or express cynicism about politicians, the prevailing mood suggests a preference for the BJP candidate, with development and candidate presence being critical issues for the voters.

respondents.key_reason: Criticizes Modi's government for 10 years of suffering, inflation, and being an enemy of the poor. Believes Modi demolishes huts and increases prices. Also criticizes Nitish Kumar's liquor ban, which he claims leads to deaths from fake liquor and police harassment. Supports Congress to defeat Modi and Nitish.
respondents.quote_original: हम हम देखो मोदी के राज में 10 साल से घुट घुट के मर रहे हैं। मोदी सरकार रहेगा तो सारा गरीब आदमी पागल हो जाएगा। इसलिए पागल बनने से बच्चे से अच्छा है बनने से पहले मोदी के हरावे और हरा के कांग्रेस के लावे।
respondents.quote_english: Look, we are dying under Modi's rule for 10 years. If Modi's government stays, all poor people will go mad. So, it's better to defeat Modi and bring Congress before going mad.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Poor man, street vendor (runs a cart/thela), likely from Bihar.

respondents.key_reason: Believes both BJP and Congress have created a monopoly, but sees hope in Rahul Gandhi and Congress to address corruption and grassroots issues. Criticizes Modi as a 'Natwarlal' who made false promises and current politicians for lacking real knowledge and misusing power. Feels Congress will win this time.
respondents.quote_original: मुझे लग रहा है कि कांग्रेस इस बार जो है इस देश में वो अपना झंडा लहराएंगे।
respondents.quote_english: I feel that Congress will hoist its flag in this country this time.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Ram Bharos Yadav, from Jaynagar, living in Patna for work, educated, concerned about youth and society.

respondents.key_reason: As a poor person, he believes Congress will win and represents the interests of the poor. He is willing to endure criticism for his choice.
respondents.quote_original: कांग्रेस जीतेगा गरीब आदमी सब कांग्रेस के वोट देगा।
respondents.quote_english: Congress will win, all poor people will vote for Congress.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Poor man, street vendor (sells groceries on a cart).

respondents.key_reason: Strongly criticizes Modi for unfulfilled promises (like Rs 3 lakh in bank accounts) and for making the country poor and hungry. Believes Modi is a liar and that the Congress candidate is a good person. His own business is suffering.
respondents.quote_original: मोदी जी बोलिन थे आगे कि ₹3 लाख गरीब के खाता पर आएगा... नहीं आया। तो तो एक नंबर के झूठा लुच्चा बन गए वो।
respondents.quote_english: Modi ji had said earlier that 3 lakh rupees would come into the accounts of the poor... It didn't come. So he became a first-class liar and scoundrel.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Older man, railway station coolie (porter), struggling financially, mentions Paswan and Muslim communities voting for Congress.

respondents.key_reason: Has always supported BJP and believes there is a strong BJP wave. He has observed Modi's government's work for the past 10 years. He considers Ravi Shankar Prasad good, despite not having seen him in the constituency.
respondents.quote_original: अपना होश में हम जब भी वोट दिए हैं तो बीजेपी को दिए हैं।
respondents.quote_english: In my conscious memory, whenever I have voted, I have voted for BJP.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Young man, has not yet voted due to his name missing from the voter list.

respondents.key_reason: Believes the current atmosphere favors BJP and that Congress is struggling. He dismisses the importance of specific issues.
respondents.quote_original: माहौल तो अभी बीजेपी का।
respondents.quote_english: The atmosphere is currently for BJP.

respondents.key_reason: Believes BJP is doing good work and has brought progress in every aspect, unlike Congress. Claims to be benefiting financially and that extortion has significantly reduced under BJP rule.
respondents.quote_original: 400 पार है अबकी बीजेपी। बीजेपी हर चीज में आगे जा रहा है। कोई चीज भी सब चीज तो कर ही दिया।
respondents.quote_english: BJP will cross 400 this time. BJP is moving forward in everything. It has done everything.

analysis.overall_video_summary: This ground report from Patna Sahib captures a mixed political sentiment among the public. While some respondents, particularly street vendors and laborers, express strong dissatisfaction with the Modi government over inflation, poverty, and unfulfilled promises, firmly supporting Congress, others, including a young man and a coconut vendor, are staunch BJP supporters, citing development, improved law and order, and overall progress. The debate often revolves around economic conditions, corruption, and the perceived performance of the ruling party versus the opposition.
