respondents.key_reason: Believes the party's nature is good and they are actively working for the public's benefit.
respondents.quote_original: हम कमल छाप में वोट देना चाहते हैं। क्योंकि वो अभी स्वभाव उनका बढ़िया है, कुछ कर रहे हैं जनता के लिए।
respondents.quote_english: We want to vote for the Lotus symbol. Because their nature is good, they are doing something for the public.

respondents.key_reason: Considers the NDA alliance government strong and supportive of its efforts for Patna and Bihar.
respondents.quote_original: गठबंधन की सरकार अभी मजबूत है और गठबंधन का ही हम लोग समर्थन कर रहे हैं। ... NDA गठबंधन।
respondents.quote_english: The alliance government is strong right now, and we are supporting the alliance. ... NDA alliance.

respondents.key_reason: Likes the Lotus symbol (BJP) because they are doing good work and not negatively impacting the public. Expresses dislike for Nitish Kumar.
respondents.quote_original: कमल छाप, नीतीश नहीं पसंद है। ... काम अच्छा कर रहे हैं। जनता पर प्रभाव नहीं पड़ रहा है।
respondents.quote_english: Lotus symbol, don't like Nitish. ... They are doing good work. There is no negative impact on the public.

respondents.key_reason: Prefers the party that performs well; states a primary inclination towards supporting BJP.
respondents.quote_original: जो बढ़िया काम करेगा उसी को पसंद है। जो भी बढ़िया काम करे सरकार। ... वैसे हम मुख्यतः जो है बीजेपी को जो है सपोर्ट किए हैं।
respondents.quote_english: Whoever does good work, that's who we like. Whichever government does good work. ... Mainly, we have supported BJP.

respondents.key_reason: Has decided to support Mahagathbandhan, specifically in favor of Shatrughan Sinha.
respondents.quote_original: हम तो महागठबंधन की ओर जाएंगे। ... नहीं तो हमको जो है ये शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा के पक्ष में हैं।
respondents.quote_english: We will go towards Mahagathbandhan. ... No, we are in favor of Shatrughan Sinha.

respondents.key_reason: Believes the previous central government (Congress-led UPA) was better as it worked for women's rights and welfare.
respondents.quote_original: महिलाओं के लिए कुछ जरूर सोचती थी। महिलाओं के अधिकार के लिए बातें करती थी। ... जो अभी केंद्र में सरकार है उससे बेहतर सरकार पूर्व में थी।
respondents.quote_english: She definitely thought for women. She spoke for women's rights. ... The previous government was better than the current central government.

respondents.key_reason: Feels that given the current national atmosphere, BJP should come to power, and it would be a misfortune for India if they don't.
respondents.quote_original: अभी तो जिस जिस हिसाब से अभी चल रहा है माहौल, देश का, उस हिसाब से तो अभी बीजेपी को आना चाहिए। ... अगर नहीं आया तो ये भारत का दुर्भाग्य होगा।
respondents.quote_english: Given the current atmosphere in the country, BJP should come to power. ... If it doesn't, it will be India's misfortune.

respondents.key_reason: Believes there is a strong 'Modi wave' and that Modi will inevitably win.
respondents.quote_original: मोदी का लहर है, मोदी जीतेगा और क्या।
respondents.quote_english: There is a Modi wave, Modi will win, what else?

respondents.key_reason: Likes the Lotus symbol (BJP) and uses a metaphor of 'fragrant flowers' to imply positive sentiment towards the party's past and present.
respondents.quote_original: हमको भी कमल छाप पसंद है। पुराना फूल महक रहा है और नया फूल महक रहा है।
respondents.quote_english: I also like the Lotus symbol. The old flower is fragrant and the new flower is fragrant.

respondents.key_reason: Confident that BJP candidate Ravi Shankar Prasad will win by a significant margin.
respondents.quote_original: रविशंकर प्रसाद जी दो-तीन लाख वोट से जीतने जा रहे हैं।
respondents.quote_english: Ravi Shankar Prasad ji is going to win by two-three lakh votes.

respondents.key_reason: Believes that votes cast for Congress (and Shatrughan Sinha) will be wasted, indicating a negative stance towards them.
respondents.quote_original: इनका वोट बर्बाद होने जा रहा है मनु मनु जी का कांग्रेस में वोट तो मेरा भाई है कांग्रेस में वोट देने जा रहा है इनका वोट डैमेज होने जा रहा है।
respondents.quote_english: His vote is going to be wasted, Manu Manu ji's vote in Congress. My brother is going to vote for Congress, his vote is going to be damaged.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, general public, discussing a relative's vote.

respondents.key_reason: Expresses strong conviction that there is a significant BJP wave and they will win.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी को। हां मेरा मन वही है और कहूं नहीं। ... बहुत लहर है। और वही निकलेगा ही।
respondents.quote_english: BJP. Yes, that's my mind, I won't say anything else. ... There is a big wave. And they will win.

respondents.key_reason: Has always voted for BJP and believes Shatrughan Sinha made a mistake by joining Mahagathbandhan, thus having no chance of winning.
respondents.quote_original: हम लोग कांग्रेस के वोट आज तक नहीं दिए हैं। सब दिन मेरा वोट बीजेपी का गया है और बीजेपी का जाएगा। ... गलती किए हैं शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा को नहीं जाना चाहिए था उनको गठबंधन में।
respondents.quote_english: We have never voted for Congress till today. My vote has always gone to BJP and will go to BJP. ... He made a mistake, Shatrughan Sinha should not have gone into the alliance.

respondents.key_reason: Views both major alliances (NDA and Mahagathbandhan) as corrupt ('thieves') due to political opportunism, but suggests the public is forced to choose the 'lesser thief'. Indirectly points to the Law Minister (BJP) as a potential choice if they uphold the law.
respondents.quote_original: दोनों में दोनों चोर हैं। कलंकित दोनों पार्टी है। ... जनता को मजबूर होकर मजबूर में जो चोर कम है उसी को चुनने का अधिकार मिल रहा है। ... कम चोर तो अब निर्णय में तो कानून मंत्री अगर कानून सही रूप से जानते हैं जनता के लिए भी अपने लिए भी तो होरा भी जी को ये कानून मंत्री को चुनना चाहिए।
respondents.quote_english: Both of them, both are thieves. Both parties are tainted. ... The public is forced to choose the one who is 'less of a thief' among the forced choices. ... The 'lesser thief' is now a matter of decision, if the law minister truly understands the law, for the public and for himself, then they should choose the law minister.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, general public, highly critical and philosophical.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures public sentiment in Patna Sahib regarding the 2019 Lok Sabha elections. A significant number of interviewees expressed strong support for the BJP, citing good work, a 'Modi wave,' and confidence in their candidates. Conversely, some respondents favored the Mahagathbandhan, particularly supporting Shatrughan Sinha or the previous Congress-led central government for its focus on women's rights. One respondent was highly critical of both major alliances, viewing them as corrupt but reluctantly leaning towards the BJP as the 'lesser of two evils'.

metadata.title: Public Opinion From Patna Sahib Lok Sabha Constituency | Kehta Hai Voter | Mar 19, 2019
metadata.constituency_audit_reason: Video explicitly focuses on 'Patna Sahib Lok Sabha Constituency', not Bankipur Assembly Constituency.

analysis.video_title: Public Opinion From Patna Sahib Lok Sabha Constituency | Kehta Hai Voter | Mar 19, 2019

respondents.key_reason: Lack of development, rampant crime, poor infrastructure, and elected representatives being out of touch with the public.
respondents.quote_original: क्राइम इस तरह से अपने चरम सीमा अपने इस पर चढ़ गया है कि यहां पर आम आदमी अपने आप को असुरक्षित गैर महफूज महसूस कर रहा है। लाइन ऑर्डर का बहुत बड़ा मसला है।
respondents.quote_english: Crime has reached its peak here to such an extent that the common man feels insecure and unsafe. Law and order is a very big issue.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Adult male, resident of Patna Sahib.

respondents.key_reason: Politicians do nothing after winning elections, only appearing during campaigning. There's a lack of basic amenities like cleanliness and rising crime.
respondents.quote_original: वो कुछ नहीं करते हैं। बस उनका काम है जीतना बस अपने ऑफिस में बैठे रहना। बाकी कुछ नहीं, कोई कुछ नहीं करता यहां पर सिर्फ वोट के समय ही आते हैं सब।
respondents.quote_english: They do nothing. Their only job is to win and then sit in their office. Nobody does anything here, they only come during election time.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Adult male, resident of Patna Sahib.

respondents.key_reason: A strong desire for change in Bihar and improved cleanliness.
respondents.quote_original: बदलाव चाहिए यहां बिहार में। और थोड़ा साफ सफाई चाहिए।
respondents.quote_english: Change is needed here in Bihar. And a little cleanliness is needed.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Adult male, resident of Patna Sahib.

respondents.key_reason: There is a 'wave of change' due to unemployment, lack of facilities for the poor, severe traffic problems, and general suffering.
respondents.quote_original: बदलाव की लहर है। गरीब लोग के लिए कुछ ऐसा व्यवस्था ही नहीं होता है और कोई फैक्ट्री नहीं खुलती है कि उन लोगों को रोजगार दिया जाए। उन लोग बेरोजगार हैं यहां। ट्रैफिक की भी बहुत समस्या है।
respondents.quote_english: There is a wave of change. There are no arrangements for the poor, no factories are opened to provide them employment. People are unemployed here. Traffic is also a big problem.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Adult male, resident of Patna Sahib.

respondents.key_reason: Believes nothing will improve until the current government (Modi) is removed. Criticizes communal politics, severe traffic, lack of facilities, and discrimination in housing based on religion.
respondents.quote_original: सिर्फ एक ही लहर है देश बचाओ, देश बचाओ और मोदी हटाओ। तभी कुछ होगा नहीं तो ऐसे कुछ नहीं होगा। सिर्फ एक ही लहर अभी इलेक्शन में चल रहा है हिंदू और मुसलमान। इसके अलावा दूसरा कोई लहर नहीं है। ये नहीं होना चाहिए। ऐसा डेवलपमेंट अगर एक बाहर का आदमी यहां नौकरी करता है उसको रेंट के लिए घर चाहिए अगर वो मुसलमान है तो उसको रेंट नहीं मिलेगा।
respondents.quote_english: There is only one wave: save the country, save the country, and remove Modi. Only then will something happen, otherwise nothing will. Only one wave is currently running in the election: Hindu and Muslim. There is no other wave besides this. This should not happen. Such development that if an outsider comes here for a job and needs a house for rent, if he is a Muslim, he won't get rent.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Adult male, resident of Patna Sahib, likely Muslim.

respondents.key_reason: The current MP (Shatrughan Sinha) is doing his own work, but not addressing the daily struggles of the common people like fuel prices and job insecurity. No one listens to their concerns.
respondents.quote_original: शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा जी अपना तो काम वो कर रहे हैं लेकिन अब आम आदमी के लिए क्या कर रहे हैं वो हम लोगों को नहीं समझ में आ रहा है। हम लोग डेली मर्रा की जिंदगी में डेली आ रहे हैं जा रहे हैं डेली तेल लेना है डेली नौकरी पे जाना है तो कुछ हो रहा है नहीं तो फिर कोई सुनने वाला नहीं है।
respondents.quote_english: Shatrughan Sinha ji is doing his work, but what he is doing for the common man, we don't understand. We are living our daily lives, coming and going daily, needing to buy fuel daily, needing to go to work daily, but if something happens, there's no one to listen.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Adult male, resident of Patna Sahib.

respondents.key_reason: Expresses deep cynicism towards politicians, stating they are all talk and no action, especially regarding youth issues.
respondents.quote_original: ना ना बिल्कुल नहीं। वो तो बेकार बात है सर ये सब। यंगर कुछ सब हवा है और कुछ नहीं है।
respondents.quote_english: No, no, absolutely not. That's all useless talk, sir. Youth, everything is just talk, nothing else.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Adult male, likely young, resident of Patna Sahib.

respondents.key_reason: Supports Shatrughan Sinha as Bihar's pride and wants him to be MP again, regardless of party. However, strongly criticizes Nitish Kumar's government for turning Patna into a 'garbage dump' and 'Jahannum Raj' (hellish rule) with rampant crime, despite promises to make it Paris.
respondents.quote_original: शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा तो बिहार के प्राइड हैं, बिहार को नाज है उनके ऊपर और हम लोग चाहेंगे कि शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा यहां से फिर एक बार एमपी बनकर जाएं चाहे वो जिस पार्टी से टिकट लेके आए। लेकिन जहां तक पटना साहिब का बात है तो पटना साहिब जो यहां पटना को पेरिस बनाने का दावा करते थे नीतीश कुमार, पटना पूरे कूड़े कचड़े के ढेर पे है। दूसरी बात कि पटना ये 15 साल के लालू जी के सरकार को जंगल राज बोलकर आए थे सत्ता में, इन्होंने पटना साहिब को नीतीश सरकार ने जहन्नुम राज में बदल दिया है। पटना का कोई ऐसा चौराहा नहीं है जिस पर खून का दाग नहीं हो। अपराध पूरी तरह से यहां समानांतर अपराधियों की सरकार चल रही है।
respondents.quote_english: Shatrughan Sinha is the pride of Bihar, Bihar is proud of him, and we want Shatrughan Sinha to become an MP from here again, no matter which party he gets a ticket from. But as far as Patna Sahib is concerned, Nitish Kumar, who claimed to make Patna Paris, Patna is now on a pile of garbage. Secondly, Nitish Kumar came to power by calling Lalu ji's 15-year government 'Jungle Raj', but his government has turned Patna Sahib into 'Jahannum Raj' (hellish rule). There is no intersection in Patna without a bloodstain. Crime is completely rampant here, a parallel government of criminals is running.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Adult male, resident of Patna Sahib.

respondents.key_reason: Voters will prioritize a secular candidate, rejecting caste politics. Expresses strong concern over the high crime rate in Patna and the unresponsiveness of the police administration.
respondents.quote_original: इस बार के वोटरों का मिजाज ये रहेगा कि सेकुलर पार्टी से जो भी कैंडिडेट हो, चाहे वो शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा हो या अदरवाइज कोई भी पार्टी हो, लेकिन पटना का जो मेन मुद्दा रहेगा वो सेकुलर पार्टी को रहेगा। जात पात की राजनीति नहीं होगी। क्राइम तो अपने चरम पे है पटना शहर के अंदर। पुलिस प्रशासन किसी का भी सुनने को तैयार नहीं है।
respondents.quote_english: This time the voters' mood will be that whoever the candidate from a secular party is, whether it's Shatrughan Sinha or any other party, the main issue for Patna will be the secular party. There will be no caste politics. Crime is at its peak within Patna city. The police administration is not ready to listen to anyone.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Adult male, resident of Patna Sahib.

respondents.key_reason: Desires improvement in education and employment opportunities, and a general 'newness' or change in people's mindset. Acknowledges some problems have been addressed, but many persist.
respondents.quote_original: सर यही कहेंगे कि शिक्षा में बढ़ोतरी हो। लोगों को रोजगार मिले। कुछ नया तो होना चाहिए। लोगों की सोच में नया होना चाहिए।
respondents.quote_english: Sir, I would say that education should increase. People should get employment. Something new should happen. There should be newness in people's thinking.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Adult male, resident of Patna Sahib.

respondents.key_reason: Voters are leaning towards the Mahagathbandhan due to Patna's failure to achieve Smart City status, lack of cleanliness, and poor administrative arrangements.
respondents.quote_original: मिजाज तो उनके बने हुए हैं बिल्कुल महागठबंधन की जानिब उनकी झुकाव है। बुनियादी मसाइल जो हैं जो दर्जा मिलना चाहिए स्मार्ट सिटी का वो पटना को तो हक हासिल नहीं है कोई सफाई नहीं है बेहतर इंतजामात नहीं है।
respondents.quote_english: Their mood is absolutely set, they are leaning towards the Mahagathbandhan. The fundamental issues are that Patna has not received the status it deserves as a Smart City, there is no cleanliness, and no better arrangements.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Adult male, resident of Patna Sahib.

respondents.key_reason: Expresses deep cynicism, stating that politicians only work for themselves, not the public. Believes they are elected for 5 years to enrich themselves and bring poverty to the masses. Focuses on livelihood over elections.
respondents.quote_original: चुनाव से हमको क्या लेना देना है। हम तो रोजी रोटी से लेना देना रहता है कि चुनाव से क्या लेना देना है। नेता तो अपना काम करते हैं जनता का तो काम नहीं करते हैं। आपको बना दे रहे 5 साल के लिए आप सोच रहे हैं 5 साल के मैं बटोल लो। जनता को मार दो गरीबी ले आओ।
respondents.quote_english: What do we have to do with elections? We are concerned with livelihood, what do we have to do with elections? Leaders do their own work, not the public's. You make them for 5 years, and they think they'll collect for 5 years. Kill the public, bring poverty.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Adult male, resident of Patna Sahib.

respondents.key_reason: Basic amenities and development work in the area are still incomplete, with many shortcomings remaining.
respondents.quote_original: अभी पूरा तो नहीं हो पाया है लग रहा है। कुछ कमी है अभी।
respondents.quote_english: It seems it hasn't been fully completed yet. There are still some shortcomings.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Adult male, resident of Patna Sahib.

respondents.key_reason: Severe sanitation issues, especially during the rainy season, make it difficult to walk and question the city's status compared to a village. Wants leaders to personally experience the filth.
respondents.quote_original: हम ये बताना चाहेंगे कि बारिश के मौसम में इतनी गंदी हो जाती है कि हद से चलना भी मुश्किल हो जाता है। फिर शहर और देहात में क्या फर्क रहा। हम ये चाहना चाहते हैं कि यहां इतनी गटर, इतनी बारिश, नेता लोग आके इसमें घूमे तो उनको एहसास मालूम होगा कि ये शहर है कि ये देहात है।
respondents.quote_english: We want to say that during the rainy season, it gets so dirty that it becomes difficult to even walk. Then what's the difference between a city and a village? We want the leaders to come and walk in this much gutter and rain, then they will realize whether this is a city or a village.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Adult male, resident of Patna Sahib.

respondents.key_reason: Politicians make promises but fail to deliver. Highlights the difficulty in daily life, especially during rain, due to poor infrastructure and widespread garbage, affecting even religious activities like going for prayers.
respondents.quote_original: परेशानी यही है कि बारिश जब हो जाती है हम लोगों को चलना फिरना बहुत दिक्कत होती है नमाज पढ़ने के लिए जाने का वक्त होता है उस वक्त सोचना पड़ता है क्या करें। बहुत सारा मसाइल पैदा हो जाती है गंदगी रास्ते। सरकार लोगों ने तो वादा करके जाते हैं कि बहुत सारा चीज कर देंगे हल कर देंगे लेकिन कोई फायदा नहीं होता।
respondents.quote_english: The problem is that when it rains, it becomes very difficult for us to walk around, especially when it's time to go for prayers, we have to think what to do. Many problems arise, garbage on the roads. The government people make promises and leave, saying they will do many things, solve many problems, but it's of no use.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Adult male, resident of Patna Sahib, likely Muslim.

respondents.key_reason: Expresses lack of awareness or interest in political issues and elections.
respondents.quote_original: हम क्या बताएं हम कुछ पता नहीं है।
respondents.quote_english: What should I say, I don't know anything.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Adult female, resident of Patna Sahib.

respondents.key_reason: Wants leaders to address the poor infrastructure that causes significant difficulties during the rainy season, making it hard to walk and perform religious duties like offering prayers.
respondents.quote_original: मैं यही कहना चाहता हूं कि नेता लोगों को कुछ तो समझ में आना चाहिए कि बारिश होने की वजह से यहां कुछ करना चाहिए कि बारिश होने के बाद नमाज पढ़ने में हम लोग को दिक्कत होती है या कहीं रास्ता में चलने में फिरने में। पानी लगा रहता है।
respondents.quote_english: I just want to say that leaders should understand that due to rain, something should be done here because after rain, we face difficulty in offering prayers or walking on the roads. Water remains stagnant.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Adult male, resident of Patna Sahib, likely Muslim.

respondents.key_reason: The primary issue is widespread filth and lack of cleanliness throughout Patna. Believes that whoever focuses on cleaning the city will gain votes.
respondents.quote_original: गंदगी। यहां की मेन समस्या यही है। आप एक दो इलाके छोड़ दें तो पूरा पटना घूम जाइए गंदगी यहां बहुत ज्यादा है। उसको साफ सुथरा करना सबसे ज्यादा जरूरी है। और ये वोट का बहुत अच्छा मुद्दा है जो सफाई के तरफ ध्यान देगा उसको वोट परसेंटेज बढ़ेगा।
respondents.quote_english: Filth. That's the main problem here. If you leave out one or two areas, the whole of Patna is very dirty. Cleaning it up is the most important thing. And this is a very good election issue; whoever pays attention to cleanliness will see their vote percentage increase.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Adult male, resident of Patna Sahib.

respondents.key_reason: Roads in the area are not properly maintained; even newly constructed ones are broken and neglected.
respondents.quote_original: परेशानी यही है सर कि रोड रोड जो है ये सब पूरा सही तरह से दुरुस्त नहीं है जो बना हुआ भी है तो पूरा फिर गड़बड़ा गया है टूट टूट गया है तो उसको फिर दोबारा दिखा नहीं जा रहा है।
respondents.quote_english: The problem is, sir, that the roads are not properly maintained. Even the ones that were built are now completely messed up, broken, so they are not being looked at again.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Adult male, likely young, resident of Patna Sahib.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures the public sentiment in Patna Sahib Lok Sabha constituency, revealing widespread dissatisfaction with the lack of development, poor infrastructure (especially roads, drainage, and cleanliness), and rampant crime. Many voters express cynicism towards politicians who make unfulfilled promises and are perceived as out of touch. While some voters lean towards the Mahagathbandhan and others express personal loyalty to Shatrughan Sinha regardless of party, a significant number remain undecided or critical of all parties, demanding fundamental change and better governance.

metadata.title: Patna Sahib में लोगों ने खोला मन का हाल, सरकार के खिलाफ जनता का रोष, देखें पूरा माहौल | Patna City
metadata.constituency_audit_reason: Video explicitly focuses on 'Patna Sahib' and general Bihar elections, not the Bankipur Assembly Constituency bypoll.

analysis.video_title: Patna Sahib में लोगों ने खोला मन का हाल, सरकार के खिलाफ जनता का रोष, देखें पूरा माहौल | Patna City

respondents.key_reason: Believes the current government (Nitish Kumar/Modi) has created a 'jungle raj' (lawlessness), corruption, unemployment, and failed to deliver on promises like factories and proper land surveys. He criticizes the government for making people 'chor' (thieves) and 'koḍi' (beggars/dependent) by not providing jobs and for the widespread corruption in administration. He also criticizes the Ayushman Bharat scheme's implementation, the distribution of ration, and giving freebies instead of real employment. He specifically calls Nitish Kumar a 'maha ghatiya aadmi' and his rule 'maha jungle raj', claiming development in Nalanda is due to favoritism. He supports Tejashwi Yadav for change.
respondents.quote_original: सबको चोर बना देगा मोदी जी और नीतीश कुमार दोनों रहेगा जब तक चोर बनेगा। अब चोर की संख्या ज्यादा हो गया है। मारकाट छीनछार के संख्या ज्यादा हो गया है। नीतीश जी महा घटिया आदमी है। महा जंगल राज इस बार का। खाली वो नालंदा विकास हुआ। नालंदा में। उज्ज्वला योजना जो दे रहे हैं तो 2 करोड़ दे रहे हैं। 140 करोड़ है। सब को मिल गया। सब को चोर बना देगा कोड़ी बना देगा। जो पैसा जो मिल रहा है मतलब वो आदमी को कोड़ी बना रहा है।
respondents.quote_english: Everyone will be made a thief as long as Modi ji and Nitish Kumar are there. The number of thieves has increased. The number of snatchings and fights has increased. Nitish ji is a very bad person. This time it's a great jungle raj. Only Nalanda developed. In Nalanda. The Ujjwala scheme they are giving, they are giving to 2 crore. And there are 140 crore. Everyone got it. It will make everyone a thief, a beggar. The money being received means it's making people beggars.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Ravindra Kumar Mehta, male, likely middle-aged/elderly, speaking in Patna Sahib constituency.

respondents.key_reason: Agrees with the previous speaker that the current government (NDA/Nitish Kumar) has 'barbad' (ruined) everything. He highlights the widespread sale of alcohol, smack, and ganja despite prohibition, indicating administrative failure and corruption. He believes the government is making people 'koḍi' (beggars/dependent) by giving freebies instead of jobs. He also uses the 'jungle raj' phrase.
respondents.quote_original: पूरा बर्बाद कर रहा है। पूरा बर्बाद कर रहा है। पूरा परिवार सूखा ना से इतना ना ज्यादा हो रहा है कि अब 100 में से 10 लड़का को देखिएगा तो दिन भर गांजा पीकर के स्मैक पीकर के पागल हो जाता है। जंगल जंगल जंगल राज कहते थे लालू बाबू को। वो तो महा जंगल है नीतीश जी का। बहुत महा जंगल है।
respondents.quote_english: It's completely ruining everything. The whole family is suffering so much from addiction that out of 100, you'll see 10 boys drinking ganja and smack all day and going crazy. They used to call Lalu Babu 'jungle raj'. But Nitish ji's is a great jungle raj. A very great jungle raj.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Anil Kumar, male, likely middle-aged, speaking in Patna Sahib constituency.

respondents.key_reason: Praises the current government for improving infrastructure (roads connecting villages to cities) and healthcare access, stating that people no longer need to be carried on cots for medical treatment. He believes the government is working well, but differentiates between the government's policy-making and the administration's implementation, suggesting the administration is at fault for issues like illegal activities and corruption, not the government itself.
respondents.quote_original: मेरे सरकार में है जो कि गांव से लेकर शहर तक जोड़ दिया। गांव से लेकर शहर तक आने जाने का सुविधा हुआ। जो कि पहले देहात से आदमी बीमार पड़ता था तो खटिया पर लाया जाता था। आज वो गाड़ी से आ रहा है और तुरंत तत्काल दिखा रहा है, इलाज कर रहा है। ये मामले में हमको सरकार अच्छा बुझा रहा है। प्रशासन का गलती ना है। सरकार की गलती तो नहीं है। सरकार तो अपना ड्यूटी दिया है। सरकार अलग है। सरकार एक ड्यूटी विभाग देता है। और विभाग को काम है वो काम करना है। अगर वो चोरी कर रहा है तो उसको कंप्लेन अपना जिसको तकलीफ है वो लिख के दे।
respondents.quote_english: In my government, villages have been connected to cities. It has become convenient to travel from villages to cities. Earlier, if someone fell ill in the village, they were brought on a cot. Today, they come by vehicle and get immediate treatment. In this regard, I find the government good. It's the administration's fault, not the government's. The government has given its duty. The government is separate. The government gives a duty to a department. And the department's job is to do that work. If it's stealing, then whoever is troubled should complain in writing.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, likely middle-aged/elderly, speaking in Patna Sahib constituency.

respondents.key_reason: Praises the government for providing benefits like increased financial aid (from 400 to 1100) and free electricity.
respondents.quote_original: हमारा सरकार तो बढ़िया है। देखिए कि सब कोई 1100 मिल रहा है। 100% पक्का है। अच्छा है।
respondents.quote_english: Our government is good. Everyone is getting 1100. 100% sure. It's good.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, likely middle-aged/elderly, speaking in Patna Sahib constituency.

respondents.key_reason: Praises Nitish Kumar's government for good work in road construction, electricity, and providing employment. He claims to have personally benefited from employment schemes despite coming from a village and believes government schemes are reaching people and are effective.
respondents.quote_original: नीतीश कुमार के सरकार में जो जितने साल रहे बिल्कुल काम अच्छा तरह से हुआ। सड़क सबसे अच्छा हुआ। पूरे बिहार भर में सड़क मतलब कि ऐसे ये टॉप किए हैं। बिजली हुआ। बच्चे लोग को रोजगार देना जो कि ऐसे हमारे अभी युवा हैं। आप तक रोजगार पहुंचा है। हां रोजगार मेरे तक पहुंचा है। रोजगार का लाभ हम उठाए हैं। हां पहुंच रहा है। लोगों तक लोगों तक पहुंचने का बिल्कुल काम है और उसको सब सभी लोग तक पहुंच रहे हैं।
respondents.quote_english: In Nitish Kumar's government, for all the years he has been in power, work has been done very well. Roads are the best. Across Bihar, roads have topped. Electricity has improved. Providing employment to youth, I am a youth myself. Has employment reached you? Yes, employment has reached me. I have benefited from employment. Yes, it is reaching. It is definitely reaching the people, and it is reaching everyone.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, young/middle-aged, identifies as a youth from a village, speaking in Patna Sahib constituency.

respondents.key_reason: Did not hear the previous discussion.
respondents.quote_original: हम तो कुछ सुनवे नहीं किए हैं।
respondents.quote_english: I haven't heard anything.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Banti Kumar, male, speaking in Patna Sahib constituency.

respondents.key_reason: Believes Nitish Kumar's government has done well in development and construction, but criticizes the administration for allowing widespread sale of alcohol, smack, and ganja.
respondents.quote_original: कुछ बात से एग्री है। सभी बात से उनके एग्री नहीं है। नीतीश कुमार का सभी चीज ठीक है। एक दो चीज खराब है। जैसे गली-गली में जो है तो दो-दो बास पर दारू बिकना, स्मैक बिकना, गांजा बिकना। ये सब उनके निर्माण के मामला में जितना विकास जो है नीतीश सरकार में हुआ है किसी सरकार में नहीं हुआ है।
respondents.quote_english: I agree with some points. I don't agree with all his points. Everything about Nitish Kumar is fine. One or two things are bad. Like alcohol, smack, ganja being sold at every two poles in every street. In terms of development, the amount of development that has happened in Nitish's government has not happened in any other government.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, speaking in Patna Sahib constituency.

respondents.key_reason: Criticizes Nitish Kumar's prohibition policy, stating that it has led to children selling alcohol and ruining their future. He believes that if alcohol were openly sold, the government would get revenue, and children wouldn't be involved in illegal activities or crime.
respondents.quote_original: आज दारू बेचे से देखिए तनी तनी को बच्चा लोग दारू बेच रहा है। नितेश बाबू दारू बंद नहीं किए हैं। ये बच्चा सब के भविष्य बंद कर दिए हैं। आज छोटा-छोटा बच्चा लोग दारू बेच रहा है। अगर बिहार में दारू चालू हो जाएगा तो पैसा कहां से लाएगा। कल हो के चोरी चमारी करेगा ना तो लूटमार करेगा।
respondents.quote_english: Today, because of alcohol sales, you see small children selling alcohol. Nitish Babu has not stopped alcohol; he has stopped the future of these children. Today, small children are selling alcohol. If alcohol were allowed in Bihar, where would the money come from? Tomorrow they will steal or loot.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, likely middle-aged/elderly, speaking in Patna Sahib constituency.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures diverse opinions in Patna Sahib regarding the Bihar elections. A significant portion of interviewees express strong dissatisfaction with the current Nitish Kumar government, citing issues like unemployment, corruption, lawlessness (especially drug and alcohol sales despite prohibition), and administrative failures, with some advocating for a change to Mahagathbandhan. Conversely, other respondents praise the government for infrastructure development, improved healthcare access, and successful implementation of welfare schemes, while some differentiate between government policy and administrative execution.

metadata.title: Patna Sahib Vidhan Sabha Public Opinion : अचानक से बदला IIT-IIM वाले को जिताएंगे, ऐलान हुआ |
metadata.constituency_audit_reason: Video explicitly focuses on 'Patna Sahib Vidhan Sabha', which is a different assembly constituency than Bankipur.

analysis.video_title: Patna Sahib Vidhan Sabha Public Opinion : अचानक से बदला IIT-IIM वाले को जिताएंगे, ऐलान हुआ |

respondents.key_reason: Strong anti-BJP sentiment and a perceived wave of change in Patna Sahib. The Nishad/Mallah community has united with Mahagathbandhan after Mukesh Sahani was declared Deputy CM candidate.
respondents.quote_original: भाजपा के हम ही लोग भी वोट देते थे पहले लेकिन इस बार नहीं देंगे। अब तो और महागठबंधन मजबूत हो गया कल जो मुकेश साहनी जी को डिप्टी सीएम घोषित कर दिया तो पूरा निषाद समाज एक हो गया है।
respondents.quote_english: We ourselves used to vote for BJP before, but not this time. Now the Mahagathbandhan has become even stronger; yesterday Mukesh Sahani ji was declared Deputy CM, so the entire Nishad community has united.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, local resident of Patna Sahib, likely from or representing the Nishad/Mallah community.

respondents.key_reason: Pride in the Mahagathbandhan's candidate, Shashank Shekhar, who is highly educated and comes from a political family with a history of public service.
respondents.quote_original: महागठबंधन के लिए भी गर्व की बात है कि एक पढ़ा-लिखा नौजवान हमारा प्रत्याशी हुआ है पटना साहिब का।
respondents.quote_english: It is a matter of pride for the Mahagathbandhan that an educated young man has become our candidate from Patna Sahib.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, local resident of Patna Sahib.

respondents.key_reason: The Mallah community has joined the Mahagathbandhan, ensuring the alliance's victory. Mentions specific alliance partners like RJD, Male, and CPI-ML.
respondents.quote_original: मल्लाह तो आ गया है अब महागठबंधन में। तो कांग्रेस का नैया पार करबे करेंगे राजद के, माले के, सीपीआईएमएल के।
respondents.quote_english: The Mallah community has now joined the Mahagathbandhan. So, Congress's boat will definitely cross with RJD, Male, CPI-ML.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, likely from the Mallah community or aware of their political leanings.

respondents.key_reason: Criticism of the BJP's (Nand Kishore Yadav's) 30-year tenure, which allegedly led to the destruction of education and development. Also mentions alleged corruption by the central government.
respondents.quote_original: हमारे पटना साहिब में जिस तरह से शिक्षा और विकास का विनाश हुआ है... हर हाल में इसको बचा के वापस लाना है और महागठबंधन को भी जय बनाना है।
respondents.quote_english: In our Patna Sahib, the way education and development have been destroyed... in any case, we have to save this and bring it back and make Mahagathbandhan victorious.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, local resident of Patna Sahib.

respondents.key_reason: Praises the past development work by Congress leader Sharad Jain (e.g., Mangal Talab, Patna City development) and contrasts it with the alleged lack of development during Nand Kishore Yadav's 30-year tenure.
respondents.quote_original: शरद जैन का कार्यकाल में जो मंगल तालाब का विकास हुआ। जो पटना सिटी का विकास हुआ। उस कार्यकाल से आप 30 साल के नंदू जी के कार्यकाल को पैमाना नाप लीजिए।
respondents.quote_english: The development of Mangal Talab and Patna City that happened during Sharad Jain's tenure. Compare that tenure with Nanduji's 30-year tenure.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, older resident, implying he has witnessed both tenures.

respondents.key_reason: Believes that Rahul Gandhi attracts the public, youth, and educated people, indicating support for the alliance.
respondents.quote_original: अवाम, जनता और नौजवान और पढ़े-लिखे लोग का अट्रैक्शन राहुल गांधी की तरफ है।
respondents.quote_english: The attraction of the public, youth, and educated people is towards Rahul Gandhi.

respondents.key_reason: There is a strong wave of change across Bihar, and the Mahagathbandhan's candidate is highly qualified and comes from a family with socialist and egalitarian ideologies.
respondents.quote_original: निश्चित रूप से पटना साहिब ही नहीं पूरे बिहार में एक बदलाव की लहर है... निश्चित रूप से महागठबंधन का वे प्रत्याशी जो एक हाइली क्वालिफाइड है... एक ऐसे परिवार से संबंध रखता जिसका समाजवाद से, साम्यवाद से और एक इक्वालिटी, बराबरी जैसे समाज के विचारधारा को यकीन रखता है।
respondents.quote_english: Certainly, not just Patna Sahib but the entire Bihar has a wave of change... Definitely, the Mahagathbandhan's candidate is highly qualified... and belongs to a family that believes in the ideology of socialism, communism, and equality.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, identifies as a party-affiliated person (likely Mahagathbandhan supporter).

respondents.key_reason: Strongly criticizes the current MLA (Nand Kishore Yadav) and the NDA government for 30 years of no development, especially in education and infrastructure. Accuses them of intentionally hindering progress and highlights the poor state of schools.
respondents.quote_original: 30 साल में जो नंदू जी 1995 में जब चुनाव लड़े उस समय वो बच्चा पैदा नहीं हुआ होगा, वो बच्चा आज मतदाता है। इतने बड़े टेन्योर में कार्यकाल में पटना सिटी का शिक्षा संस्थान... वहां मैथ का टीचर एक है।
respondents.quote_english: The child who wasn't born when Nanduji fought elections in 1995, that child is a voter today. In such a long tenure, the educational institutions of Patna City... there is only one math teacher there.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, local resident of Patna City, critical of the long-standing MLA.

respondents.key_reason: Compares the development record of Congress MLA Sharad Jain favorably against the current MLA, stating there are no significant infrastructure achievements by the latter. Expresses confidence in Mahagathbandhan candidate Shashank Shekhar's victory.
respondents.quote_original: इस मापदंड पर शरद जैन कांग्रेस का विधायक ऊपर होता है... कोई इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर ऐसा काम नहीं है जो उनको उपलब्धि में गिना जा सकता है। निश्चित रूप से महागठबंधन का प्रत्याशी शशांक शेखर चुनाव जीतेगा।
respondents.quote_english: By this standard, Congress MLA Sharad Jain is superior... there is no such infrastructure work that can be counted as his achievement. Certainly, Mahagathbandhan's candidate Shashank Shekhar will win the election.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, local resident with historical knowledge of the area's politics.

respondents.key_reason: A new, strong candidate (Shashank Shekhar) has emerged after a long time, giving people a voice and hope for victory. Expresses a feeling of pride and confidence in the party's success.
respondents.quote_original: शरद कुमार जैन के बाद यह पहला हम लोगों को कोई कैंडिडेट मिला है कि कुछ हंसने और बोलने का मौका दिया है। नहीं तो हर बार यही लगता था कि सीधे भैया वोट दो और घर जाकर आराम करो। अब है कि रोड पर निकलेंगे, शान से निकलेंगे, हमारी पार्टी की जीत है।
respondents.quote_english: After Sharad Kumar Jain, this is the first candidate we have got who has given us a chance to laugh and speak. Otherwise, every time it felt like just vote and go home and rest. Now we will come out on the road with pride, our party will win.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, local resident, feels empowered by the new candidate.

respondents.key_reason: Attraction towards Rahul Gandhi and the alliance due to their focus on progress, truth, and unity, moving away from divisive politics and empty promises. Believes unity is essential for development.
respondents.quote_original: अवाम, जनता और नौजवान और पढ़े-लिखे लोग का अट्रैक्शन राहुल गांधी की तरफ है। गठबंधन की तरफ है... जुमलेबाजी से हमें पीछे हटना है। जो सच्चाई है, जो मोहब्बत की बात है... मोहब्बत की तरफ आओ, देश आगे बढ़ेगा।
respondents.quote_english: The attraction of the public, youth, and educated people is towards Rahul Gandhi. It is towards the alliance... We have to move away from empty promises. What is truth, what is love... Come towards love, the country will progress.

respondents.key_reason: Supports the young candidate Shashank Shekhar, who represents the voice of youth. Criticizes 30 years of no development (lack of colleges, parks, and poor drainage) under Nand Kishore Yadav. Confident of Mahagathbandhan's victory.
respondents.quote_original: 30 वर्ष से विधायक पटना साहिब में हमारे चाचा नंद किशोर यादव रहे हैं। ना एक कॉलेज दिए बढ़िया, ना एक वैसा कोई कोई गार्डन दिए बैठने उठने के लिए... बदलाव होने वाला है। सुशांत भैया युवा के आवाज बन के आए हैं और महागठबंधन इस बार अच्छे सीट से जीतने जा रहा है।
respondents.quote_english: For 30 years, our uncle Nand Kishore Yadav has been the MLA in Patna Sahib. He didn't give a good college, nor any garden for sitting... Change is going to happen. Sushant Bhaiya has come as the voice of the youth and Mahagathbandhan is going to win with a good margin this time.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Young male, local resident, refers to Nand Kishore Yadav as 'chacha' (uncle).

respondents.key_reason: No development or change in Patna City for 30 years under Nand Kishore Yadav (BJP). Sees the new, young, IITian candidate (Shashank Shekhar) from Congress/Mahagathbandhan as a symbol of new hope and inevitable change and development.
respondents.quote_original: आज हमारी उम्र 35 वर्ष हो गई है। माननीय विधायक 30 साल से विधायक है। यानी जब से मैंने होश संभाला तब से पटना सिटी को मैं वैसे ही हालत में देख रहा हूं... अब नया सवेरा आने वाला है, नया युवा आने वाला है और वो सुशांत के रूप में हम लोग को महागठबंधन के उम्मीदवार के रूप में कांग्रेस पार्टी ने देने का काम किया है... परिवर्तन निश्चित है।
respondents.quote_english: Today I am 35 years old. The honorable MLA has been an MLA for 30 years. Meaning, since I gained consciousness, I have seen Patna City in the same condition... Now a new dawn is coming, a new youth is coming, and Congress party has given us that in the form of Sushant, the Mahagathbandhan candidate... Change is certain.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, 35 years old, local resident of Patna City.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures a strong sentiment for change in the Patna Sahib constituency, with multiple respondents expressing dissatisfaction with the incumbent BJP MLA's 30-year tenure, citing a lack of development in education and infrastructure. There is widespread support for the Mahagathbandhan's young, educated candidate, Shashank Shekhar, who is seen as a symbol of new hope and progress, with many believing a 'wave' of change is imminent.

respondents.key_reason: The public will accept whoever BJP gives an opportunity to.
respondents.quote_original: भाजपा किसी को भी मौका देगा तो जनता उसको स्वीकार करेगी।
respondents.quote_english: BJP will give opportunity to anyone, the public will accept them.

respondents.key_reason: Vote will go to BJP regardless of the candidate.
respondents.quote_original: कोई भी खड़ा हो उससे मतलब नहीं वोट बीजेपी को ही जाएगा।
respondents.quote_english: Doesn't matter who stands, the vote will go to BJP.

respondents.key_reason: Shatrughan Sinha will not win if he contests.
respondents.quote_original: इस बार उम्मीद तो नहीं है सर अगर शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा आते हैं तो नहीं जीतेंगे 100%।
respondents.quote_english: This time there is no hope, sir, if Shatrughan Sinha comes, he will not win 100%.

respondents.key_reason: Prefers Ram Kripal or a new candidate who thinks for the youth.
respondents.quote_original: यहां से राम कृपाल को दे सकती है या कोई नया उम्मीदवार लेकर आइए जो युवाओं के लिए सोचे।
respondents.quote_english: From here, they can give it to Ram Kripal or bring a new candidate who thinks for the youth.

respondents.key_reason: RJD has great hope this time.
respondents.quote_original: इस बार आरजेडी को बहुत बड़ी उम्मीद है।
respondents.quote_english: This time RJD has great hope.

respondents.key_reason: Supports BJP.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी
respondents.quote_english: BJP

respondents.key_reason: Supports Narendra Modi.
respondents.quote_original: हां नरेंद्र मोदी हां।
respondents.quote_english: Yes, Narendra Modi, yes.

respondents.key_reason: Ram Kripal has society's support, majority, ideology, and proper manner.
respondents.quote_original: सोसाइटी है, बहुमत है, विचार है, ढंग है।
respondents.quote_english: There is society, majority, ideology, manner.

respondents.key_reason: Wants Modi government to come from Patna.
respondents.quote_original: पटना से मोदी सरकार आना चाहिए।
respondents.quote_english: Modi government should come from Patna.

respondents.key_reason: Public sentiment is currently leaning towards Modi.
respondents.quote_original: अभी तो जो जनता तो आधा मतलब कि अभी मोदी को खड़ा कर रहा है।
respondents.quote_english: Right now, the public is half-heartedly putting Modi forward.

respondents.key_reason: Ram Kripal will bring development.
respondents.quote_original: हां अगर उनको मिल जाए तो और अच्छा बात है। विकास करेंगे।
respondents.quote_english: Yes, if he gets it, it's even better. He will develop.

respondents.key_reason: Rajnath Singh can do good for the country, and BJP government is better.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी का सरकार रहेगा तो और अच्छा रहेगा।
respondents.quote_english: If BJP's government is there, it will be even better.

respondents.key_reason: Ram Kripal is 'ours' (familiar/local candidate).
respondents.quote_original: राम कृपाल जी तो वही हैं हम लोग का।
respondents.quote_english: Ram Kripal ji is ours.

respondents.key_reason: Believes Ram Kripal will be the candidate.
respondents.quote_original: राम कृपाल जी आएंगे।
respondents.quote_english: Ram Kripal ji will come.

respondents.key_reason: Believes Ram Kripal will win.
respondents.quote_original: राम कृपाल जी जीतेंगे।
respondents.quote_english: Ram Kripal ji will win.

respondents.key_reason: Ram Kripal does good work in the locality.
respondents.quote_original: हम लोग अच्छा मोहल्ला में काम करते हैं।
respondents.quote_english: We work well in the locality.

respondents.key_reason: Ram Kripal should definitely be given a chance.
respondents.quote_original: एकदम श्योर देना चाहिए राम कृपाल जी को।
respondents.quote_english: Definitely should give to Ram Kripal ji.

respondents.key_reason: BJP's government will come again in 2019.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी का सरकार एक बार और आएगा 2019 में।
respondents.quote_english: BJP's government will come one more time in 2019.

respondents.key_reason: Ram Kripal should definitely be given a chance.
respondents.quote_original: एकदम मौका देना चाहिए।
respondents.quote_english: Definitely should give a chance.

respondents.key_reason: Ram Kripal does very good work and is accessible in every locality.
respondents.quote_original: बहुत अच्छा काम करते हैं हर मोहल्ले में हर वार्ड में जाते हैं। अच्छा काम करते हैं।
respondents.quote_english: He does very good work, goes to every locality, every ward. He does good work.

respondents.key_reason: Ram Kripal is a very good candidate.
respondents.quote_original: कैंडिडेट बहुत अच्छा है राम कृपाल जी।
respondents.quote_english: Ram Kripal ji is a very good candidate.

respondents.key_reason: Ram Kripal is the leader of the masses.
respondents.quote_original: राम कृपाल जन-जन के नेता हैं तो और किसको रहेगा।
respondents.quote_english: Ram Kripal is the leader of the masses, so who else will it be?

respondents.key_reason: Shatrughan Sinha was rejected by the public.
respondents.quote_original: शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा नकार दिया जनता की।
respondents.quote_english: Shatrughan Sinha was rejected by the public.

respondents.key_reason: The public will accept whoever BJP gives an opportunity to.
respondents.quote_original: भाजपा किसी को भी मौका देगा तो जनता उसको स्वीकार करेगी।
respondents.quote_english: BJP will give opportunity to anyone, the public will accept them.

respondents.key_reason: Candidate doesn't matter, party choice is supreme.
respondents.quote_original: चाहे राम कृपाल यादव हो या कोई भी कैंडिडेट हो वो कोई इशू नहीं है।
respondents.quote_english: Whether it's Ram Kripal Yadav or any other candidate, that's not an issue.

respondents.key_reason: Shatrughan Sinha should be removed as soon as possible.
respondents.quote_original: और शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा को बाहर का रास्ता दिखाना बहुत जल्द से जल्द चाहिए।
respondents.quote_english: And Shatrughan Sinha should be shown the way out as soon as possible.

respondents.key_reason: Wants accountability from politicians who should care for the public after winning.
respondents.quote_original: अब हम लोग अभी जीता दें और बाद में हम लोग को ठेंगा धरा दे ऐसा थोड़ी है सब कोई को मतलब कि ना देख देखभाल करना चाहिए पूरा गांव भरा है।
respondents.quote_english: Now we make them win and later they show us a thumb, that's not how it is. Everyone should be looked after, the whole village is full.

respondents.key_reason: Wants BJP government, candidate is secondary.
respondents.quote_original: यहां से कोई भी खड़ा हो जाए ठीक है कोई मतलब नहीं है क्योंकि बीजेपी का ही सरकार आना चाहिए उससे मतलब नहीं है पर बीजेपी का सरकार होना चाहिए।
respondents.quote_english: Anyone can stand from here, it's fine, it doesn't matter because BJP's government should come, it doesn't matter who, but BJP's government should be there.

respondents.key_reason: Vote will go to BJP regardless of the candidate.
respondents.quote_original: कोई भी खड़ा हो उससे मतलब नहीं वोट बीजेपी को ही जाएगा।
respondents.quote_english: Doesn't matter who stands, the vote will go to BJP.

respondents.key_reason: Should give vote to BJP.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी को ही देना चाहिए।
respondents.quote_english: Should give to BJP.

respondents.key_reason: Wants BJP government, so any BJP candidate should be voted for.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी में जो आ गया जो कैंडिडेट बीजेपी में लड़ रहा है उसको वोट देना चाहिए क्योंकि बीजेपी का ही सरकार लाना है।
respondents.quote_english: Whoever comes into BJP, whichever candidate is fighting for BJP, should be voted for because we have to bring BJP's government.

respondents.key_reason: Supports BJP government.
respondents.quote_original: हां बीजेपी का सरकार।
respondents.quote_english: Yes, BJP's government.

respondents.key_reason: Candidate doesn't matter, party (NDA) is important.
respondents.quote_original: हां यहां से कोई भी खड़ा हो जाए। कोई भी।
respondents.quote_english: Yes, anyone can stand from here. Anyone.

respondents.key_reason: Government schemes (Jan Dhan, Atal Pension, Ujjwala, crop insurance) are benefiting the poor, bringing peace and economic well-being.
respondents.quote_original: जितना भी तरह को योजनाएं हैं जो गरीब किसान फसल बीमा योजना जो हाल में सारा लोग गरीब को लाभान्वित हो रहा है। इसलिए तय आपने एनडीए को ही किया है। हां तय है। अमन है, चैन है, सब चीज है, लोग कमा खा रहा है, खुशी चैन से तो एनडीए को वोट देंगे।
respondents.quote_english: All kinds of schemes, like the poor farmer crop insurance scheme, all the poor people are benefiting. That's why you have decided on NDA. Yes, it's decided. There is peace, tranquility, everything is there, people are earning and eating, happily and peacefully, so we will vote for NDA.

respondents.key_reason: Any candidate from NDA will get a chance.
respondents.quote_original: एनडीए के कोई भी उम्मीदवार हों उनको मौका मिलेगा।
respondents.quote_english: Any candidate of NDA will get a chance.

respondents.key_reason: BJP's government is certain to be formed.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी का सरकार बनेगा। तय है।
respondents.quote_english: BJP's government will be formed. It's certain.

respondents.key_reason: Mahagathbandhan's preparations will not make a difference.
respondents.quote_original: महागठबंधन से तैयार हो रहा है तो उससे कोई फर्क नहीं। उससे कोई फर्क नहीं।
respondents.quote_english: If Mahagathbandhan is preparing, it makes no difference. It makes no difference.

respondents.key_reason: BJP's government is bound to be formed.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी का सरकार बनना ही है।
respondents.quote_english: BJP's government is bound to be formed.

respondents.key_reason: Believes BJP will emerge victorious from everywhere.
respondents.quote_original: हां हर जगह से बीजेपी निकलेगा।
respondents.quote_english: Yes, BJP will emerge from everywhere.

respondents.key_reason: Cannot predict the outcome yet.
respondents.quote_original: अभी हम लोग कैसे कह सकते हैं।
respondents.quote_english: How can we say now?

respondents.key_reason: Supports Mahagathbandhan.
respondents.quote_original: महागठबंधन।
respondents.quote_english: Mahagathbandhan.

respondents.key_reason: Lalu Prasad Yadav is the leader of the poor and thinks about them.
respondents.quote_original: गरीबों के बारे में सोचा जा रहा है। गरीब का नेता है। लालू प्रसाद यादव।
respondents.quote_english: The poor are being thought about. He is the leader of the poor. Lalu Prasad Yadav.

respondents.key_reason: RJD has great hope this time and is confident of victory.
respondents.quote_original: मौका तो आरजेडी का समर्थन जो भी हो उसी को। हां एकदम पक्का। लेकिन इस बार आरजेडी को बहुत बड़ी उम्मीद है।
respondents.quote_english: The opportunity should be given to whoever RJD supports. Yes, absolutely sure. But this time RJD has great hope.

respondents.key_reason: Agrees with RJD's stance, believes they can resolve current political complications and bring good for Bihar.
respondents.quote_original: बस समर्थन तो मेरा इन्हीं के साथ है जो उन्होंने बोला है बात सही बोली है और मैं भी चाहता हूं कि वह आए क्योंकि अभी बहुत उलझने चल रही हैं। माशा अल्लाह आने वाला टाइम अच्छा हो बिहार के लिए मैं तो यही चाहता हूं।
respondents.quote_english: My support is with them, what they said is true, and I also want them to come because there are many complications right now. God willing, the coming time should be good for Bihar, that's what I want.

respondents.key_reason: Shatrughan Sinha will not win if he contests.
respondents.quote_original: इस बार उम्मीद तो नहीं है सर अगर शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा आते हैं तो नहीं जीतेंगे 100%।
respondents.quote_english: This time there is no hope, sir, if Shatrughan Sinha comes, he will not win 100%.

respondents.key_reason: Dissatisfied with Shatrughan Sinha's performance; wants a candidate with good ideas, dignity, and who works for the country and constituency.
respondents.quote_original: अच्छा सांसद मिला नहीं है क्योंकि 10 वर्षों से भर रहे हैं शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा जी लेकिन कुछ कर नहीं रहे हैं। जनता को सबसे पहले तो उनके विचारों को उनके जो मर्यादा है उनका जो मतलब कि जो देश के लिए और अपने सांसद के लिए एक जो विचार होना चाहिए और उस क्षेत्र में एक अच्छा काम होना चाहिए और उसके अनुसार उनको वोट देना चाहिए।
respondents.quote_english: Haven't got a good MP because Shatrughan Sinha ji has been filling it for 10 years but isn't doing anything. First of all, the public should consider their ideas, their dignity, what they mean for the country and for their MP, there should be an idea, and there should be good work in that area, and they should vote accordingly.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, young adult, from Sampchak block

respondents.key_reason: Shatrughan Sinha has done nothing; wants a new candidate or Ram Kripal who thinks for youth and students.
respondents.quote_original: बस कोई नया उम्मीदवार आए शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा तो बिहारी बाबू के नाम पे एकदम क्या बोल सकते हो उसको जो भी सब कम है। यहां से राम कृपाल को दे सकती है या कोई नया उम्मीदवार लेकर आइए जो युवाओं के लिए सोचे। स्टूडेंट के लिए।
respondents.quote_english: Just a new candidate should come, Shatrughan Sinha, in the name of Bihari Babu, what can you say, everything is less. From here they can give it to Ram Kripal or bring a new candidate who thinks for the youth. For students.

analysis.overall_video_summary: This video captures public sentiment in Patna Sahib for the 2019 Lok Sabha elections. A significant majority of interviewees express strong support for the BJP and its candidates, particularly Ram Kripal Yadav, citing reasons like development, good governance, and unwavering party loyalty. There is also a strong sentiment against the incumbent Shatrughan Sinha, with many believing he has not performed well. A smaller segment of the public expresses support for the RJD/Mahagathbandhan, primarily emphasizing concerns for the poor and social justice.

respondents.key_reason: Exercising her democratic right to vote.
respondents.quote_original: क्योंकि ये मेरा अधिकार है इसलिए मैं यहां आई हूं वहां से इलेक्शन के लिए।
respondents.quote_english: Because this is my right, that's why I have come here for the election.

respondents.key_reason: Prioritizing voting over household chores.
respondents.quote_original: वोट पहले दे देंगे तब घर के काम करेंगे।
respondents.quote_english: We will cast our vote first, then do household chores.

respondents.key_reason: Voting is essential and takes precedence over other tasks.
respondents.quote_original: जी हां, हम लोग तो अपना काम करके बाद में कर लेंगे लेकिन वोट देना जरूरी ना है।
respondents.quote_english: Yes, we will do our work later, but voting is necessary, isn't it?

respondents.key_reason: Believes in supporting the poor.
respondents.quote_original: गरीब आदमी को सहायता होना चाहिए।
respondents.quote_english: Poor people should receive help.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video highlights the significant participation of women voters in Patna Sahib, Bihar, who are prioritizing casting their votes over their daily household chores. Interviewees emphasize that voting is their right and a necessary civic duty, with one respondent specifically mentioning the need for assistance for the poor. The general sentiment is that women are actively engaging in the electoral process, similar to men.

respondents.key_reason: Strong support for Tejaswi Yadav due to perceived job creation and a belief in his leadership. Expresses severe criticism of Nitish Kumar's governance, accusing him of being drunk and making unrealistic claims, and general anti-incumbency against the current state government. Also critical of Modi's unfulfilled promises (15 lakh, gas). Emphasizes caste/community identity (Yadav) and the RJD symbol (lantern).
respondents.quote_original: एकतरफा मेरा वोट गिरेगा आरजेडी का। जब तक सांस है, जब तक ललटेन पर मेरा वोट गिरना ही गिरना है।
respondents.quote_english: My vote will unilaterally go to RJD. As long as I breathe, my vote will definitely fall on the lantern (RJD symbol).
respondents.demographics_or_context: Adult male, very vocal, local resident.

respondents.key_reason: Extreme dissatisfaction with the current central government (Modi/BJP) and local MP (Ravishankar Prasad) due to high inflation, unfulfilled promises (15 lakh), lack of development, MP's absence from the constituency, focus on divisive issues (Hindu-Muslim, Pakistan), and alleged EVM tampering. Expresses a strong desire for change.
respondents.quote_original: महंगाई का तो रोके नहीं है। कुछ नहीं। देखिए सिलेंडर कितना हो गया महंगा। आदमी गरीब मर रहा है। इस बार नहीं मिलेगा। बहुत मौका दिए हम लोग। कुछ नहीं किया। ईवीएम से खेला हो रहा है यहां पे। मंदिर मस्जिद यही करते रहते हैं उनके अलावा उनका कोई काम ही नहीं है।
respondents.quote_english: They haven't stopped inflation. Nothing. Look how expensive cylinders have become. Poor people are dying. This time they won't get it. We gave them many chances. They did nothing. EVM rigging is happening here. They just keep doing temple-mosque, besides that they have no other work.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Adult male, very vocal, critical, likely a local resident.

respondents.key_reason: Strong anti-incumbency against the local MP (Ravishankar Prasad) who has not visited the constituency even once after winning two terms, showing a lack of engagement with the public.
respondents.quote_original: जीतने के बाद आए हैं एक भी बार? दो टेन्योर से रहे हैं तो दो टेन्योर। कभी नहीं, कभी नहीं, कभी नहीं आए हैं।
respondents.quote_english: Have they come even once after winning? They've been there for two tenures. Never, never, never came.

respondents.key_reason: Strong anti-incumbency against the local MP (Ravishankar Prasad) who is completely absent from the constituency, unknown to many, and only appears on TV. There is a strong demand for change.
respondents.quote_original: यहां एक भी गली कुछ में कहीं भी देख लीजिए उनका कोई नामो निशान नहीं है। जीतने के बाद जीतने के बाद आए हैं एक भी बार? दो टेन्योर से रहे हैं तो दो टेन्योर। कभी नहीं, कभी नहीं, कभी नहीं आए हैं। एकदम बदलाव दम जरूरी है।
respondents.quote_english: Look anywhere, in any street, there's no trace of him. Have they come even once after winning? They've been there for two tenures. Never, never, never came. Change is absolutely necessary.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures strong anti-incumbency sentiment in Patna Sahib, Bihar. Interviewees express deep dissatisfaction with both the central BJP government over inflation and unfulfilled promises, and the local MP (Ravishankar Prasad) for his complete absence from the constituency. While some firmly support RJD due to perceived job creation by Tejaswi Yadav, others demand change without specifying an alternative, citing issues like EVM tampering and a focus on divisive politics.

respondents.key_reason: Believes Shatrughan Sinha won his seat due to the NDA/BJP's vote bank and not his individual popularity or name.
respondents.quote_original: शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा के नाम पर नहीं बी हुआ है। लाला जी को वोट बैंक यहां है इसलिए बीजेपी है, एनडीए के नाम से जीते।
respondents.quote_english: He didn't win on Shatrughan Sinha's name. Lalaji's vote bank is here, that's why BJP, he won on NDA's name.

respondents.key_reason: Criticizes Shatrughan Sinha for being arrogant and not listening to people's problems, stating he has never heard him address issues in 10 years.
respondents.quote_original: सुने ही नहीं आज तक। 10 साल में हमको नहीं लगा कि सुने कभी किसी का। आदमी रावण का घमंड तो रहा ही नहीं तो इनका फिर कहां से रहेगा।
respondents.quote_english: Never heard him till today. In 10 years, I don't think he ever listened to anyone. Even Ravana's arrogance didn't last, so how can his last?

respondents.key_reason: Acknowledges the public perception that BJP is the best, despite Shatrughan Sinha's perceived inaction in getting work done. Expresses uncertainty about future election outcomes.
respondents.quote_original: काम तो ऐसे जिस तरीके से उनको चुना जाता है उस हिसाब से तो काम नहीं ही करवाते हैं लेकिन क्या करें लोग का मेंटालिटी बैठा हुआ है बीजेपी इज द बेस्ट तो ऐसे तो बीजेपी बेस्ट है ही लेकिन आगे अब आगे आने वाले चुनाव में देखा जाएगा क्या होगा नहीं होगा।
respondents.quote_english: The way he was elected, he doesn't get work done, but what to do, people's mentality is set that BJP is the best. So BJP is indeed the best, but in the upcoming elections, we'll see what happens.

respondents.key_reason: Highlights the lack of support for street vendors and the absence of a proper system for small businesses, leading to suffering among the poor.
respondents.quote_original: फुटपाथ पर कोई दुकान लगाने नहीं दे रहा है गरीब आदमी मर रहा है। उसको कोई लाइसेंस बनाना चाहिए कुछ करना चाहिए कि हां 1500 लगेगा 500 लगेगा कायदे की जगह पर लगाओ। कोई व्यवस्था नहीं है।
respondents.quote_english: They don't let poor people set up shops on the footpath, poor people are dying. They should make a license or do something, like it will cost 1500 or 500, set it up in a proper place. There's no system.

respondents.key_reason: Is confident that BJP will not win in Bihar, stating that if they do, it would be purely by luck.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी तो आएगा ही नहीं कंफर्म है बिहार के अंदर में। अगर आ गया तो उसका गुड लक होगा।
respondents.quote_english: BJP will not come at all, it's confirmed in Bihar. If it comes, it will be his good luck.

respondents.key_reason: Believes BJP will not give Shatrughan Sinha a ticket, noting his criticism of BJP and his association with other parties like Mamata Banerjee's.
respondents.quote_original: ये तो बीजेपी उनको टिकट दे नहीं जा रही तो लड़ेंगे कहां। सवाल ही नहीं है। बीजेपी से लड़ने का उनका प्रश्न ही नहीं है। वो तो कल ममता बनर्जी के यहां भी जाए और वहां भी अपना रहे हैं। तो बीजेपी के क्रिटिक रहे हैं वो।
respondents.quote_english: BJP is not going to give him a ticket, so where will he contest from? There's no question. There's no question of him contesting from BJP. He even went to Mamata Banerjee's place yesterday and stayed there. So he has been a critic of BJP.

respondents.key_reason: Criticizes Shatrughan Sinha for not resolving persistent waterlogging and drainage issues, despite being an MP for multiple terms, noting that these problems didn't exist 40 years ago.
respondents.quote_original: नाला का पानी तो ही जाता है बरसात में पानी निकलता नहीं है। वाटर लॉगिंग तो बहुत है। डी ब्लॉक से लेकर लोहानीपुर तक। समस्या ही समस्या है ना। पानी वाटर लॉगिंग जो है दो टर्म शत्रुघ्न सिन्हा जी एमपी रहे उसके बाद राज्यसभा से भी रहे तो समस्या तो खत्म होना चाहिए।
respondents.quote_english: Drain water flows, but in monsoon, water doesn't drain. Waterlogging is a big problem. From D Block to Lohanipur. It's just problems, isn't it? Waterlogging, Shatrughan Sinha was MP for two terms, then also from Rajya Sabha, so the problem should have ended.

respondents.key_reason: Defends BJP and criticizes Shatrughan Sinha for attacking the party, stating that Sinha lacks substance, is insignificant compared to Modi, and the party will not tolerate his criticism.
respondents.quote_original: प्रहार इसलिए कि वो अपने कुछ नहीं है तो क्या करेंगे। पार्टी को उतना गाली बगे तो पार्टी तो नहीं रखेगा। मोदी सामने ये जीरो हैं।
respondents.quote_english: He attacks because he himself is nothing, so what else will he do? If he abuses the party so much, the party won't keep him. In front of Modi, he is zero.

respondents.key_reason: States that she has not seen Shatrughan Sinha and no development work has been done in her area.
respondents.quote_original: नहीं हम नहीं देखे हैं। कोई काम नहीं करवाएं।
respondents.quote_english: No, we haven't seen him. No work has been done.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Female, lives near Congress Maidan, not a long-term resident

respondents.key_reason: Believes Shatrughan Sinha gets a lot of work done in the area, including cleanliness and maintenance, and expresses surprise that he didn't secure a position within BJP.
respondents.quote_original: करवाते हैं बहुत काम करवाते हैं। सफाई-फाई करवाना सब कुछ देखरेख सब कुछ करवाते हैं। आश्चर्य होता है कि बीजेपी में उनका कुछ जगह नहीं मिल पाया।
respondents.quote_english: He gets a lot of work done. Cleaning, maintenance, everything. It's surprising that he didn't get a place in BJP.

respondents.key_reason: Observes that local development work, such as roads, streetlights, and cleanliness, is currently being carried out.
respondents.quote_original: अभी तो काम तो हो ही रहा है। सफाई-तफाई है सड़क-वड़क वाला सलाई-वलाई सब तो हो गए हैं। हां सब तो है। हां लाइट-उट लगे हुए किया है।
respondents.quote_english: Work is happening right now. Cleaning, roads, streetlights, all that has been done. Yes, all that is there. Yes, he got lights installed.

respondents.key_reason: States that Shatrughan Sinha does all the necessary work in the area, including getting lights installed and constructing lanes.
respondents.quote_original: काम तो पूरा करते हैं। जो भी इतना अगल-बगल में गली है सब उन्हीं का दिया हुआ है। लाइट लगवाए हैं। बगल में जितना भी गली है सब वही बनवाए हैं।
respondents.quote_english: He does all the work. All the lanes around here are his contribution. He got lights installed. All the lanes nearby, he got them built.

respondents.key_reason: Criticizes Shatrughan Sinha for listening very little to the problems of the people.
respondents.quote_original: वो तो बहुत कम सुन पाते हैं।
respondents.quote_english: He listens very little.

respondents.key_reason: Criticizes Shatrughan Sinha for rarely visiting the area and not paying attention to the poor or their work-related issues, such as street vendors.
respondents.quote_original: कैसा हो रहा है काम धंधा यहां पर साल में कितना बार आते हैं जो गरीब आदमी को देख लेते हैं। बहुत कम आते हैं। एक दिन आते हैं तो चार रोज नहीं आते।
respondents.quote_english: How is the work here? How many times a year does he come to see the poor people? He comes very rarely. If he comes one day, he doesn't come for four days.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, lives in the city (not a close neighbor)

respondents.key_reason: States that he does not recognize Shatrughan Sinha.
respondents.quote_original: पहचान ना करते हैं भाई झूठ काहे कहे। पहचाने ना करते हैं तो जानेंगे कैसे।
respondents.quote_english: Don't recognize him, why lie? If I don't recognize him, how would I know him?

respondents.key_reason: Criticizes Shatrughan Sinha's inaccessibility, noting that security guards at his house prevent public interaction.
respondents.quote_original: वो तो आते हैं अपना घर पर तो वहां तो गार्ड रहता है ना जाएंगे भी तो नहीं जाने देगा कोई।
respondents.quote_english: He comes to his house, but there's a guard there, so even if we go, no one will let us in.

respondents.key_reason: Knows Shatrughan Sinha from photos but has not seen him in person.
respondents.quote_original: देखे तो नहीं है फोटो देखता हूं।
respondents.quote_english: Haven't seen him, I see his photo.

respondents.key_reason: Expresses a highly positive view of Shatrughan Sinha's character, noting his regular visits (every 15-20 days) and his interaction with neighbors.
respondents.quote_original: और यहां के जितने पड़ोस के लोग हैं सभी लोगों से मिलते जुलते हैं। अच्छे विचार के हैं बहुत बढ़िया मैंने बहुत ही ऊंचे विचार के इंसान हैं।
respondents.quote_english: And he meets all the neighbors here. He has good thoughts, a very great, very high-minded person.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, long-term neighbor of Shatrughan Sinha

analysis.overall_video_summary: The public opinion on Shatrughan Sinha in his Patna Sahib constituency is highly divided. While some neighbors praise his character, frequent visits, and development work, many others criticize his inaccessibility, lack of responsiveness to public problems like waterlogging and street vendor issues, and perceived arrogance. There's also a strong sentiment that his political success is tied to the NDA/BJP brand rather than his individual popularity, with some believing he won't get a BJP ticket in the future.

analysis.video_title: Battle for Patna Sahib

respondents.key_reason: Expressed strong dissatisfaction with Shatrughan Sinha, stating he has not visited the constituency nor undertaken any development work.
respondents.quote_original: Shatrughan ji aaj tak laagi idhar dikhai bhi nahi diye hain. Kabhi bhi nahi. Kuch kaam nahi hua hai.
respondents.quote_english: Shatrughan ji has not been seen here till date. Never ever. No work has been done.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, local resident in Patna Sahib.

respondents.key_reason: As a political candidate, he emphasizes that the election is about determining the country's direction, not about film connections, positioning himself as a serious political contender.
respondents.quote_original: Nahi dekhiye, wo ye desh ki dasha disha tay karne ka chunav hai.
respondents.quote_english: No, look, this election is about deciding the direction of the country.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, political candidate for Congress in Patna Sahib.

respondents.key_reason: Highlights Arvind Kejriwal's track record in Delhi, emphasizing that promises were fulfilled, and criticizes film stars in politics for not engaging with ground-level issues.
respondents.quote_original: Aap Arvind Kejriwal ka naam sune hain na? Delhi mein sarkar bani thi. Hai na? Aur sab jitna bhi unhone wada kiya tha usko nibhaya. Aapko pata hai na?
respondents.quote_english: You've heard Arvind Kejriwal's name, right? A government was formed in Delhi. Right? And he fulfilled all the promises he made. You know that, right?
respondents.demographics_or_context: Female, political candidate for Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) in Patna Sahib.

respondents.key_reason: Expresses strong skepticism about claims of development, citing a lack of jobs and poor sanitation as major unaddressed issues.
respondents.quote_original: Dekhiye sabse pehla baat to job nahi hai yahan pe. Safai nahi hai yahan pe. Kaafi log bolte hain ki vikas hua hai. Mereko nahi lagta ki vikas hua hai. Lekin agar aap boliye ki industry aa gaya, job aa gaya, to ye pura ka pura fake hai.
respondents.quote_english: Look, first of all, there are no jobs here. There is no cleanliness here. Many people say development has happened. I don't think development has happened. But if you say industry has come, jobs have come, then this is all fake.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, local resident in Patna Sahib.

respondents.key_reason: As a candidate, he acknowledges existing shortcomings in governance, such as poor roads and drains, but asserts that capable individuals (like himself/his party) are needed to bring about future progress.
respondents.quote_original: Nitish Kumar, unki sarkar, bahut kamiya baaki hain. Anek log ginayenge, hamara rodwa dekhe, naliya dekhe. Lekin jo aadmi kar sakta hai, jisko karne ki kshamta hai, wahi aage bhi karega.
respondents.quote_english: Nitish Kumar, his government, many shortcomings remain. Many people will list them, look at our roads, look at the drains. But the person who can do it, who has the capability to do it, only they will do it in the future too.
respondents.demographics_or_context: Male, political candidate for Janata Dal (United) in Patna Sahib.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video provides a ground report from the Patna Sahib Lok Sabha constituency, highlighting a multi-cornered contest involving prominent figures like Shatrughan Sinha, Kunal Singh Yadav (Congress), Praveen Amanullah (AAP), and Gopal Prasad Sinha (JDU). It captures voter sentiment, which largely expresses dissatisfaction with the lack of development, jobs, and sanitation, particularly criticizing the performance of incumbent politicians. The report also touches upon the candidates' strategies, including AAP's focus on Kejriwal's Delhi model and the JDU candidate's acknowledgment of local issues while promising future action.

metadata.title: Bihar Election 2025: Patna Sahib का किला ढहेगा, तेज रफ्तार चाहिए,लोग दहाड़े, कोढ़ी है ऊ सब, बदलेंगे?

analysis.video_title: Bihar Election 2025: Patna Sahib का किला ढहेगा, तेज रफ्तार चाहिए,लोग दहाड़े, कोढ़ी है ऊ सब, बदलेंगे?

respondents.key_reason: Strong confidence that Congress will win.
respondents.quote_english: Congress will win 100%.

respondents.key_reason: Dissatisfaction with the current government's performance over 20 years, citing lack of employment and only basic infrastructure development. Believes the current government is lazy and ineffective, and Congress will win.
respondents.quote_original: बेरोजगार के लिए रोजगार जो कि देवे नहीं करता। ऊ काम ना करता है सब कोढ़ी है सब। कांग्रेस जीतेगी यहां से।
respondents.quote_english: They don't provide employment for the unemployed. They don't work, they are all lazy. Congress will win from here.

respondents.key_reason: Support for Tejashwi Yadav.
respondents.quote_original: तेजस्वी
respondents.quote_english: Tejashwi

respondents.key_reason: Support for Nitish Kumar.
respondents.quote_original: तेज रफ्तार नीतीश कुमार
respondents.quote_english: Fast-paced Nitish Kumar

respondents.key_reason: Support for Tejashwi Yadav.
respondents.quote_original: तेजस्वी यादव
respondents.quote_english: Tejashwi Yadav

respondents.key_reason: Desire for a change in government.
respondents.quote_original: सरकार बदलना चाहिए।
respondents.quote_english: The government should change.

respondents.key_reason: Belief that change will occur in Patna Sahib.
respondents.quote_original: पटना साहिब भी बदलेगा इस बार।
respondents.quote_english: Patna Sahib will also change this time.

respondents.key_reason: Predicts BJP's defeat in its stronghold due to internal discord and dissatisfaction over ticket distribution for the local MLA's son.
respondents.quote_original: बीजेपी अपने मजबूत किले को खोने जा रही है। उन लोग में आपस में बहुत अनबन है ना। माननीय यहां के जो विधायक जी हैं वो चाह रहे थे कि हमारे सुपुत्र को मिले टिकट। उनको नहीं मिला, उनको मन में अंदर से करवाहट है, दुख है, तकलीफ है।
respondents.quote_english: BJP is going to lose its strong fort. They have a lot of internal discord. The honorable MLA here wanted his son to get the ticket. He didn't get it, he has bitterness, sadness, and pain inside.

respondents.key_reason: Supports Tejashwi Yadav with the hope of securing employment and better education for the youth and their children.
respondents.quote_original: हम तेजस्वी यादव को वोट देंगे। हम लोग हम लोग नौजवान आदमी है उन्हीं से इसका ये है बेटा-बेटी भी पढ़ रही है, नौकरी मिलेगा उम्मीद पर।
respondents.quote_english: We will vote for Tejashwi Yadav. We are young people, and he is our hope. Our children are studying, we hope to get jobs.

respondents.key_reason: Believes Patna Sahib is demanding change.
respondents.quote_original: पटना साहिब बदलाव मांग रहा है।
respondents.quote_english: Patna Sahib is asking for change.

respondents.key_reason: Expresses dissatisfaction that the poor have received no benefits in the last 15 years under the current government.
respondents.quote_original: 15 साल में अभी तक गरीब लोग कुछ नहीं मिला।
respondents.quote_english: In 15 years, the poor people have received nothing.

respondents.key_reason: Observing public sentiment, noting happiness with Mahagathbandhan and anger towards NDA, implying a shift in public mood.
respondents.quote_original: महागठबंधन में इतनी खुशी और एनडीए से इतनी नाराजगी का है?
respondents.quote_english: Why so much happiness with Mahagathbandhan and so much anger with NDA?

respondents.key_reason: Believes everyone has their own choice and does not state a preference.
respondents.quote_original: अपना-अपना चॉइस है।
respondents.quote_english: Everyone has their own choice.

respondents.key_reason: Believes the Congress candidate, Sushant Shekhar, has a strong hold, and NDA is losing due to internal issues like Nand Kishore Yadav not getting a ticket.
respondents.quote_original: इस बार तो सुशांत शेखर जो है उनका पकड़ बढ़िया चल रहा है। एनडीए को तो हारना चाहिए नंदकिशोर जी के टिकट नहीं मिलने के कारण का है कि नंदकिशोर जी के पकड़ अच्छा था।

respondents.quote_english: Being a strong fort doesn't mean anything; the public here is in the mood for change. Very much in the mood for change and wants to make Congress win at all costs.

respondents.key_reason: Believes Congress should win the seat, questioning why NDA should always take it, indicating a desire for change.

respondents.quote_english: Congress will get the seat, why should NDA always take it?

respondents.quote_english: We are angry with the government. For Yadavs, sand mining is stopped, water supply is stopped, everything is stopped. Nothing is working. This time in Patna Sahib, you will bring change.

respondents.key_reason: Supports Congress due to the educated and capable candidate, Sushant Shekhar, who is expected to address the issues of the poor. Believes change is necessary and predicts BJP's long-standing dominance will end.

respondents.quote_english: We want change because the youth, Sushant Shekhar, the candidate given by Congress, is very gentle and educated. We don't want the current government; we want change. This time, BJP's 30-year dream from here will be shattered.

respondents.quote_english: Everyone gets the Sahara money. They gave poison to lakhs of people, making them drink poison. Poor people are dying, crying.

respondents.quote_english: Definitely change will happen.

analysis.overall_video_summary: The video captures a strong sentiment for change in the Patna Sahib constituency, with a significant number of interviewees expressing dissatisfaction with the incumbent BJP/NDA government. Many respondents cite issues like lack of employment, unfulfilled promises (e.g., Sahara money, 10,000 rupees for the poor), and a general lack of development over the past 15-20 years. There is a clear leaning towards the Mahagathbandhan, particularly the Congress candidate Sushant Shekhar and Tejashwi Yadav, with many believing that BJP's traditional stronghold will fall due to internal party issues and public demand for new leadership.
